From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Theorem preservation : forall E R e s e' s' T,
  typing E R e T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  red e s e' s' ->
  exists R', wf_sig E (R' ++ R) /\
    typing E (R' ++ R) e' T /\
    typing_store E (R' ++ R) s'
with preservation_record : forall E R r s r' s' T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  red_record_comp r s r' s' ->
  exists R', wf_sig E (R' ++ R) /\
    typing_record_comp E (R' ++ R) r' T /\
    typing_store E (R' ++ R) s'.

Theorem progress : forall e s R T,
  typing empty R e T ->
  typing_store empty R s ->
  value e \/ exists e' s', red e s e' s'
with progress_record_comp : forall r s R T,
  typing_record_comp empty R r T ->
  typing_store empty R s ->
  value_record_comp r \/ exists r' s', red_record_comp r s r' s'.

17	Inductive mut : Set :=

21	Inductive typ : Set :=
22	  | typ_top : typ
23	  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
24	  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
25	  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
26	  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ

34	  | typ_record : atom -> typ -> typ

36	
37	Inductive exp : Set :=
38	  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
39	  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
40	  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
41	  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
42	  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
43	  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
44	  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
45	
46	  | exp_box : exp -> exp
47	  | exp_unbox : exp -> exp
48	  | exp_set_box : exp -> exp -> exp
49	  | exp_ref : label -> exp
50	
51	  | exp_seal : exp -> exp
52	
53	  | exp_record : rec_comp -> exp
54	  | exp_record_read : exp -> atom -> exp
55	  | exp_record_write: exp -> atom -> exp -> exp
56	with rec_comp : Set :=
57	
58	
59	  | rec_empty : rec_comp
60	  | rec_exp : atom -> exp -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
61	  | rec_ref : atom -> label -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
62	.
63	
64	Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.
65	
66	Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.
67	
68	Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.
69	
70	Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.
71	
72	Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
73	  match T with
74	  | typ_top => typ_top
75	  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
76	  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
77	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
78	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
79	  | typ_box T => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T)
80	  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
81	  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
82	  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
83	  end.
84	
85	Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
86	  match e with
87	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
88	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
89	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
90	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
91	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
92	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
93	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
94	  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
95	  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
96	  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
97	  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
98	  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
99	  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
100	  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
101	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
102	  end
103	with
104	  open_te_record_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
105	  match r with
106	  | rec_empty => rec_empty
107	  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_te_rec K U e) (open_te_record_rec K U r)
108	  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_te_record_rec K U r)
109	  end.
110	
111	Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
112	  match e with
113	  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
114	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
115	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
116	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
117	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
118	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
119	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
120	  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_ee_rec k f e)
121	  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_ee_rec k f  e)
122	  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_ee_rec k f b) (open_ee_rec k f e)
123	  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
124	  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_ee_rec k f e)
125	  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
126	  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_ee_rec k f e) a
127	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_ee_rec k f e1) a (open_ee_rec k f e2)
128	  end
129	with
130	  open_ee_record_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : rec_comp :=
131	  match r with
132	  | rec_empty => rec_empty
133	  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_ee_rec k f e) (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
134	  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
135	  end.
136	
137	Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.
138	
139	Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.
140	
141	Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.
142	
143	Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
144	  | type_top :
145	      type typ_top
146	  | type_var : forall X,
147	      type (typ_fvar X)
148	  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
149	      type T1 ->
150	      type T2 ->
151	      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
152	  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
153	      type T1 ->
154	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 X)) ->
155	      type (typ_all T1 T2)
156	  | type_box : forall T,
157	      type T ->
158	      type (typ_box T)
159	  | type_readonly : forall T,
160	      type T ->
161	      type (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
162	  | type_intersect : forall T1 T2,
163	      type T1 ->
164	      type T2 ->
165	      type (typ_int T1 T2)
166	  | type_record : forall a T1,
167	      type T1 ->
168	      type (typ_record a T1)
169	.
170	
171	Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
172	  | expr_var : forall x,
173	      expr (exp_fvar x)
174	  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
175	      type T ->
176	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
177	      expr (exp_abs T e1)
178	  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
179	      expr e1 ->
180	      expr e2 ->
181	      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
182	  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
183	      type T ->
184	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
185	      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
186	  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
187	      expr e1 ->
188	      type V ->
189	      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
190	  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
191	      expr e1 ->
192	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
193	      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
194	  | expr_box : forall e,
195	      expr e ->
196	      expr (exp_box e)
197	  | expr_unbox : forall e,
198	      expr e ->
199	      expr (exp_unbox e)
200	  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
201	      expr e1 ->
202	      expr e2 ->
203	      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
204	  | expr_ref : forall l,
205	      expr (exp_ref l)
206	  | expr_seal : forall e,
207	      expr e ->
208	      expr (exp_seal e)
209	  | expr_record : forall r,
210	      record_comp r ->
211	      expr (exp_record r)
212	  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
213	      expr e ->
214	      expr (exp_record_read e a)
215	  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
216	      expr e1 ->
217	      expr e2 ->
218	      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
219	with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
220	  | record_comp_empty :
221	      record_comp (rec_empty)
222	  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
223	      expr e ->
224	      record_comp r ->
225	      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
226	  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
227	      record_comp r ->
228	      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
229	.
230	
231	Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
232	  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).
233	
234	Inductive binding : Set :=
235	  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
236	  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.
237	
238	Inductive signature : Set :=
239	  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.
240	
241	Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).
242	
243	Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).
244	
245	Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).
246	
247	Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).
248	
249	Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
250	  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
251	      wf_typ E typ_top
252	  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
253	      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
254	      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
255	  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
256	      wf_typ E T1 ->
257	      wf_typ E T2 ->
258	      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
259	  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
260	      wf_typ E T1 ->
261	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
262	        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
263	      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
264	  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
265	      wf_typ E T ->
266	      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
267	  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
268	      wf_typ E T ->
269	      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
270	  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
271	      wf_typ E T1 ->
272	      wf_typ E T2 ->
273	      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
274	  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
275	      wf_typ E T1 ->
276	      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
277	.
278	
279	Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
280	  | wf_env_empty :
281	      wf_env empty
282	  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
283	      wf_env E ->
284	      wf_typ E T ->
285	      X `notin` dom E ->
286	      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
287	  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
288	      wf_env E ->
289	      wf_typ E T ->
290	      x `notin` dom E ->
291	      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).
292	
293	Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
294	    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
295	        wf_env E ->
296	        wf_sig E sempty
297	    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
298	        wf_sig E R ->
299	        wf_typ E T ->
300	        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
301	        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).
302	
303	Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
304	    match T with
305	
306	
307	
308	    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
309	    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
310	    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
311	    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
312	
313	    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))
314	
315	    | _ => T
316	    end.
317	
318	Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
319	    match T with
320	    | typ_top => typ_top
321	    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
322	    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
323	    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
324	    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
325	    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
326	    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
327	    | typ_mut M T =>
328	        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
329	    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
330	    end.
331	
332	Arguments merge_mutability T m /.
333	
334	Arguments normal_form_typing T /.
335	
336	Inductive in_normal_form : typ -> Prop :=
337	  | top_in_normal_form :
338	    in_normal_form typ_top
339	  | fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom),
340	    in_normal_form X
341	  | readonly_fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom) m,
342	    in_normal_form (typ_mut m X)
343	  | arrow_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
344	    in_normal_form T1 ->
345	    in_normal_form T2 ->
346	    in_normal_form (typ_arrow T1 T2)
347	  | all_in_normal_form : forall L T1 T2,
348	    in_normal_form T1 ->
349	    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> in_normal_form (open_tt T2 X)) ->
350	    in_normal_form (typ_all T1 T2)
351	  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
352	    in_normal_form T ->
353	    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
354	  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
355	    in_normal_form T ->
356	    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
357	  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
358	    in_normal_form T1 ->
359	    in_normal_form T2 ->
360	    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
361	  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
362	    in_normal_form T1 ->
363	    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
364	  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
365	    in_normal_form T ->
366	    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
367	.
368	
369	Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
370	  | actually_equal : forall S T,
371	    S = T ->
372	    in_intersection S T
373	  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
374	    in_intersection S L ->
375	    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
376	  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
377	    in_intersection S R ->
378	    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).
379	
380	Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
381	    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
382	    (in_intersection S T).
383	
384	Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
385	  | sub_top : forall E S,
386	      wf_env E ->
387	      wf_typ E S ->
388	      sub E S typ_top
389	  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
390	      wf_env E ->
391	      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
392	      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
393	  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,

408	      sub E T2 T1 ->
409	      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)
410	
411	  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
412	      sub E T1 T2 ->
413	      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
414	
415	  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
416	      sub E T1 T2 ->
417	      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
418	  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
419	      sub E T1 T2 ->
420	      sub E T2 T3 ->
421	      sub E T1 T3
422	  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,

424	      wf_typ E T1 ->
425	      wf_typ E T2 ->

433	      sub E T1 T2 ->
434	      sub E T1 T3 ->

436	  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
437	      sub E T1 T2 ->
438	      sub E T2 T1 ->
439	      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)
440	
441	  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
442	      sub E T1 T2 ->
443	      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))
444	
445	  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
446	      wf_typ E T1 ->
447	      wf_typ E T2 ->
448	      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
449	      sub E T1 T2
450	.
451	
452	Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).
453	
454	Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
455	    match r with
456	    | rec_empty => {}
457	    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
458	    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
459	    end.

461	Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
462	  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
463	      wf_env E ->
464	      wf_sig E R ->
465	      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
466	      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
467	  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
468	      wf_sig E R ->
469	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
470	        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
471	      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
472	  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
473	      wf_sig E R ->
474	      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
475	      typing E R e2 T1 ->
476	      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
477	  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
478	      wf_sig E R ->
479	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
480	        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
481	      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
482	  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
483	      wf_sig E R ->
484	      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
485	      sub E T T1 ->
486	      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
487	  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
488	      wf_sig E R ->
489	      typing E R e S ->
490	      sub E S T ->
491	      typing E R e T
492	  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
493	      wf_sig E R ->
494	      typing E R e1 T1 ->
495	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
496	        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
497	      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
498	  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
499	      wf_sig E R ->
500	      typing E R e T ->
501	      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
502	  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
503	      wf_sig E R ->
504	      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
505	      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T
506	
507	  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
508	      wf_sig E R ->
509	      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
510	      typing E R e2 T ->
511	      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
512	  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
513	      wf_env E ->
514	      wf_sig E R ->
515	      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
516	      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)
517	
518	  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
519	      typing E R e T ->
520	      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
521	
522	  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
523	      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
524	      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
525	  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
526	      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
527	      typing E R (exp_record r) T
528	
529	  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
530	      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
531	      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
532	  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
533	      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
534	      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
535	
536	  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
537	      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
538	      typing E R e2 T ->
539	      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
540	with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
541	  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
542	      wf_env E ->
543	      wf_sig E R ->
544	      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
545	  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
546	      a `notin` record_dom r ->
547	      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
548	      typing E R e T ->
549	      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
550	  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,

552	      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->

555	.

557	Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).
558	
559	Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

561	Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
562	  | value_abs : forall T e1,
563	      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
564	      value (exp_abs T e1)
565	  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
566	      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
567	      value (exp_tabs T e1)
568	  | value_ref : forall l,
569	      value (exp_ref l)
570	  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
571	      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))

573	      value_record_comp r ->
574	      value (exp_record r)
575	  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
576	      value_record_comp r ->
577	      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))

586	Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

591	  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

597	Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
598	  forall l,
599	    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
600	        exists v,
601	            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
602	            typing E R v T /\ value v)
603	    /\

605	        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

607	Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).
608	
609	Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
610	    match r with
611	    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
612	    | _ => None
613	    end.
614	
615	Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

617	Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
618	  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
619	      expr e2 ->
620	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
621	      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
622	  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
623	      value e1 ->
624	      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
625	      red (exp_app e1 e2) s2 (exp_app e1 e2') s2'
626	  | red_tapp : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' V,
627	      type V ->
628	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
629	      red (exp_tapp e1 V) s1 (exp_tapp e1' V) s1'
630	  | red_abs : forall T e1 s1 v2,
631	      well_formed_store s1 ->
632	      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
633	      value v2 ->
634	      red (exp_app (exp_abs T e1) v2) s1 (open_ee e1 v2) s1
635	  | red_tabs : forall T1 e1 s1 T2,
636	      well_formed_store s1 ->
637	      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
638	      type T2 ->
639	      red (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) s1 (open_te e1 T2) s1
640	  | red_let_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
641	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
642	      body_e e2 ->
643	      red (exp_let e1 e2) s1 (exp_let e1' e2) s1'
644	  | red_let : forall v1 e2 s2,
645	      well_formed_store s2 ->
646	      value v1 ->
647	      body_e e2 ->
648	      red (exp_let v1 e2) s2 (open_ee e2 v1) s2
649	  | red_box_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
650	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
651	      red (exp_box e1) s1 (exp_box e1') s1'
652	  | red_box_ref : forall v1 l s1,
653	      well_formed_store s1 ->
654	      value v1 ->
655	      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
656	      red (exp_box v1) s1 (exp_ref l) (LabelMapImpl.add l v1 s1)
657	  | red_unbox_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
658	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
659	      red (exp_unbox e1) s1 (exp_unbox e1') s1'
660	  | red_unbox_ref : forall l v1 s1,
661	      well_formed_store s1 ->
662	      value v1 ->
663	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
664	      red (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) s1 v1 s1
665	  | red_unbox_sealed_ref : forall l v1 s1,
666	      well_formed_store s1 ->
667	      value v1 ->
668	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
669	      red (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
670	  | red_set_box_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
671	      expr e2 ->
672	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
673	      red (exp_set_box e1 e2) s1 (exp_set_box e1' e2) s1'
674	  | red_set_box_2 : forall v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
675	      value v1 ->
676	      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
677	      red (exp_set_box v1 e2) s2 (exp_set_box v1 e2') s2'
678	  | red_set_box_ref : forall l v1 v2 s1,
679	      well_formed_store s1 ->
680	      value v1 ->
681	      value v2 ->
682	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
683	      red (exp_set_box (exp_ref l) v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
684	  | red_seal_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1',
685	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
686	      red (exp_seal e1) s1 (exp_seal e1') s1'
687	  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
688	      well_formed_store s1 ->
689	      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
690	      red (exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) s1 (exp_abs T e1) s1
691	  | red_seal_tabs : forall T e1 s1,
692	      well_formed_store s1 ->
693	      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
694	      red (exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) s1 (exp_tabs T e1) s1

696	      well_formed_store s1 ->
697	      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) s1
698	  | red_seal_sealed_record : forall r s1,
699	      well_formed_store s1 ->

702	  | red_record : forall r1 s1 r1' s1',

709	      well_formed_store s1 ->
710	      value_record_comp r ->

739	  | red_record_exp_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1,

754	Notation "< e1 | s1 > --> < e1' | s1' >" := (red e1 s1 e1' s1') (at level 69).

759	  | redm_eq : forall e s e' s',

769	  | sealcomp_fvar : forall (x : atom),
770	      sealcomp x x
771	  | sealcomp_bvar : forall (n : nat),
772	      sealcomp n n
773	  | sealcomp_abs : forall T e1 e2,

779	      sealcomp (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app f1 f2)
780	  | sealcomp_tabs : forall T e1 e2,
781	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
782	      sealcomp (exp_tabs T e1) (exp_tabs T e2)
783	  | sealcomp_tapp : forall T e1 e2,
784	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
785	      sealcomp (exp_tapp e1 T) (exp_tapp e2 T)

787	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
788	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
789	      sealcomp (exp_let e1 e2) (exp_let f1 f2)

791	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
792	      sealcomp (exp_box e1) (exp_box e2)
793	  | sealcomp_unbox : forall e1 e2,
794	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->

796	  | sealcomp_set_box : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
797	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
798	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->

802	  | sealcomp_seal : forall e1 e2,

805	  | sealcomp_record : forall r1 r2,
806	      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
807	      sealcomp (exp_record r1) (exp_record r2)
808	  | sealcomp_record_read : forall e1 e2 x,
809	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
810	      sealcomp (exp_record_read e1 x) (exp_record_read e2 x)
811	  | sealcomp_record_write : forall e1 f1 x e2 f2,
812	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
813	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
814	      sealcomp (exp_record_write e1 x e2) (exp_record_write f1 x f2)
815	  | sealcomp_multiple_seal : forall e1 e2,
816	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
817	      sealcomp e1 (exp_seal e2)

819	  | sealcomp_rec_empty :
820	      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_empty) (rec_empty)
821	  | sealcomp_rec_exp : forall a e1 e2 r1 r2,
822	      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
823	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
824	      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) (rec_exp a e2 r2)
825	  | sealcomp_rec_ref : forall a l r1 r2,
826	      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
827	      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_ref a l r1) (rec_ref a l r2)
828	.
829	
830	Definition sealcomp_store (s1 : store) (s2 : store) :=
831	  (forall l v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s1) ->
832	      exists v', (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v' s2) /\ sealcomp v v') /\
833	  (forall l v', (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v' s2) ->
834	      exists v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s1) /\ sealcomp v v').

836	Notation "e1 <e= e2" := (sealcomp e1 e2) (at level 60).
837	
838	Notation "r1 <r= r2" := (sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) (at level 60).
839	
840	Notation "s1 <s= s2" := (sealcomp_store s1 s2) (at level 60).
841	
842	Fixpoint seal_count (e : exp)  {struct e} : nat :=
843	  match e with
844	  | exp_bvar i => 0
845	  | exp_fvar x => 0
846	  | exp_abs V e1 => (seal_count e1)
847	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
848	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (seal_count e1)
849	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (seal_count e1)
850	  | exp_let e1 e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
851	  | exp_box e => (seal_count e)
852	  | exp_unbox e => (seal_count e)
853	  | exp_set_box b e => (seal_count b) + (seal_count e)
854	  | exp_ref l => 0
855	  | exp_seal e => (S (seal_count e))
856	  | exp_record r => (seal_count_record r)
857	  | exp_record_read e a => (seal_count e)
858	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
859	  end
860	with
861	  seal_count_record (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : nat :=
862	  match r with
863	  | rec_empty => 0
864	  | rec_exp a e r => (seal_count e) + (seal_count_record r)
865	  | rec_ref a l r => (seal_count_record r)
866	  end.
867	
868	Arguments seal_count e /.
869	
870	Arguments seal_count_record r /.
871	
872	Notation "| f |" := (seal_count f) (at level 69).

(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

Require Export Fsub.FmMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Require Export Fsub.Label.

Require Export Fsub.Signatures.

Require Export Fsub.LabelMap.

Require Export Coq.Program.Equality.


Inductive mut : Set :=
  | mut_readonly : mut
.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_box : typ -> typ

  | typ_mut : mut -> typ -> typ

  | typ_int : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_record : atom -> typ -> typ
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp

  | exp_box : exp -> exp
  | exp_unbox : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_box : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : label -> exp

  | exp_seal : exp -> exp

  | exp_record : rec_comp -> exp
  | exp_record_read : exp -> atom -> exp
  | exp_record_write: exp -> atom -> exp -> exp
with rec_comp : Set :=


  | rec_empty : rec_comp
  | rec_exp : atom -> exp -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
  | rec_ref : atom -> label -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_box T => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
  end
with
  open_te_record_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_te_rec K U e) (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_ee_rec k f  e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_ee_rec k f b) (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_ee_rec k f e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_ee_rec k f e1) a (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  end
with
  open_ee_record_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_ee_rec k f e) (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_box : forall T,
      type T ->
      type (typ_box T)
  | type_readonly : forall T,
      type T ->
      type (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | type_intersect : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_int T1 T2)
  | type_record : forall a T1,
      type T1 ->
      type (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_box : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_box e)
  | expr_unbox : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_unbox e)
  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
  | expr_ref : forall l,
      expr (exp_ref l)
  | expr_seal : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_seal e)
  | expr_record : forall r,
      record_comp r ->
      expr (exp_record r)
  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_record_read e a)
  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | record_comp_empty :
      record_comp (rec_empty)
  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
      expr e ->
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Inductive signature : Set :=
  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_mut M T =>
        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
    end.

Arguments merge_mutability T m /.

Arguments normal_form_typing T /.

Inductive in_normal_form : typ -> Prop :=
  | top_in_normal_form :
    in_normal_form typ_top
  | fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom),
    in_normal_form X
  | readonly_fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom) m,
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m X)
  | arrow_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | all_in_normal_form : forall L T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> in_normal_form (open_tt T2 X)) ->
    in_normal_form (typ_all T1 T2)
  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
.

Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | actually_equal : forall S T,
    S = T ->
    in_intersection S T
  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S L ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S R ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).

Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
    (in_intersection S T).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
      typing E R (exp_record r) T

  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
.

Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).

Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)
  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))
  | value_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_record r)
  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))
with value_record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | value_rec_empty :
      value_record_comp rec_empty
  | value_rec_ref : forall a l r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value_record_comp (rec_ref a l r)
.

Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

Notation empty_store := (LabelMapImpl.empty store).

Definition well_formed_store (s : store) :=
  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

(* The original dependent pair uses this same witness. *)
Definition fresh_label_for_store (s : store) :=
  Label.fresh (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)).

Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,
            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
            typing E R v T /\ value v)
    /\
    (forall v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
    match r with
    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
    | _ => None
    end.

Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value e1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s2 (exp_app e1 e2') s2'
  | red_tapp : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' V,
      type V ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_tapp e1 V) s1 (exp_tapp e1' V) s1'
  | red_abs : forall T e1 s1 v2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value v2 ->

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. tauto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.

    + right. apply IH. assumption.

  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),

Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.

  match T with

  | typ_bvar _ => {}

  | typ_all T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_box T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  end.

Lemma wf_typ_binds_iff_1 : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 <-> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.

Lemma sub_binds_iff : forall (E1 E2 : env) S T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 <-> binds x b E2) ->
  sub E1 S T -> sub E2 S T.
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 S T Hiff H.
  induction H as [ E S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E X HE0 HS0
                 | U E T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E T1 T2 HE0 HS1 HS2
                 | E T1 T2 HE0 HS1 HS2
                 | E T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E T1 T2 HS1 HS2 Hsub IHsub ].

  - apply sub_refl_tvar. eapply wf_typ_binds_iff; eauto.

  - apply (sub_all L E2 S1 S2 T1 T2); auto.

    intros y b. simpl. split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.

  - eapply sub_trans; eauto.

  - apply sub_inter; auto.
  - apply sub_record; auto.
  - apply sub_readonly_record; auto.
  - apply (sub_denormalize E2 T1 T2); eauto using wf_typ_binds_iff.
Qed.

685	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->

687	  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
688	      well_formed_store s1 ->

695	  | red_seal_sealed_ref: forall l s1,

699	      well_formed_store s1 ->

702	  | red_record : forall r1 s1 r1' s1',
703	      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
704	      red (exp_record r1) s1 (exp_record r1') s1'
705	  | red_record_read_1 : forall a e1 e1' s1 s1',

708	  | red_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
709	      well_formed_store s1 ->
710	      value_record_comp r ->

712	      value v1 ->
713	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
714	      red (exp_record_read (exp_record r) a) s1 v1 s1
715	  | red_sealed_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,

717	      value_record_comp r ->
718	      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
719	      value v1 ->
720	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
721	      red (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
722	  | red_record_write_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
723	      expr e2 ->
724	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
725	      red (exp_record_write e1 a e2) s1 (exp_record_write e1' a e2) s1'
726	  | red_record_write_2 : forall a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
727	      value v1 ->
728	      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
729	      red (exp_record_write v1 a e2) s2 (exp_record_write v1 a e2') s2'
730	  | red_record_write_ref : forall a l r v1 v2 s1,
731	      well_formed_store s1 ->
732	      value_record_comp r ->
733	      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
734	      value v1 ->
735	      value v2 ->
736	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
737	      red (exp_record_write (exp_record r) a v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
738	with red_record_comp : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop :=
739	  | red_record_exp_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1,
740	      record_comp r1 ->
741	      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
742	      red_record_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) s1 (rec_exp a e1' r1) s1'

744	      well_formed_store s1 ->

748	      red_record_comp (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1)
749	  | red_record_ref : forall a l r1 s1 r1' s1',

758	Inductive redm : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
759	  | redm_eq : forall e s e' s',
760	    e = e' -> s = s' -> redm e s e' s'
761	  | redm_step : forall e s e'' s'' e' s',
762	    red e s e'' s'' ->
763	    redm e'' s'' e' s' ->

768	Inductive sealcomp : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
769	  | sealcomp_fvar : forall (x : atom),
770	      sealcomp x x
771	  | sealcomp_bvar : forall (n : nat),
772	      sealcomp n n
773	  | sealcomp_abs : forall T e1 e2,
774	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
775	      sealcomp (exp_abs T e1) (exp_abs T e2)
776	  | sealcomp_app : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
777	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
778	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
779	      sealcomp (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app f1 f2)
780	  | sealcomp_tabs : forall T e1 e2,
781	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
782	      sealcomp (exp_tabs T e1) (exp_tabs T e2)
783	  | sealcomp_tapp : forall T e1 e2,
784	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
785	      sealcomp (exp_tapp e1 T) (exp_tapp e2 T)
786	  | sealcomp_let : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
787	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
788	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
789	      sealcomp (exp_let e1 e2) (exp_let f1 f2)
790	  | sealcomp_box : forall e1 e2,
791	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
792	      sealcomp (exp_box e1) (exp_box e2)
793	  | sealcomp_unbox : forall e1 e2,
794	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
795	      sealcomp (exp_unbox e1) (exp_unbox e2)
796	  | sealcomp_set_box : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
797	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
798	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
799	      sealcomp (exp_set_box e1 e2) (exp_set_box f1 f2)
800	  | sealcomp_ref : forall l,
801	      sealcomp (exp_ref l) (exp_ref l)
802	  | sealcomp_seal : forall e1 e2,
803	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
804	      sealcomp (exp_seal e1) (exp_seal e2)
805	  | sealcomp_record : forall r1 r2,
806	      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
807	      sealcomp (exp_record r1) (exp_record r2)
808	  | sealcomp_record_read : forall e1 e2 x,
809	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
810	      sealcomp (exp_record_read e1 x) (exp_record_read e2 x)
811	  | sealcomp_record_write : forall e1 f1 x e2 f2,
812	      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
813	      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
814	      sealcomp (exp_record_write e1 x e2) (exp_record_write f1 x f2)
815	  | sealcomp_multiple_seal : forall e1 e2,
816	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
817	      sealcomp e1 (exp_seal e2)
818	with sealcomp_rec_comp : rec_comp -> rec_comp -> Prop :=
819	  | sealcomp_rec_empty :
820	      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_empty) (rec_empty)
821	  | sealcomp_rec_exp : forall a e1 e2 r1 r2,
822	      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
823	      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
824	      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) (rec_exp a e2 r2)
825	  | sealcomp_rec_ref : forall a l r1 r2,
826	      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
827	      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_ref a l r1) (rec_ref a l r2)
828	.
829	
830	Definition sealcomp_store (s1 : store) (s2 : store) :=
831	  (forall l v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s1) ->
832	      exists v', (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v' s2) /\ sealcomp v v') /\
833	  (forall l v', (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v' s2) ->
834	      exists v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s1) /\ sealcomp v v').
835	
836	Notation "e1 <e= e2" := (sealcomp e1 e2) (at level 60).
837	
838	Notation "r1 <r= r2" := (sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) (at level 60).
839	
840	Notation "s1 <s= s2" := (sealcomp_store s1 s2) (at level 60).
841	
842	Fixpoint seal_count (e : exp)  {struct e} : nat :=
843	  match e with
844	  | exp_bvar i => 0
845	  | exp_fvar x => 0
846	  | exp_abs V e1 => (seal_count e1)
847	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
848	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (seal_count e1)
849	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (seal_count e1)
850	  | exp_let e1 e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
851	  | exp_box e => (seal_count e)
852	  | exp_unbox e => (seal_count e)
853	  | exp_set_box b e => (seal_count b) + (seal_count e)
854	  | exp_ref l => 0
855	  | exp_seal e => (S (seal_count e))
856	  | exp_record r => (seal_count_record r)
857	  | exp_record_read e a => (seal_count e)
858	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
859	  end
860	with
861	  seal_count_record (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : nat :=
862	  match r with
863	  | rec_empty => 0
864	  | rec_exp a e r => (seal_count e) + (seal_count_record r)
865	  | rec_ref a l r => (seal_count_record r)
866	  end.
867	
868	Arguments seal_count e /.
869	
870	Arguments seal_count_record r /.
871	
872	Notation "| f |" := (seal_count f) (at level 69).

1	From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
2	
3	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
4	(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)
5	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
6	
7	Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
8	  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
9	Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.
10	
11	Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
12	  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
13	Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.
14	
15	Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
16	  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
17	Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.
18	
19	Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
20	  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
21	Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.
22	
23	Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
24	  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
25	Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.
26	
27	Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
28	  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
29	Proof.
30	  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
31	  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
32	Qed.
33	
34	Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
35	  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
36	Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [H|H].
37	  - left. symmetry. assumption.
38	  - right. assumption.
39	  - left. symmetry. assumption.
40	  - right. assumption.
41	Qed.
42	
43	Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
44	  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
45	Proof.
46	  induction E as [| [y b'] E IH]; intros x b Hb.
47	  - inversion Hb.
48	  - apply (in_dom_cons E x y b'). simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
49	    + inversion Heq. subst. left. reflexivity.
50	    + right. apply (IH x b). assumption.
51	Qed.
52	
53	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
54	(* Free atoms of a type                                              *)
55	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
56	
57	Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
58	  match T with
59	  | typ_top => {}
60	  | typ_bvar _ => {}
61	  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
62	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
63	  | typ_all T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
64	  | typ_box T1 => fv_typ T1
65	  | typ_mut _ T1 => fv_typ T1
66	  | typ_int T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
67	  | typ_record _ T1 => fv_typ T1
68	  end.
69	
70	Lemma fv_typ_open_tt : forall (T : typ) K (U : typ) X,
71	  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X `notin` fv_typ U ->
72	  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K U T).
73	Proof.
74	  induction T; intros K U X HT HU; simpl in *.
75	  - auto.
76	  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E; simpl.
77	    + assumption.
78	    + auto.
79	  - auto.
80	  - simpl. auto.
81	  - simpl. auto.
82	  - simpl. auto.
83	  - simpl. auto.
84	  - simpl. auto.
85	  - simpl. auto.
86	Qed.
87	
88	Lemma fv_typ_open_tt_fvar : forall (T : typ) K (Y X : atom),
89	  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X <> Y ->
90	  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T).
91	Proof.
92	  intros T K Y X HT HXY.
93	  assert (Hnot : X `notin` fv_typ (typ_fvar Y)).
94	  { simpl. apply notin_singleton. auto. }
95	  eapply fv_typ_open_tt; eauto.
96	Qed.
97	
98	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
99	(* Well-formed types depend only on the bindings available           *)
100	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
101	
102	Lemma wf_typ_binds_iff : forall (E1 : env) T,
103	  wf_typ E1 T ->
104	  forall (E2 : env), (forall x b, binds x b E1 <-> binds x b E2) -> wf_typ E2 T.
105	Proof.
106	  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hiff.
107	  - constructor.
108	  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply (proj1 (Hiff X (bind_sub U))). assumption.
109	  - constructor; auto.
110	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
111	    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
112	    intros y b. simpl. split; intros [Heq | Hin].
113	    + left; assumption.
114	    + right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
115	    + left; assumption.
116	    + right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
117	  - constructor; auto.
118	  - constructor; auto.
119	  - constructor; auto.
120	  - constructor; auto.
121	Qed.
122	
123	Lemma binds_cons_app_iff : forall (E E' : env) X (T : binding) y (b : binding),
124	  binds y b (((X,T)::E') ++ ((X,T)::E)) <-> binds y b ((X,T)::(E'++E)).
125	Proof. intros. unfold binds. repeat rewrite in_app_iff. simpl. rewrite in_app_iff. tauto. Qed.
126	
127	Lemma wf_typ_weaken : forall (E : env) T,
128	  wf_typ E T -> forall (E' : env), wf_typ (E' ++ E) T.
129	Proof.
130	  intros E T H. induction H; intros E'.
131	  - constructor.
132	  - apply (wf_typ_var U (E' ++ E) X). apply binds_app_2. assumption.
133	  - constructor; auto.
134	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
135	    + auto.
136	    + intros X HX. eapply wf_typ_binds_iff.
137	      * apply (H1 X HX (((X, bind_sub T1) :: E'))).
138	      * apply binds_cons_app_iff.
139	  - constructor; auto.
140	  - constructor; auto.
141	  - constructor; auto.
142	  - constructor; auto.
143	Qed.
144	
145	Lemma wf_typ_weaken_cons1 : forall (E : env) X (b : binding) T,
146	  wf_typ E T -> wf_typ ((X,b)::E) T.
147	Proof. intros E X b T H. apply (wf_typ_weaken E T H ((X,b)::nil)). Qed.
148	
149	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
150	(* wf_env                                                           *)
151	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
152	
153	Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
154	  wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
155	Proof. intros E R H. induction H. assumption. assumption. Qed.
156	
157	Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_typ : forall (E : env) x T,
158	  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
159	Proof.
160	  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
161	  split; assumption.
162	Qed.
163	
164	Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_sub : forall (E : env) x T,
165	  wf_env (x ~ bind_sub T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
166	Proof.
167	  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
168	  split; assumption.
169	Qed.
170	
171	Lemma wf_env_binds_typ : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
172	  forall x T, binds x (bind_typ T) E -> wf_typ E T.
173	Proof.
174	  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
175	  - inversion Hy.
176	  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
177	    + inversion Heq.
178	    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
179	  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
180	    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
181	    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
182	Qed.
183	
184	Lemma wf_env_binds_sub : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
185	  forall x T, binds x (bind_sub T) E -> wf_typ E T.
186	Proof.
187	  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
188	  - inversion Hy.
189	  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
190	    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
191	    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
192	  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
193	    + inversion Heq.
194	    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
195	Qed.

197	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
198	(* Strengthening wf_typ                                              *)
199	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
200	
201	Lemma binds_cons_iff_lift : forall (E1 E2 : env) (Y : atom) (T : binding),
202	  (forall y b, binds y b E1 <-> binds y b E2) ->
203	  forall y b, binds y b ((Y,T)::E1) <-> binds y b ((Y,T)::E2).
204	Proof.
205	  intros E1 E2 Y T Hiff y b. simpl. split; intros [Hc|Hin].
206	  - left; assumption.
207	  - right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
208	  - left; assumption.
209	  - right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
210	Qed.
211	
212	Lemma binds_swap_cons : forall (E : env) X (T : binding) Y (U : binding) y b,
213	  binds y b ((X,T)::(Y,U)::E) <-> binds y b ((Y,U)::(X,T)::E).
214	Proof. intros. unfold binds. simpl. tauto. Qed.
215	
216	Lemma binds_cons_bind_typ_app : forall (E1 E2 : env) x V (Y : atom) (U : binding) y b,
217	  (forall z c, binds z c E1 <-> binds z c (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) ->
218	  (binds y b ((Y,U)::E1) <-> binds y b ((x, bind_typ V)::(Y,U)::E2)).
219	Proof.
220	  intros E1 E2 x V Y U y b Hiff.
221	  etransitivity.
222	  - apply (binds_cons_iff_lift E1 (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) Y U Hiff).
223	  - apply binds_swap_cons.
224	Qed.

226	Lemma wf_typ_remove_bind_typ : forall (E1 : env) T,
227	  wf_typ E1 T ->
228	  forall (E2 : env) x V,
229	    (forall y b, binds y b E1 <-> binds y b (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) ->
230	    x `notin` fv_typ T ->
231	    wf_typ E2 T.
232	Proof.
233	  intros E1 T H.
234	  induction H as [ E
235	                  | U E X Hb
236	                  | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
237	                  | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
238	                  | E T H1 IH1
239	                  | E T H1 IH1
240	                  | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
241	                  | E a T1 H1 IH1 ];
242	  intros E2 x V Hiff Hfv.
243	  - constructor.
244	  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X).
245	    apply (proj1 (Hiff X (bind_sub U))) in Hb.
246	    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
247	    + inversion Heq.
248	    + assumption.
249	  - constructor.
250	    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
251	      * assumption.
252	      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
253	    + apply IH2 with (x := x) (V := V).
254	      * assumption.
255	      * apply notin_union_2 in Hfv. assumption.
256	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{ x }}).
257	    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
258	      * assumption.
259	      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
260	    + intros Y HY.
261	      assert (HYL : Y `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
262	      assert (HYx : Y <> x).
263	      { assert (Hny : Y `notin` {{ x }}) by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; assumption).
264	        apply notin_singleton_1' in Hny. symmetry. exact Hny. }
265	      assert (HfvT2 : x `notin` fv_typ T2) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; assumption).
266	      assert (Hfvo : x `notin` fv_typ (open_tt T2 Y)).
267	      { apply fv_typ_open_tt_fvar; auto. }
268	      apply (IH0 Y HYL (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2) x V).
269	      * intros y b. eapply binds_cons_bind_typ_app. exact Hiff.
270	      * assumption.
271	  - constructor.
272	    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V); auto.
273	  - constructor.
274	    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V); auto.
275	  - constructor.
276	    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
277	      * assumption.
278	      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
279	    + apply IH2 with (x := x) (V := V).
280	      * assumption.
281	      * apply notin_union_2 in Hfv. assumption.
282	  - constructor.
283	    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V); auto.

328	Definition same_kinds (E1 E2 : env) : Prop :=
329	  forall X, (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1) <-> (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E2).
330	
331	Lemma same_kinds_refl : forall E, same_kinds E E.
332	Proof. intros. intros X. reflexivity. Qed.
333	
334	Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
335	  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U)::E2).
336	Proof.
337	  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
338	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
339	    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
340	    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
341	      exists V'. right. assumption.
342	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
343	    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
344	    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
345	      exists V'. right. assumption.
346	Qed.
347	
348	Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub_any : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
349	  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U')::E2).
350	Proof.
351	  intros E1 E2 X U U' Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
352	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
353	    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U'. left. reflexivity.
354	    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
355	      exists V'. right. assumption.
356	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
357	    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U. left. reflexivity.
358	    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
359	      exists V'. right. assumption.
360	Qed.
361	
362	Lemma same_kinds_cons_typ : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
363	  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_typ U)::E1) ((X, bind_typ U)::E2).
364	Proof.
365	  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
366	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
367	    + inversion Heq.
368	    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
369	      exists V'. right. assumption.
370	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
371	    + inversion Heq.
372	    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
373	      exists V'. right. assumption.
374	Qed.

376	Lemma wf_typ_kind : forall (E1 : env) T,
377	  wf_typ E1 T -> forall (E2 : env), same_kinds E1 E2 -> wf_typ E2 T.
378	Proof.
379	  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hsk.
380	  - constructor.
381	  - destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
382	    apply (wf_typ_var U' E2 X). assumption.
383	  - constructor; auto.
384	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
385	    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)). apply same_kinds_cons_sub. assumption.
386	  - constructor; auto.
387	  - constructor; auto.
388	  - constructor; auto.
389	  - constructor; auto.
390	Qed.

392	Lemma sub_wf_both : forall (E : env) S T, sub E S T ->
393	  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E T) /\
394	  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E S).
395	Proof.
396	  intros E S T H.
397	  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
398	                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
399	                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
400	                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
401	                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
402	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
403	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
404	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
405	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
406	                 | E0 T1 T2 HE0 HS1 HS2
407	                 | E0 T1 T2 HE0 HS1 HS2
408	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
409	                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
410	                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
411	                 | E0 T1 T2 HS1 HS2 Hsub IHsub ].
412	  - (* top *) split; intros HE Hx; [constructor | exact HS0].
413	  - (* refl tvar *) split; intros; assumption.
414	  - (* trans tvar *) split.
415	    + intros HE HS. destruct IHsub as [IH1 _].
416	      apply (IH1 HE). apply (wf_env_binds_sub _ HE X U Hb).
417	    + intros HE HT. apply (wf_typ_var U E0 X Hb).
418	  - (* arrow *) split.
419	    + intros HE HS. destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HS) as [HS1 HS2].
420	      destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b]. destruct IH2 as [IH2a _].
421	      apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IH1b | apply IH2a]; assumption.
422	    + intros HE HT. destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HT) as [HT1 HT2].
423	      destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. destruct IH2 as [_ IH2b].
424	      apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IH1a | apply IH2b]; assumption.
425	  - (* all *) split.
426	    + intros HE HS. destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HS) as [Ls [HS1 HS2]].
427	      assert (HT1 : wf_typ E0 T1).
428	      { destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b]. apply (IH1b HE HS1). }
429	      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L0 `union` Ls `union` dom E0).
430	      * exact HT1.
431	      * intros X HX.
432	        assert (HXL0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
433	        assert (HXLs : X `notin` Ls) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
434	        assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
435	        assert (Hwe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0)).
436	        { apply (wf_env_sub E0 X T1); auto. }
437	        assert (Hws0 : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub S1 ++ E0) (open_tt S2 X)).
438	        { apply HS2. assumption. }
439	        assert (Hws : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_tt S2 X)).
440	        { eapply wf_typ_kind.
441	          - exact Hws0.
442	          - intros Y. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply same_kinds_refl. }
443	        destruct (IH0 X HXL0) as [IH0a _]. apply (IH0a Hwe Hws).
444	    + intros HE HT. destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HT) as [Lt [HT1 HT2]].
445	      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L0 `union` Lt `union` dom E0).
446	      * destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. apply (IH1a HE HT1).
447	      * intros X HX.
448	        assert (HXL0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
449	        assert (HXLt : X `notin` Lt) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
450	        assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
451	        assert (Hwe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0)).
452	        { apply (wf_env_sub E0 X T1); auto. }
453	        assert (Hwt : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_tt T2 X)).
454	        { apply HT2. assumption. }
455	        destruct (IH0 X HXL0) as [_ IH0b].
456	        eapply wf_typ_kind.
457	        { apply (IH0b Hwe Hwt). }
458	        intros Y. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply same_kinds_refl.
459	  - (* box *) split.
460	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
461	      apply wf_typ_box. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS)].
462	    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
463	      apply wf_typ_box. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT)].
464	  - (* readonly *) split.
465	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
466	      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS)].
467	    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
468	      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)].
469	  - (* readonly mutable *) split.
470	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
471	      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IH1a; [exact HE | assumption].
472	    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
473	      apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)].
474	  - (* trans *) split.
475	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. destruct IH2 as [IH2a _].
476	      apply IH2a; [exact HE | apply IH1a; [exact HE | assumption]].
477	    + intros HE HT. destruct IH2 as [_ IH2b]. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
478	      apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply IH2b; [exact HE | assumption]].
479	  - (* inter left *) split.
480	    + intros HE HS. apply (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HS).
481	    + intros HE HT. apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
482	  - (* inter right *) split.
483	    + intros HE HS. apply (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HS)).
484	    + intros HE HT. apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
485	  - (* inter *) split.
486	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. destruct IH2 as [IH2a _].
487	      apply wf_typ_intersect; auto.
488	    + intros HE HT. destruct (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT) as [HT2 HT3].
489	      destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b]. apply (IH1b HE HT2).
490	  - (* record *) split.
491	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
492	      apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HS)].
493	    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
494	      apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)].
495	  - (* readonly record *) split.
496	    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
497	      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS))].
498	    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
499	      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT))].
500	  - (* denormalize *) split; intros; assumption.
501	Qed.

667	Lemma wf_typ_nf_gen : forall (E : env) T,
668	  wf_typ E T ->
669	  forall (E' : env), same_kinds E E' -> wf_typ E' (normal_form_typing T).
670	Proof.
671	  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hsk.
672	  - rewrite nf_top. constructor.
673	  - rewrite nf_fvar. destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
674	    apply (wf_typ_var U' E' X). assumption.
675	  - rewrite nf_arrow. constructor; auto.
676	  - rewrite nf_all. apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
677	    + apply IHwf_typ. assumption.

881	                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
882	                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub

892	                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2

900	    assert (HS1 : wf_typ E0 S1) by apply (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HS)).
901	    assert (HS2 : wf_typ E0 S2) by apply (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HS)).
902	    repeat split; auto; try apply arr_comp_arrow.
903	  - (* all *) inversion Hac.
904	  - (* box *) inversion Hac.
905	  - (* readonly *) inversion Hac; subst.
906	    + assert (Hacf : ArrComp X A B) by apply arr_comp_fvar.
907	      destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A B HA HB Hacf)
908	        as [A' [B' [HA' [HB' [Hac' [HA'' HB'']]]]]].
909	      exists A', B'. repeat split; auto. apply arr_comp_mut. assumption.

911	        as [A' [B' [HA' [HB' [Hac' [HA'' HB'']]]]]].

686	      red (exp_seal e1) s1 (exp_seal e1') s1'
687	  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
688	      well_formed_store s1 ->
689	      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
690	      red (exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) s1 (exp_abs T e1) s1
691	  | red_seal_tabs : forall T e1 s1,
692	      well_formed_store s1 ->
693	      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
694	      red (exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) s1 (exp_tabs T e1) s1
695	  | red_seal_sealed_ref: forall l s1,

698	  | red_seal_sealed_record : forall r s1,
699	      well_formed_store s1 ->
