  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
Proof.
  intros T m A H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_box.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.

  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H3).
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst. exists A. repeat split; auto; apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H3)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].

From D Require Import Dev.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws Hwt Hnot IH];
    intro Hb.
  - (* empty signature *)
    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
    + apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws Hwt Hnot IH].
  - constructor.
  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
  wf_sig E R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (apply wf_sig_uniq; exact Hws).
  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique _ _ _ _ _ Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 2. Domination lemmas for signature concatenation                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma sig_dom_app : forall (R1 R2 : sig) (l : label),
  l `in` Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2) <->
  l `in` Signatures.dom R1 \/ l `in` Signatures.dom R2.
Proof.
  intros R1 R2 l.
  pose proof (Signatures.dom_app (A := signature) R1 R2) as Heq.
  rewrite (proj1 (LabelSetFacts.In_m eq_refl Heq)).
  apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sig_cons : forall (R : sig) (l0 : label) (T0 : typ)
                              (l : label) (T : typ),
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) (l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R) <->
  (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros. apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_app : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig),
  wf_sig E R1 -> wf_sig E R2 ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R1 ->
      ~ (l `in` Signatures.dom R2)) ->
  wf_sig E (R1 ++ R2).
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 H1.
  induction H1 as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws Hwt Hnot IH];
    intros H2 Hdisj.
  - simpl. exact H2.
  - change (wf_sig E ((l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0) ++ R2)).
    simpl. apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IH.
      * exact H2.
      * intros l T Hb. apply Hdisj. apply Signatures.binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
    + exact Hwt.
    + intro Hin. apply (proj1 (sig_dom_app R0 R2 l0)) in Hin.
      destruct Hin as [Hin1 | Hin2].
      * exact (Hnot Hin1).
      * apply (Hdisj l0 T0). apply Signatures.binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 3. Fresh label properties                                         *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma InA_eq_key_elt_fst : forall (p : label * exp)
                                  (l : list (label * exp)),
  InA (LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt (elt := exp)) p l ->
  In (fst p) (List.map fst l).
Proof.
  intros p l H. induction H as [x y l0 HR | x y l0 HR IH].
  - unfold LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt in HR. simpl in HR.
    destruct HR as [Hfst _]. simpl. left. exact Hfst.
  - simpl. right. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_not_maps : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp),
  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> False.
Proof.
  intros s l v Hfresh HMaps.
  apply LabelMapFacts.elements_mapsto_iff in HMaps.
  pose proof (InA_eq_key_elt_fst (l, v) (LabelMapImpl.elements s) HMaps) as Hin.
  pose proof (Label.fresh_not_in (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s))) as Hnot.
  unfold fresh_label_for_store in Hfresh.
  rewrite <- Hfresh in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_neq : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp) (l0 : label),
  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l0 v s -> l <> l0.
Proof.
  intros s l v l0 Hfresh HMaps Heq.
  subst l0.
  exact (fresh_label_not_maps s l v Hfresh HMaps).
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                (l : label) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
Proof.
  intros E R s l T Hts Hb.
  unfold typing_store in Hts.
  destruct (Hts l) as [Hfst _].
  destruct (Hfst T Hb) as [v [HMaps _]]. exists v. exact HMaps.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_notin_sig_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
                                        (s : store) (l : label),
  typing_store E R s ->
  l = fresh_label_for_store s ->
  ~ (l `in` Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hfresh Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [T Hb].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HMaps].
  apply (fresh_label_not_maps s l v).
  - symmetry. exact Hfresh.
  - exact HMaps.
Qed.
EOF

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
Proof.
  intros T m A H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H3); subst.
    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].

Qed.

  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - rewrite nf_fvar. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2).
    rewrite nf_box. exists (normal_form_typing A).
    repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box.
    + apply wf_typ_nf. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
    + apply to_nf_lem; auto.
    + apply of_nf_lem; auto.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    + rewrite nf_mut. rewrite nf_fvar. rewrite merge_fvar. exists A.
      repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_rofvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
    + destruct (IHT A HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
      rewrite nf_mut. exists A0. repeat split; auto.
      apply BoxComp_merge_fwd with (m := m). assumption.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - inversion Hac.
Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_src_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> BoxComp (normal_form_typing T) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
    exists T. split.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
    + split.
      * apply box_comp_box.
      * split.
        -- apply of_nf_lem; auto. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
        -- apply to_nf_lem; auto. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
  - rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
    destruct (BoxComp_merge_rev E (normal_form_typing T) m A HE
                (wf_typ_nf _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)) HA Hac)
      as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (IHT A1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA1 Hac1)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - rewrite nf_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
Qed.


Lemma BoxComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, BoxComp (typ_mut m T) A -> BoxComp T A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply box_comp_fvar. - assumption. Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_int_inv : forall X Y A, BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A -> BoxComp X A \/ BoxComp Y A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_box_inv : forall A B, BoxComp (typ_box A) B -> B = A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sub_boxcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall A, wf_typ E A -> BoxComp T A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp S A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
  intros A HA Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst. exists T1.
    split; [apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS)|].
    split.
    + apply box_comp_box.
    + split.
      * exact H2.
      * exact H1.
  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 [HA2' HA2'']]]].
    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - destruct (BoxComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - destruct (BoxComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    destruct (IHsub HE Hnf A0 HA0 Hac0) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (BoxComp_src_lift E0 T1 A1 HE HSd1 HA1 Hac1) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA0' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA'']].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA''' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1'' | exact HA0'']].
Qed.

Lemma sub_box_box : forall (E : env) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_box A) -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) HE HA Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HB) (box_comp_box B))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' [H1 H2]]]].
  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (BoxComp_box_inv _ _ Hac')).
  subst A'. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ArrComp_arrow_inv : forall A B X Y,
  ArrComp (typ_arrow A B) X Y -> X = A /\ Y = B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma sub_arrow_arrow : forall (E : env) A B C D,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow C D) ->
  sub E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) -> sub E C A /\ sub E B D.
Proof.
  intros E A B C D HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_arrcomp E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) HE HA Hsub C D
              (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HB)) (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HB))
              (arr_comp_arrow C D))
    as [X [Y [HX [HY [Hac [H1 H2]]]]]].
  destruct (ArrComp_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ Hac) as [HXA HYB].
  subst X. subst Y. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> forall l T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R H.
  induction H as [ E0 HE0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hpre IHpre HT Hnotin ]; intros l1 T1 Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hl HT'. subst. assumption.
    + apply (IHpre l1 T1). assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typing_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l S,
  typing E R (exp_ref l) S ->
  exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R /\ sub E (typ_box T) S.
Proof.
  intros E R l S H.
  remember (exp_ref l) as e eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    exists T0. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* typing_ref *) injection He as Hl. subst l0.
    exists T. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * assumption.
      * apply wf_typ_box. eapply wf_sig_binds; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_unbox_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l T,
  typing E R (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) T ->
  (exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\ sub E T0 T)
  \/
  (exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\
     sub E T0 (typ_mut mut_readonly T) /\ sub E T0 T).
Proof.
  intros E R l T H.
  remember (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [[T0 [Hb Hsub]] | [T0 [Hb [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    + left. exists T0. split; [assumption | eapply sub_trans; eauto].
    + right. exists T0. split; [assumption | split].
      * eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub1 | apply sub_readonly; exact H1].
      * eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub2 | exact H1].
  - (* typing_unbox *) injection He as He1. subst e.
    assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); assumption).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv _ _ _ _ H0) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    assert (Hws : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)).
    { apply wf_typ_box. apply (wf_sig_binds E R H l0 T0 Hb). }
    assert (Hwt : wf_typ E (typ_box T)).
    { apply (sub_wf_target E (typ_box T0) (typ_box T) HE Hws Hsub). }
    destruct (sub_box_box E T0 T HE Hws Hwt Hsub) as [H01 H10].
    left. exists T0. split; assumption.
  - (* typing_unbox_readonly *) injection He as He1. subst e.
    assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); assumption).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv _ _ _ _ H0) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    assert (Hws : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)).
    { apply wf_typ_box. apply (wf_sig_binds E R H l0 T0 Hb). }
    assert (Hwt : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T))).
    { apply (sub_wf_target E (typ_box T0) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) HE Hws Hsub). }
    assert (Hwtb : wf_typ E (typ_box T)).
    { apply wf_typ_inv_readonly. assumption. }
    destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_box T0) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T))
                HE Hws Hsub T (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ Hwtb)
                (box_comp_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T) T (box_comp_box T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [H1 H2]]]].
    assert (Heq : A' = T0) by (apply (BoxComp_box_inv _ _ Hac')).
    subst A'.
    right. exists T0. split; [assumption | split].
    + apply sub_readonly_mutable. assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hb.
  - (* empty signature *)
    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
    + apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot].
  - constructor.
  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
  wf_sig E R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (exact (wf_sig_uniq E R Hws)).
  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique signature l (bind_sig T1) (bind_sig T2) R
                Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 2. Domination lemmas for signature concatenation                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma sig_dom_app : forall (R1 R2 : sig) (l : label),
  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2)) <->
  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R1) \/ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2).
Proof.
  intros R1 R2 l.
  pose proof (@Signatures.dom_app signature R1 R2) as Heq.
  pose proof (@LabelSetFacts.In_m l l eq_refl
                (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2))
                (LabelSetImpl.union (Signatures.dom R1)
                                    (Signatures.dom R2)) Heq) as Hm.
  split; intro H.
  - apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. apply (proj1 Hm). exact H.
  - apply (proj2 Hm). apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sig_cons : forall (R : sig) (l0 : label) (T0 : typ)
                              (l : label) (T : typ),
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) (l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R) <->
  (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros.
  change (Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) ((l0, bind_sig T0) :: R) <->
          (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R).
  rewrite Signatures.binds_cons_iff.
  split; intro H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl Hs] | H].
    + left. split; auto. injection Hs as HT. exact HT.
    + right. exact H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl HT] | H].
    + left. split; auto. rewrite HT. reflexivity.
    + right. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_app : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig),
  wf_sig E R1 -> wf_sig E R2 ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R1 ->
      ~ (LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2))) ->
  wf_sig E (R1 ++ R2).
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 H1.
  induction H1 as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intros H2 Hdisj.
  - simpl. exact H2.
  - change (wf_sig E0 ((l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0) ++ R2)).
    simpl. apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IH.
      * exact H2.
      * intros l T Hb. apply (Hdisj l T).
        apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l T)). right. exact Hb.
    + exact Hwt.
    + intro Hin. apply (proj1 (sig_dom_app R0 R2 l0)) in Hin.
      destruct Hin as [Hin1 | Hin2].
      * exact (Hnot Hin1).
      * apply (Hdisj l0 T0).
        apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l0 T0)). left. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 3. Fresh label properties                                         *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma InA_eq_key_elt_fst : forall (p : label * exp)
                                  (l : list (label * exp)),
  InA (LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt (elt := exp)) p l ->
  In (fst p) (List.map fst l).
Proof.
  intros p l H. induction H as [x y l0 HR | x y l0 HR IH].
  - unfold LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt in HR. simpl in HR.
    destruct HR as [Hfst _]. simpl. left. exact Hfst.
  - simpl. right. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_not_maps : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp),
  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> False.
Proof.
  intros s l v Hfresh HMaps.
  apply LabelMapFacts.elements_mapsto_iff in HMaps.
  pose proof (InA_eq_key_elt_fst (l, v) (LabelMapImpl.elements s) HMaps) as Hin.
  pose proof (Label.fresh_not_in (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s))) as Hnot.
  unfold fresh_label_for_store in Hfresh.
  rewrite <- Hfresh in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_neq : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp) (l0 : label),
  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l0 v s -> l <> l0.
Proof.
  intros s l v l0 Hfresh HMaps Heq.
  subst l0.
  exact (fresh_label_not_maps s l v Hfresh HMaps).
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                (l : label) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
Proof.
  intros E R s l T Hts Hb.
  unfold typing_store in Hts.
  destruct (Hts l) as [Hfst _].
  destruct (Hfst T Hb) as [v [HMaps _]]. exists v. exact HMaps.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_notin_sig_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
                                        (s : store) (l : label),
  typing_store E R s ->
  l = fresh_label_for_store s ->
  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hfresh Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [T Hb].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HMaps].
  apply (fresh_label_not_maps s l v).
  - symmetry. exact Hfresh.
  - exact HMaps.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Auxiliary: typing entails well-formedness of the signature       *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_wf_sig_mut : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R
with typing_record_wf_sig_mut : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_sig E R.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T Hty. induction Hty; eauto.
  - intros E R r T Htr. induction Htr; eauto.
Qed.

(* Extending the environment with one binding preserves a wf signature. *)
Lemma wf_sig_env_weaken_cons : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
                                     (X : atom) (b : binding),
  wf_sig E R -> wf_env (X ~ b ++ E) -> wf_sig (X ~ b ++ E) R.
Proof.
  intros E R X b Hws Hwe. revert Hwe.
  induction Hws as [E0 Hwe0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws0 IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hwe'.
  - apply wf_sig_empty. exact Hwe'.
  - apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IH. exact Hwe'.
    + apply wf_typ_weaken_cons1. exact Hwt.
    + exact Hnot.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Signature weakening for typing                                   *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_sig_weaken_mut : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T ->
  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T
with typing_record_sig_weaken_mut :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing_record_comp E R r T ->
  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing_record_comp E (R2 ++ R) r T.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T Hty.
    induction Hty as
      [ E R x T Hwe Hws Hbind
      | L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E R e1 e2 T2 Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2
      | L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E R e1 T T2 Hws Hbody IH Hsub
      | S E R e T Hws Hbody IH Hsub
      | L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2
      | E R e T Hws Hbody IH
      | E R e T Hws Hbody IH
      | E R e1 e2 T Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2
      | E R l T Hwe Hws Hbind
      | E R e T Hbody IH
      | E R e T Hbody IH
      | E R r T Hrecord IHrecord
      | E R e a T Hbody IH
      | E R e a T Hbody IH
      | E R e1 a e2 T Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 ];
      intros R2 Hws'.
    + apply (typing_var E (R2 ++ R) x T Hwe Hws' Hbind).
    + apply (typing_abs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
      intros x Hx.
      apply (IHbody x Hx R2).
      apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ V) Hws').
      apply wf_sig_wf_env.
      apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1).
      apply Hbody. exact Hx.
    + apply (typing_app T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T2 Hws'
                (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_tabs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
      intros X HX.
      apply (IHbody X HX R2).
      apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) X (bind_sub V) Hws').
      apply wf_sig_wf_env.
      apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R
                (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)).
      apply Hbody. exact HX.
    + apply (typing_tapp T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 T T2 Hws'
                (IH R2 Hws') Hsub).
    + apply (typing_sub S E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws') Hsub).
    + apply (typing_let L T1 T2 e1 e2 E (R2 ++ R) Hws' (IH1 R2 Hws')).
      intros x Hx.
      apply (IH2 x Hx R2).
      apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ T1) Hws').
      apply wf_sig_wf_env.
      apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2).
      apply Hbody2. exact Hx.
    + apply (typing_box E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_unbox E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_set_box E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T Hws'
                (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_ref E (R2 ++ R) l T Hwe Hws').
      apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hbind.
    + apply (typing_seal E (R2 ++ R) e T (IH R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_unbox_readonly E (R2 ++ R) e T (IH R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_record E (R2 ++ R) r T (IHrecord R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_record_read E (R2 ++ R) e a T (IH R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_record_read_readonly E (R2 ++ R) e a T (IH R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_record_write E (R2 ++ R) e1 a e2 T (IH1 R2 Hws')
                (IH2 R2 Hws')).
  - intros E R r T Htr.
    induction Htr as
      [ E R Hwe Hws
      | E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hrec IHrec Hbody IHbody
      | E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hrec IHrec Hbind ];
      intros R2 Hws'.
    + apply (typing_record_empty E (R2 ++ R) Hwe Hws').
    + apply (typing_record_exp E (R2 ++ R) a e r T Tr Hnd
                (IHrec R2 Hws') (IHbody R2 Hws')).
    + apply (typing_record_ref E (R2 ++ R) a l r T Tr Hnd
                (IHrec R2 Hws')).
      apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hbind.
Qed.
EOF

From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Type substitution for the locally nameless System F<: variant     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Substitute the free type variable X by U in T.  Because type      *)
(* binders are de Bruijn indices there is no capture problem.        *)
Fixpoint subst_tt (X : atom) (U T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar Y => if (Y === X) then U else typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
  | typ_box T1 => typ_box (subst_tt X U T1)
  | typ_mut M T1 => typ_mut M (subst_tt X U T1)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (subst_tt X U T1)
  end.

(* Apply subst_tt to every type annotation of an expression.         *)
Fixpoint subst_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te X U e1) (subst_tt X U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (subst_te X U b) (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (subst_te_record X U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (subst_te X U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (subst_te X U e1) a (subst_te X U e2)
  end
with subst_te_record (X : atom) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (subst_te X U e) (subst_te_record X U r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (subst_te_record X U r)
  end.

(* Apply subst_tt to the type of a binding, preserving its kind.     *)
Definition subst_binding (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt X U T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt X U T)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tt_env (X : atom) (U : typ) (E : env) {struct E} : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, b) :: E' => (x, subst_binding X U b) :: subst_tt_env X U E'
  end.

(* Free type-variable atoms occurring in the type annotations of an  *)
(* expression / record component.                                    *)
Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => {}
  | exp_fvar _ => {}
  | exp_abs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_te e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => fv_te e1 `union` fv_te e2
  | exp_tabs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_te e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => fv_te e1 `union` fv_typ V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => fv_te e1 `union` fv_te e2
  | exp_box e => fv_te e
  | exp_unbox e => fv_te e
  | exp_set_box b e => fv_te b `union` fv_te e
  | exp_ref _ => {}
  | exp_seal e => fv_te e
  | exp_record r => fv_te_record r
  | exp_record_read e _ => fv_te e
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => fv_te e1 `union` fv_te e2
  end
with fv_te_record (r : rec_comp) : atoms :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => {}
  | rec_exp _ e r => fv_te e `union` fv_te_record r
  | rec_ref _ _ r => fv_te_record r
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Simple commutation / identity facts                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_eq : forall (X : atom) U,
  subst_tt X U (typ_fvar X) = U.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (X === X) as [Heq|Hneq]; auto. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_neq : forall (X Y : atom) U,
  Y <> X -> subst_tt X U (typ_fvar Y) = typ_fvar Y.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (Y === X) as [Heq|Hneq]; auto.
  exfalso. apply Hneq. symmetry. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_id : forall (X : atom) U T,
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> subst_tt X U T = T.
Proof.
  intros X U T. induction T; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst a. exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X H). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H0.
    rewrite (IHT1 H). rewrite (IHT2 H0). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H0.
    rewrite (IHT1 H). rewrite (IHT2 H0). reflexivity.
  - apply IHT. assumption.
  - apply IHT. assumption.
  - apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H0.
    rewrite (IHT1 H). rewrite (IHT2 H0). reflexivity.
  - apply IHT. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_bvar : forall (X : atom) U J,
  subst_tt X U (typ_bvar J) = typ_bvar J.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* A syntactic closedness predicate sufficient for all the opening   *)
(* commutations below.                                               *)
Fixpoint no_bvar (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar _ => False
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => no_bvar T1 /\ no_bvar T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => no_bvar T1 /\ no_bvar T2
  | typ_box T1 => no_bvar T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => no_bvar T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => no_bvar T1 /\ no_bvar T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => no_bvar T1
  end.

Lemma no_bvar_open_tt : forall (V : typ), no_bvar V ->
  forall K (Y : atom), open_tt_rec K Y V = V.
Proof.
  intros V H. induction H; intros K Y; simpl; auto.
  - (* bvar: no_bvar false *) destruct H.
  - rewrite (IHno_bvar1 K Y). rewrite (IHno_bvar2 K Y). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHno_bvar1 K Y). rewrite (IHno_bvar2 K Y). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHno_bvar K Y). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHno_bvar K Y). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHno_bvar1 K Y). rewrite (IHno_bvar2 K Y). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHno_bvar K Y). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Opening and substitution commute (both directions)                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma open_tt_rec_subst_comm : forall K (T : typ) (X : atom) (V : typ) (Y : atom),
  no_bvar V -> Y <> X ->
  open_tt_rec K Y (subst_tt X V T) = subst_tt X V (open_tt_rec K Y T).
Proof.
  intros K T. induction T; intros X V Y Hb Hneq; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K == n) eqn:E.
    + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_neq; [reflexivity | assumption].
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq'].
    + subst a. rewrite (no_bvar_open_tt V Hb K Y). reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_neq; [reflexivity | assumption].
  - rewrite IHT1; auto. rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT1; auto. rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - rewrite IHT1; auto. rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
Qed.

(* Substuting T for the opened variable and also substituting inside T. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_subst2 : forall K (T2 : typ) (X : atom) (V : typ) (T : typ),
  no_bvar V ->
  subst_tt X V (open_tt_rec K T T2)
  = open_tt_rec K (subst_tt X V T) (subst_tt X V T2).
Proof.
  intros K T2. induction T2; intros X V T Hb; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E; reflexivity.
  - destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst a. rewrite (no_bvar_open_tt V Hb K (subst_tt X V T)). reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_neq; [reflexivity | assumption].
  - rewrite IHT2_1; auto. rewrite IHT2_2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2_1; auto. rewrite IHT2_2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2_1; auto. rewrite IHT2_2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_subst_tt : forall (T : typ) (X : atom) U,
  X `notin` fv_typ T ->
  open_tt T U = subst_tt X U (open_tt T X).
Proof.
  intros. apply open_tt_rec_subst_comm_typ.
Qed.

(* The type-level version of the requested open/subst identity.      *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_subst_tt : forall K (T : typ) (X : atom) U,
  X `notin` fv_typ T ->
  open_tt_rec K U T = subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K X T).
Proof.
  intros K T. induction T; intros X U H; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E.
    + simpl. rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst a. exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X H). reflexivity.
    + simpl. rewrite subst_tt_fvar_neq; [reflexivity | assumption].
  - apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H0.
    rewrite (IHT1 X U H). rewrite (IHT2 X U H0). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H0.
    rewrite (IHT1 X U H). rewrite (IHT2 X U H0). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT X U H). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT X U H). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H0.
    rewrite (IHT1 X U H). rewrite (IHT2 X U H0). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT X U H). reflexivity.
Qed.

  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)

  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)

  | exp_unbox e1 => exp_unbox (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => exp_set_box (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l

Fixpoint fv_exp (e : exp) : atoms :=

  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_exp e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_exp e2
  | exp_tabs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_exp e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_typ V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_exp e2
  | exp_box e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_exp e2
  | exp_ref _ => {}
  | exp_seal e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_record r => fv_rec_comp r
  | exp_record_read e1 a => fv_exp e1 `union` {{ a }}
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` {{ a }} `union` fv_exp e2

  match r with
  | rec_empty => {}
  | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` fv_exp e `union` fv_rec_comp r
  | rec_ref a _ r => {{ a }} `union` fv_rec_comp r

  x `notin` fv_exp e ->

  unfold open_ee.
  rewrite subst_ee_open_ee_rec.
  rewrite subst_ee_eq_fvar.
  rewrite subst_ee_fv; [reflexivity|assumption].

  rewrite subst_ee_open_ee_rec.
  rewrite subst_ee_eq_fvar.
  rewrite subst_ee_fv; [reflexivity|assumption].

  | rc_int_l : forall X Y A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | rc_int_r : forall X Y A, RComp Y A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | rc_mut : forall m X A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma RComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, RComp (typ_mut m T) A -> RComp T A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply rc_fvar. - assumption. Qed.

Lemma RComp_int_inv : forall X Y A, RComp (typ_int X Y) A -> RComp X A \/ RComp Y A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.

Lemma RComp_record_inv : forall A B, RComp (typ_record a A) B -> B = A.

Lemma RComp_mut_record_inv : forall m a0 T A,
  RComp (typ_mut m (typ_record a0 T)) A -> A = T /\ a0 = a.

  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply rc_rofvar.

Lemma typing_sig_weaken : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T ->
  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T Hty R2 Hws.
  exact (typing_sig_weaken_aux E R e T Hty R2 Hws).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Store lemmas                                                     *)
(* ================================================================ *)

(* A label absent from the store cannot be bound by the signature. *)
Lemma typing_store_notin_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                      (l : label),
  typing_store E R s ->
  (forall v, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hnot Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HM].
  exact (Hnot v HM).
Qed.

(* Generic signature extension for store typings: [R2] is a prefix of
   new bindings, and the caller exhibits a typed store entry for every
   binding in [R2].  Bindings already in [R1] keep their entries, whose
   typings are weakened using [typing_sig_weaken]. *)
Lemma typing_store_mono_sig : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig) (s : store),
  wf_sig E (R2 ++ R1) ->
  typing_store E R1 s ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R2 ->
      exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s /\
                typing E (R2 ++ R1) v T /\ value v) ->
  typing_store E (R2 ++ R1) s.
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 s Hws Hts Hext.
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb.
    apply Signatures.binds_app_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Hb2 | Hb1].
    + exact (Hext l0 T0 Hb2).
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v [HM [Hty Hval]]].
      exists v. split; [exact HM |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
      * exact Hval.
  - intros v HM.
    destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
    destruct (Hg v HM) as [T0 [Hval [Hty Hb]]].
    exists T0. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
    + exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
    + exact (Signatures.binds_app_3 signature l0 (bind_sig T0) R2 R1 Hb).
Qed.

(* Add one fresh label/entry, extending the signature with its type.
   [wf_typ E T] is genuinely needed: [typing] does not imply [wf_typ]
   (e.g. [typing_abs] accepts an arbitrary annotation), while [wf_sig_typ]
   does require it.  The absence of [l] from the store is what lets us
   derive [l] notin dom R, so no separate disjointness hypothesis is
   needed. *)
Lemma typing_store_add : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  wf_typ E T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  (forall v0, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v0 s) ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hwt Hts Hfresh Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  assert (Hnot : ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R)) by
    (apply (typing_store_notin_dom E R s l Hts); exact Hfresh).
  assert (Hwf : wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R)) by
    (apply wf_sig_typ; [exact Hws | exact Hwt | exact Hnot]).
  apply (typing_store_mono_sig E R (l ~ bind_sig T)
           (LabelMapImpl.add l v s) Hwf Hts).
  intros l0 T0 Hb.
  change (Signatures.binds l0 (bind_sig T0) ((l, bind_sig T) :: nil)) in Hb.
  apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [[Hl HS] | Hb0].
  - injection HS as HT. subst l0. subst T0.
    exists v. split.
    + apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
    + split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
      * exact Hval.
  - simpl in Hb0. inversion Hb0.
Qed.

(* Replace/insert the store entry at an already-bound label.  The type
   is forced by the signature (using well-formedness/uniqueness of
   bindings), so the new value simply has to inhabit that type. *)
Lemma typing_store_update : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                   (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hts Hb Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb0.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst l0.
      assert (HT : T0 = T) by
        (exact (wf_sig_binds_uniq E R l T0 T Hws Hb0 Hb)).
      subst T0.
      exists v. split.
      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
      * split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb0) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
      exists v0. split.
      * exact (proj2 (LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff (elt := exp)
                       s l l0 v v0 Hneq) HM).
      * split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hval0].
  - intros v0 HM.
    apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff in HM.
    destruct HM as [[Heq Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
    + subst l0. subst v0.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split; [exact Hty | exact Hb].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hb0].
Qed.

record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Inductive signature : Set :=
  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_mut M T =>
        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
    end.

From D Require Import Dev.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Term-variable substitution                                    *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Fixpoint subst_ee (x : atom) (v e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => if x === y then v else exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee x v e1) V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_box e1 => exp_box (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_unbox e1 => exp_unbox (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => exp_set_box (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e1 => exp_seal (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r)
  | exp_record_read e1 a => exp_record_read (subst_ee x v e1) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (subst_ee x v e1) a (subst_ee x v e2)
  end
with subst_ee_rec_comp (x : atom) (v : exp) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (subst_ee x v e) (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r)
  end.

Lemma subst_ee_eq_fvar : forall x v,
  subst_ee x v (exp_fvar x) = v.
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  destruct (x === x) eqn:E; [reflexivity|].
  exfalso. apply n. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ee_neq_fvar : forall x y v,
  y <> x -> subst_ee x v (exp_fvar y) = exp_fvar y.
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  destruct (x === y) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
  exfalso. apply H. symmetry. assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 2. Free atoms of an expression                                   *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Fixpoint fv_exp (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_exp e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_exp e2
  | exp_tabs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_exp e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_typ V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_exp e2
  | exp_box e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` fv_exp e2
  | exp_ref _ => {}
  | exp_seal e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_record r => fv_rec_comp r
  | exp_record_read e1 a => fv_exp e1 `union` {{ a }}
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => fv_exp e1 `union` {{ a }} `union` fv_exp e2
  end
with fv_rec_comp (r : rec_comp) : atoms :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => {}
  | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` fv_exp e `union` fv_rec_comp r
  | rec_ref a _ r => {{ a }} `union` fv_rec_comp r
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2a. Substitution removes nothing when the variable is not free     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint subst_ee_fv (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall x v, x `notin` fv_exp e -> subst_ee x v e = e :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => fun x v _ => eq_refl
  | exp_fvar y =>
      fun x v H => subst_ee_neq_fvar x y v (notin_singleton_1' y x H)
  | exp_abs V e1 =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_abs V z)
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_2 x (fv_typ V) (fv_exp e1) H))
  | exp_app e1 e2 =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal2 exp_app
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_1 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2) H))
          (subst_ee_fv e2 x v (notin_union_2 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2) H))
  | exp_tabs V e1 =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_tabs V z)
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_2 x (fv_typ V) (fv_exp e1) H))
  | exp_tapp e1 V =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_tapp z V)
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_1 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_typ V) H))
  | exp_let e1 e2 =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal2 exp_let
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_1 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2) H))
          (subst_ee_fv e2 x v (notin_union_2 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2) H))
  | exp_box e1 =>
      fun x v H => f_equal exp_box (subst_ee_fv e1 x v H)
  | exp_unbox e1 =>
      fun x v H => f_equal exp_unbox (subst_ee_fv e1 x v H)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal2 exp_set_box
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_1 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2) H))
          (subst_ee_fv e2 x v (notin_union_2 x (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2) H))
  | exp_ref l => fun x v _ => eq_refl
  | exp_seal e1 =>
      fun x v H => f_equal exp_seal (subst_ee_fv e1 x v H)
  | exp_record r =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal exp_record (subst_ee_rec_fv r x v H)
  | exp_record_read e1 a =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_record_read z a)
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v (notin_union_1 x (fv_exp e1) {{ a }} H))
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal2 (fun z w => exp_record_write z a w)
          (subst_ee_fv e1 x v
             (notin_union_1 x (fv_exp e1 `union` {{ a }}) (fv_exp e2) H))
          (subst_ee_fv e2 x v
             (notin_union_2 x (fv_exp e1 `union` {{ a }}) (fv_exp e2) H))
  end
with subst_ee_rec_fv (r : rec_comp) {struct r} :
  forall x v, x `notin` fv_rec_comp r -> subst_ee_rec_comp x v r = r :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => fun x v _ => eq_refl
  | rec_exp a e r =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal2 (fun z w => rec_exp a z w)
          (subst_ee_fv e x v
             (notin_union_2 x ({{ a }} `union` fv_exp e) (fv_rec_comp r)
                (notin_union_1 x ({{ a }} `union` fv_exp e) (fv_rec_comp r) H)))
          (subst_ee_rec_fv r x v
             (notin_union_2 x ({{ a }} `union` fv_exp e) (fv_rec_comp r)
                (notin_union_2 x ({{ a }} `union` fv_exp e) (fv_rec_comp r) H)))
  | rec_ref a l r =>
      fun x v H =>
        f_equal (fun z => rec_ref a l z)
          (subst_ee_rec_fv r x v
             (notin_union_2 x ({{ a }}) (fv_rec_comp r) H))
  end.

Lemma subst_ee_fv_apply : forall e x v,
  x `notin` fv_exp e -> subst_ee x v e = e.
Proof. intros. apply (subst_ee_fv e). assumption. Qed.

Lemma subst_ee_rec_fv_apply : forall r x v,
  x `notin` fv_rec_comp r -> subst_ee_rec_comp x v r = r.
Proof. intros. apply (subst_ee_rec_fv r). assumption. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2b. Commutation of subst_ee with open_ee                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subst_ee_open_ee_bvar : forall x v k w i,
  subst_ee x v (open_ee_rec k w (exp_bvar i))
  = open_ee_rec k (subst_ee x v w) (subst_ee x v (exp_bvar i)).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (k == i); reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_ee_open_ee (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall x v k w,
    subst_ee x v (open_ee_rec k w e)
    = open_ee_rec k (subst_ee x v w) (subst_ee x v e) :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => fun x v k w => subst_ee_open_ee_bvar x v k w i
  | exp_fvar y => fun x v k w => eq_refl
  | exp_abs V e1 =>
      fun x v k w =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_abs V z)

(* Generic signature extension for store typings: [R2] is a prefix of
   new bindings, and the caller exhibits a typed store entry for every
   binding in [R2].  Bindings already in [R1] keep their entries, whose
   typings are weakened using [typing_sig_weaken]. *)
Lemma typing_store_mono_sig : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig) (s : store),
  wf_sig E (R2 ++ R1) ->
  typing_store E R1 s ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R2 ->
      exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s /\
                typing E (R2 ++ R1) v T /\ value v) ->
  typing_store E (R2 ++ R1) s.
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 s Hws Hts Hext.
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb.
    apply Signatures.binds_app_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Hb2 | Hb1].
    + exact (Hext l0 T0 Hb2).
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v [HM [Hty Hval]]].
      exists v. split; [exact HM |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
      * exact Hval.

    destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
    destruct (Hg v HM) as [T0 [Hval [Hty Hb]]].

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition same_kinds (E1 E2 : env) : Prop :=
  forall X, (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1) <-> (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E2).

Lemma same_kinds_refl : forall E, same_kinds E E.
Proof. intros. intros X. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub_any : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U')::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U U' Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U'. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_typ : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_typ U)::E1) ((X, bind_typ U)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_kind : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T -> forall (E2 : env), same_kinds E1 E2 -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hsk.
  - constructor.
  - destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
    apply (wf_typ_var U' E2 X). assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)). apply same_kinds_cons_sub. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_both : forall (E : env) S T, sub E S T ->
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E T) /\
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E S).
Proof.
Lemma sub_wf_both : forall (E : env) S T, sub E S T ->
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E T) /\
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E S).
Proof.
  intros E S T H.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HE0 HS1 HS2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HE0 HS1 HS2
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HS1 HS2 Hsub IHsub ].
  - (* top *) split; intros HE Hx; [constructor | exact HS0].
  - (* refl tvar *) split; intros; assumption.
  - (* trans tvar *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IHsub as [IH1 _].
      apply (IH1 HE). apply (wf_env_binds_sub _ HE X U Hb).
    + intros HE HT. apply (wf_typ_var U E0 X Hb).
  - (* arrow *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HS) as [HS1 HS2].
      destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b]. destruct IH2 as [IH2a _].
      apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IH1b | apply IH2a]; assumption.
    + intros HE HT. destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HT) as [HT1 HT2].
      destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. destruct IH2 as [_ IH2b].
      apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IH1a | apply IH2b]; assumption.
  - (* all *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HS) as [Ls [HS1 HS2]].
      assert (HT1 : wf_typ E0 T1).
      { destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b]. apply (IH1b HE HS1). }
      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L0 `union` Ls `union` dom E0).
      * exact HT1.
      * intros X HX.
        assert (HXL0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
        assert (HXLs : X `notin` Ls) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
        assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
        assert (Hwe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0)).
        { apply (wf_env_sub E0 X T1); auto. }
        assert (Hws0 : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub S1 ++ E0) (open_tt S2 X)).
        { apply HS2. assumption. }
        assert (Hws : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_tt S2 X)).
        { eapply wf_typ_kind.
          - exact Hws0.
          - intros Y. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply same_kinds_refl. }
        destruct (IH0 X HXL0) as [IH0a _]. apply (IH0a Hwe Hws).
    + intros HE HT. destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HT) as [Lt [HT1 HT2]].
      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L0 `union` Lt `union` dom E0).
      * destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. apply (IH1a HE HT1).
      * intros X HX.
        assert (HXL0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
        assert (HXLt : X `notin` Lt) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
        assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
        assert (Hwe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0)).
        { apply (wf_env_sub E0 X T1); auto. }
        assert (Hwt : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_tt T2 X)).
        { apply HT2. assumption. }
        destruct (IH0 X HXL0) as [_ IH0b].
        eapply wf_typ_kind.
        { apply (IH0b Hwe Hwt). }
        intros Y. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply same_kinds_refl.
  - (* box *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
      apply wf_typ_box. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS)].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply wf_typ_box. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT)].
  - (* readonly *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS)].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)].
  - (* readonly mutable *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IH1a; [exact HE | assumption].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)].
  - (* trans *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. destruct IH2 as [IH2a _].
      apply IH2a; [exact HE | apply IH1a; [exact HE | assumption]].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH2 as [_ IH2b]. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply IH2b; [exact HE | assumption]].
  - (* inter left *) split.
    + intros HE HS. apply (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HS).
    + intros HE HT. apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
  - (* inter right *) split.
    + intros HE HS. apply (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HS)).
    + intros HE HT. apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
  - (* inter *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _]. destruct IH2 as [IH2a _].
      apply wf_typ_intersect; auto.
    + intros HE HT. destruct (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT) as [HT2 HT3].
      destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b]. apply (IH1b HE HT2).
  - (* record *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
      apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HS)].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)].
  - (* readonly record *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS))].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT))].
  - (* denormalize *) split; intros; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_target : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E S T H1)); assumption. Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_source : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E S T -> wf_typ E S.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (sub_wf_both E S T H1)); assumption. Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork SubstTTSnap.

Lemma binds_remove_mid : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U Y b,
  Y <> X ->
  (binds Y b (E1 ++ (X, bind_sub U) :: E2) <-> binds Y b (E1 ++ E2)).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Z c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U Y b Hne; simpl.
  - split; intros Hz.
    + destruct Hz as [Heq | Hin].
      * inversion Heq. subst. contradiction.
      * assumption.
    + right. assumption.
  - split; intros Hz.
    + destruct Hz as [Heq | Hin].
      * left. assumption.
      * right. apply (proj1 (IH E2 X U Y b Hne)). assumption.
    + destruct Hz as [Heq | Hin].
      * left. assumption.
      * right. apply (proj2 (IH E2 X U Y b Hne)). assumption.
Qed.

Lemma no_bvar_wf : forall (E : env) T, wf_typ E T -> no_bvar T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; simpl.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - split; assumption.
  - split; assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - split; assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_tt_gen : forall (E1 : env) X U (E2 : env) T,
  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 ->
  wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) T ->
  forall V, no_bvar V -> wf_typ (E1 ++ E2) V ->
  wf_typ (E1 ++ E2) (subst_tt X V T).
Proof.
  intros E1 X U E2 T Hnd1 Hnd2 H.
  remember (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) as E0 eqn:He.
  revert E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2.
  induction H as [ E0
                 | U0 E0 Y Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ];
  intros E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV.
  - rewrite subst_tt_id. constructor.
    intros Hc. apply Hc.
  - subst E0. unfold subst_tt.
    destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec Y X) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst Y. rewrite e. assumption.
    + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_neq; auto.
      apply (wf_typ_var U0 (E1 ++ E2) Y).
      apply (proj1 (binds_remove_mid E1 E2 X U Y (bind_sub U0) Hneq)).
      assumption.
  - rewrite subst_tt_id; [| intros Hc; apply Hc].
    constructor.
    + apply (IH1 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
    + apply (IH2 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
  - subst E0. simpl.
    apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{ X }}).
    + apply (IH1 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (HYL : Y `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HYX : Y <> X).
      { assert (Hny : Y `notin` {{ X }}) by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; assumption).
        apply notin_singleton_1' in Hny. symmetry. exact Hny. }
      assert (HndY1 : X `notin` dom ((Y, bind_sub T1) :: E1)).
      { simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [Heq | Hin].
        - subst. contradiction.
        - assumption.
        - left; assumption.
        - right; assumption. }
      assert (HV' : wf_typ ((Y, bind_sub T1) :: E1 ++ E2) V).
      { apply wf_typ_weaken_cons1 with (X := Y) (b := bind_sub T1). assumption. }
      assert (Hbody : wf_typ ((Y, bind_sub T1) :: E1 ++ E2)
                (subst_tt X V (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) T2))).
      { apply (IH0 Y HYL ((Y, bind_sub T1) :: E1) X U E2).
        - rewrite He. reflexivity.
        - exact HndY1.
        - exact Hnd2.
        - exact Hnb.
        - exact HV'. }
      rewrite <- (open_tt_rec_subst_comm 0 T2 X V Y Hnb HYX).
      exact Hbody.
  - rewrite subst_tt_id; [| intros Hc; apply Hc].
    apply wf_typ_box. apply (IH1 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
  - rewrite subst_tt_id; [| intros Hc; apply Hc].
    apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IH1 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
  - rewrite subst_tt_id; [| intros Hc; apply Hc].
    apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply (IH1 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
    + apply (IH2 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
  - rewrite subst_tt_id; [| intros Hc; apply Hc].
    apply wf_typ_record. apply (IH1 E1 X U E2 He Hnd1 Hnd2 V Hnb HV).
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
  destruct (ArrComp_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ Hac) as [HXA HYB].
  subst X. subst Y. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> forall l T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R H.
  induction H as [ E0 HE0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hpre IHpre HT Hnotin ]; intros l1 T1 Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hl HT'. subst. assumption.
    + apply (IHpre l1 T1). assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typing_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l S,
  typing E R (exp_ref l) S ->
  exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R /\ sub E (typ_box T) S.
Proof.
  intros E R l S H.
  remember (exp_ref l) as e eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    exists T0. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* typing_ref *) injection He as Hl. subst l0.
    exists T. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * assumption.
      * apply wf_typ_box. eapply wf_sig_binds; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_wf_sig : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
  typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R
with typing_record_comp_wf_sig : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_sig E R.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T H. induction H; eauto.
  - intros E R r T H. induction H; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_unbox_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l T,
  typing E R (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) T ->
  exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\ sub E T0 T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H.
  remember (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    exists T0. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* typing_unbox *) injection He as He1. subst e.
    assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); apply (typing_wf_sig E R _ _ H0)).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv _ _ _ _ H0) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    assert (Hws : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)).
    { apply wf_typ_box. apply (wf_sig_binds E R H l0 T0 Hb). }
    assert (Hwt : wf_typ E (typ_box T)).
    { apply (sub_wf_target E (typ_box T0) (typ_box T) HE Hws Hsub). }
    destruct (sub_box_box E T0 T HE Hws Hwt Hsub) as [H01 H10].
    exists T0. split; assumption.
  - (* typing_unbox_readonly *) injection He as He1. subst e.
Proof.
  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HB) (rc_here a B))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' H1]]].
  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (RComp_record_inv _ _ _ Hac')).
  subst A'. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_type : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T -> type T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
  - apply type_all with (L := L); auto.
  - apply type_box; assumption.
  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
  - apply type_record; assumption.
Qed.
