Lemma sub_refl : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T T.
Proof.
  intros E T HE H. revert HE.
  induction H as [ E0
                 | U E0 X Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ]; intros HE.
  - apply sub_top; [assumption | constructor].
  - apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption | eapply wf_typ_var; eauto].
  - apply sub_arrow; auto.
  - apply (sub_all (L `union` dom E0) E0 T1 T2 T1 T2).
    + apply IH1; assumption.
    + intros X HX.
      apply (IH0 X).
      * apply notin_union_1 in HX. assumption.
      * apply (wf_env_sub E0 X T1); auto.
  - apply sub_box; [apply IH1; assumption | apply IH1; assumption].
  - apply sub_readonly; apply IH1; assumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply (sub_inter_left E0 T1 T2); assumption.
    + apply (sub_inter_right E0 T1 T2); assumption.
  - apply sub_record; [apply IH1; assumption | apply IH1; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma sub_to_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros. apply (sub_denormalize E T (normal_form_typing T)); auto.
  - apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_idem. apply sub_refl; auto. apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_of_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E (normal_form_typing T) T.
Proof.
  intros. apply (sub_denormalize E (normal_form_typing T) T); auto.
  - apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_idem. apply sub_refl; auto. apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_box T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  end.

Lemma fv_typ_open_tt : forall (T : typ) K (U : typ) X,
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X `notin` fv_typ U ->
  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K U T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros K U X HT HU; simpl in *.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E; simpl.
    + assumption.
    + auto.
  - auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_typ_open_tt_fvar : forall (T : typ) K (Y X : atom),
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X <> Y ->
  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T).
Proof.
  intros T K Y X HT HXY.
  assert (Hnot : X `notin` fv_typ (typ_fvar Y)).
  { simpl. apply notin_singleton. auto. }
  eapply fv_typ_open_tt; eauto.
Qed.

  | typ_top => True

  | typ_box T1 => lc_at d T1

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [H|H].
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [y b'] E IH]; intros x b Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - apply (in_dom_cons E x y b'). simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply (IH x b). assumption.
Qed.

  Y <> X ->
  binds Y b (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) ->
  binds Y b A \/ binds Y b E.
Proof.
  intros A E X U Y b Hne H. apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [HA | HXE].

    + assumption.

328	Definition same_kinds (E1 E2 : env) : Prop :=
329	  forall X, (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1) <-> (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E2).
330	
331	Lemma same_kinds_refl : forall E, same_kinds E E.
332	Proof. intros. intros X. reflexivity. Qed.
333	
334	Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
335	  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U)::E2).
336	Proof.
337	  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
338	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
339	    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
340	    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
341	      exists V'. right. assumption.
342	  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
343	    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
344	    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
345	      exists V'. right. assumption.
346	Qed.

9	(* Substitute the free type variable X by U in T.  Because type      *)
10	(* binders are de Bruijn indices there is no capture problem.        *)
11	Fixpoint subst_tt (X : atom) (U T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
12	  match T with
13	  | typ_top => typ_top
14	  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
15	  | typ_fvar Y => if (Y === X) then U else typ_fvar Y
16	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
17	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
18	  | typ_box T1 => typ_box (subst_tt X U T1)
19	  | typ_mut M T1 => typ_mut M (subst_tt X U T1)
20	  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
21	  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (subst_tt X U T1)
22	  end.
23	
24	(* Apply subst_tt to every type annotation of an expression.         *)
25	Fixpoint subst_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
26	  match e with
27	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
28	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
29	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
30	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
31	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
32	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te X U e1) (subst_tt X U V)
33	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
34	  | exp_box e => exp_box (subst_te X U e)
35	  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (subst_te X U e)
36	  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (subst_te X U b) (subst_te X U e)
37	  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
38	  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (subst_te X U e)
39	  | exp_record r => exp_record (subst_te_record X U r)
40	  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (subst_te X U e) a
41	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (subst_te X U e1) a (subst_te X U e2)

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top

===HEAD
From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Type substitution for the locally nameless System F<: variant     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Substitute the free type variable X by U in T.  Because type      *)
(* binders are de Bruijn indices there is no capture problem.        *)
Fixpoint subst_tt (X : atom) (U T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
===TAIL
  Y <> X ->
  binds Y b (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) ->
  binds Y b A \/ binds Y b E.
Proof.
  intros A E X U Y b Hne H. apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [HA | HXE].
  - left. assumption.
  - right. apply in_app_iff in HXE. destruct HXE as [HX | HE].
    + apply binds_cons_inv in HX. destruct HX as [Heq | Hin].
      * inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
      * inversion Hin.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_gen : forall (A : env) X U (E : env) T,
  X `notin` dom A ->
  X `notin` dom E ->
  wf_typ (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) T ->
  forall V, closed_typ V ->
    wf_typ (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) V ->
    wf_typ (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) (subst_tt X V T).
Proof.
  intros A X U E T HndA HndE H.
  remember (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) as E0 eqn:He.
  revert A E He HndA HndE.
  induction H as [ E0
                 | U0 E0 Y Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
                 | E0 T1 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ];
    intros A E He HndA HndE V Hclosed HV.
  - constructor.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfSubst TypeOpen2 SubstTTSnap.

Lemma typing_wf_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
  typing E R e T -> wf_typ E T
with typing_record_comp_wf_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T Hty. induction Hty as
      [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E0 R0 e1 e2 T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E0 R0 e1 T T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
      | S E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
      | L T1 T2 e1 e2 E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e1 e2 T Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
      | E0 R0 l T Hwe Hws Hb
      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 r T Hr IHr
      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e1 a e2 T H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ].
    + apply (wf_env_binds_typ _ Hwe x T0 Hb).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E0 `union` fv_typ T1)) as [x Hx].
      assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (HxE : x `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (HxT : x `notin` fv_typ T1) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; apply notin_union_2 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (Hwb : wf_typ (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) T1) by (apply IHbody; assumption).
      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0))
        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0);
            apply (typing_wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0 (open_ee e1 x) T1);
            apply Hbody; assumption).
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
      assert (HwT1 : wf_typ E0 T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_remove_bind_typ; eauto. intros y b; reflexivity. }
      apply wf_typ_arrow; assumption.
    + apply (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ IH1)).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E0)) as [X HX].
      assert (HXL : X `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HXE : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0))
        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0);
            apply (typing_wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0 (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X));
            apply Hbody; assumption).
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * exact HwV.
      * intros X0 HX0. apply IHbody. assumption.
    + destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ IH1) as [L0 [HwT1 Hwbody]].
      assert (Hwe : wf_env E0) by (apply wf_sig_wf_env with (R := R0); assumption).
      assert (HwT : wf_typ E0 T)
        by (apply (sub_wf_source E0 T T1 Hwe HwT1 Hsub)).
      destruct (atom_fresh (L0 `union` dom E0 `union` fv_typ T2)) as [X HX].
      assert (HXL0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HXE : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HXT2 : X `notin` fv_typ T2) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HbodyX : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_tt T2 X)) by (apply Hwbody; assumption).
      pose (Hres := wf_typ_subst_tt E0 X T1 (open_tt T2 X) HXE HbodyX T (wf_typ_type _ _ HwT) HwT).
      rewrite <- (open_tt_rec_subst_tt 0 T2 X T HXT2) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
    + apply (sub_wf_target E0 S T Hws IH1 Hsub).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fv_typ T2)) as [x Hx].
      assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (HxT : x `notin` fv_typ T2) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (Hwb : wf_typ (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E0) T2) by (apply IHbody; assumption).
      eapply wf_typ_remove_bind_typ; eauto. intros y b; reflexivity.
    + apply wf_typ_box; assumption.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ IH1).
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ IH1).
    + apply wf_typ_box. apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l T Hws Hb).
    + apply wf_typ_readonly; assumption.
    + apply wf_typ_readonly.
      apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ IH1)).
    + assumption.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ IH1).
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ IH1)).
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ IH1).
  - intros E R r T Htr. induction Htr as
      [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
      | E0 R0 a e r T Tr Hnotin Hr IHr He IHe
      | E0 R0 a l r T Tr Hnotin Hr IHr Hb ].
    + constructor.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect.
      * constructor. assumption.
      * assumption.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect.
      * constructor. apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l T Hws Hb).
      * assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_kind : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T -> forall (E2 : env), same_kinds E1 E2 -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hsk.
  - constructor.
  - destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
    apply (wf_typ_var U' E2 X). assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)). apply same_kinds_cons_sub. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_both : forall (E : env) S T, sub E S T ->
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E T) /\
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E S).
Proof.
  intros E S T H.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
  - (* readonly record *) split.
    + intros HE HS. destruct IH1 as [IH1a _].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1a; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS))].
    + intros HE HT. destruct IH1 as [_ IH1b].
      apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. apply IH1b; [exact HE | apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT))].
  - (* denormalize *) split; intros; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_target : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E S T H1)); assumption. Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_source : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E S T -> wf_typ E S.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (sub_wf_both E S T H1)); assumption. Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
Proof.
  intros T m A H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H3); subst.
    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].

Fixpoint no_bvar (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar _ => False
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => no_bvar T1 /\ no_bvar T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => no_bvar T1 /\ no_bvar T2
  | typ_box T1 => no_bvar T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => no_bvar T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => no_bvar T1 /\ no_bvar T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => no_bvar T1
  end.

Lemma no_bvar_open_tt : forall (V : typ), no_bvar V ->
  forall K (U : typ), open_tt_rec K U V = V.
Proof.
  intros V. induction V; intros H K Y; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHV1 H1). rewrite (IHV2 H2). reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHV1 H1). rewrite (IHV2 H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHV H). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHV H). reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHV1 H1). rewrite (IHV2 H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHV H). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Locally closed types: `type` is the right closedness condition.    *)
(* It permits bound de Bruijn variables but no free ones, which is     *)
(* exactly what is needed for opening to leave a type unchanged.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition closed_typ (T : typ) : Prop :=
  forall K (U : typ), open_tt_rec K U T = T.

Fixpoint lc_at (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_at d T1 /\ lc_at d T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => lc_at d T1 /\ lc_at (S d) T2
  | typ_box T1 => lc_at d T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => lc_at d T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => lc_at d T1 /\ lc_at d T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => lc_at d T1
  end.

Lemma lc_at_open_iff : forall (T : typ) K Y,
  lc_at K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T) <-> lc_at (S K) T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros K Y; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (K == n) as [e|Hne]; simpl.
    + subst n. split; intros; [lia | exact I].
    + split; intros; lia.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHT. tauto.
  - rewrite IHT. tauto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHT. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_lc : forall (T : typ), type T -> lc_at 0 T.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H as [ | X
    | T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | L T1 T2 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
    | T H1 IH1
    | T H1 IH1
    | T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | a T1 H1 IH1 ].
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. split.
    + exact IH1.
    + destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
      exact (proj1 (lc_at_open_iff T2 0 X) (IHbody X HX)).
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_open_id : forall (T : typ) d, lc_at d T ->
  forall K (U : typ), d <= K -> open_tt_rec K U T = T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros d Hc K U HK; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Hc as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHT1 d H1 K U HK). rewrite (IHT2 d H2 K U HK). reflexivity.
  - destruct Hc as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHT1 d H1 K U HK).
    rewrite (IHT2 (S d) H2 (S K) U ltac:(lia)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT d Hc K U HK). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT d Hc K U HK). reflexivity.
  - destruct Hc as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHT1 d H1 K U HK). rewrite (IHT2 d H2 K U HK). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT d Hc K U HK). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_closed : forall T, lc_at 0 T -> closed_typ T.
Proof. intros T H K U. apply (lc_at_open_id T 0 H K U). lia. Qed.

Lemma type_closed : forall T, type T -> closed_typ T.
Proof. intros T H. apply lc_at_closed. apply type_lc. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_lc : forall (E : env) T, wf_typ E T -> lc_at 0 T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H as [ E
    | U E X Hb
    | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
    | E T H1 IH1
    | E T H1 IH1
    | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | E a T1 H1 IH1 ].
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. split.
    + exact IH1.
    + destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
      exact (proj1 (lc_at_open_iff T2 0 X) (IHbody X HX)).
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_closed : forall (E : env) T, wf_typ E T -> closed_typ T.
Proof. intros E T H. apply lc_at_closed. apply (wf_typ_lc E T H). Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [H|H].
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [y b'] E IH]; intros x b Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - apply (in_dom_cons E x y b'). simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply (IH x b). assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Free atoms of a type                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}

Lemma open_tt_rec_subst_comm : forall K (T : typ) (X : atom) (V : typ) (Y : atom),
  no_bvar V -> Y <> X ->
  open_tt_rec K Y (subst_tt X V T) = subst_tt X V (open_tt_rec K Y T).
Proof.
  intros K T. revert K. induction T; intros K X V Y Hb Hneq; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K == n) eqn:E.
    + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_neq; [reflexivity | assumption].
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq'].
    + subst a. rewrite (no_bvar_open_tt V Hb K Y). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT1 K X V Y Hb Hneq). rewrite (IHT2 K X V Y Hb Hneq). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT1 K X V Y Hb Hneq). rewrite (IHT2 (S K) X V Y Hb Hneq). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT K X V Y Hb Hneq). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT K X V Y Hb Hneq). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT1 K X V Y Hb Hneq). rewrite (IHT2 K X V Y Hb Hneq). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT K X V Y Hb Hneq). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Substuting T for the opened variable and also substituting inside T. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_subst2 : forall K (T2 : typ) (X : atom) (V : typ) (T : typ),
  no_bvar V ->
  subst_tt X V (open_tt_rec K T T2)
  = open_tt_rec K (subst_tt X V T) (subst_tt X V T2).
Proof.
  intros K T2. revert K. induction T2; intros K X V T Hb; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E; reflexivity.
  - destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst a. rewrite (no_bvar_open_tt V Hb K (subst_tt X V T)). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT2_1; auto. rewrite IHT2_2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2_1; auto. rewrite IHT2_2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2_1; auto. rewrite IHT2_2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT2; auto.
Qed.

(* The type-level version of the requested open/subst identity.      *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_subst_tt : forall K (T : typ) (X : atom) U,
  X `notin` fv_typ T ->
  open_tt_rec K U T = subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K X T).
Proof.
  intros K T. revert K. induction T; intros K X U H; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E.
    + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (a === X) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst a. exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X H). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - pose proof (notin_union_1 X _ _ H) as H1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X _ _ H) as H2.
    rewrite (IHT1 K X U H1). rewrite (IHT2 K X U H2). reflexivity.
  - pose proof (notin_union_1 X _ _ H) as H1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X _ _ H) as H2.
    rewrite (IHT1 K X U H1). rewrite (IHT2 (S K) X U H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT K X U H). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT K X U H). reflexivity.
  - pose proof (notin_union_1 X _ _ H) as H1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X _ _ H) as H2.
    rewrite (IHT1 K X U H1). rewrite (IHT2 K X U H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT K X U H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_subst_tt : forall (T : typ) (X : atom) U,
  X `notin` fv_typ T ->
  open_tt T U = subst_tt X U (open_tt T X).
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma binds_remove_mid : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U Y b,
  Y <> X ->
  (binds Y b (E1 ++ (X, bind_sub U) :: E2) <-> binds Y b (E1 ++ E2)).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Z c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U Y b Hne; simpl.
  - split; intros Hz.
    + destruct Hz as [Heq | Hin].
      * inversion Heq. subst. contradiction.
      * assumption.
    + right. assumption.
  - split; intros Hz.
    + destruct Hz as [Heq | Hin].
      * left. assumption.
      * right. apply (proj1 (IH E2 X U Y b Hne)). assumption.
    + destruct Hz as [Heq | Hin].
      * left. assumption.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2

  end.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* wf_typ inversion                                                  *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_inv_fvar : forall (E : env) (X : atom),
  wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) -> exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_arrow : forall (E : env) T1 T2,
  wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1 /\ wf_typ E T2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_all : forall (E : env) T1 T2,
  wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2) ->
  exists L, wf_typ E T1 /\
    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)).
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_box : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E (typ_box T) -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_readonly : forall (E : env) m T,
  wf_typ E (typ_mut m T) -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_inter : forall (E : env) T1 T2,
  wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1 /\ wf_typ E T2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_record : forall (E : env) a T,
  wf_typ E (typ_record a T) -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.

From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hb.
  - (* empty signature *)
    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
    + apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot].
  - constructor.
  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
  wf_sig E R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (exact (wf_sig_uniq E R Hws)).
  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique signature l (bind_sig T1) (bind_sig T2) R
                Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 2. Domination lemmas for signature concatenation                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma sig_dom_app : forall (R1 R2 : sig) (l : label),
  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2)) <->
  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R1) \/ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2).
Proof.
  intros R1 R2 l.
  pose proof (@Signatures.dom_app signature R1 R2) as Heq.
  pose proof (@LabelSetFacts.In_m l l eq_refl
                (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2))
                (LabelSetImpl.union (Signatures.dom R1)
                                    (Signatures.dom R2)) Heq) as Hm.
  split; intro H.
  - apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. apply (proj1 Hm). exact H.
  - apply (proj2 Hm). apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sig_cons : forall (R : sig) (l0 : label) (T0 : typ)
                              (l : label) (T : typ),
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) (l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R) <->
  (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros.
  change (Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) ((l0, bind_sig T0) :: R) <->
          (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R).
  rewrite Signatures.binds_cons_iff.
  split; intro H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl Hs] | H].
    + left. split; auto. injection Hs as HT. exact HT.
    + right. exact H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl HT] | H].
    + left. split; auto. rewrite HT. reflexivity.
    + right. exact H.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [H|H].
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [y b'] E IH]; intros x b Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - apply (in_dom_cons E x y b'). simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply (IH x b). assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Free atoms of a type                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork.

Lemma sub_weaken_incl : forall (E1 : env) S T,
  wf_env E1 -> wf_typ E1 S -> sub E1 S T ->
  forall (E2 : env), wf_env E2 ->
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  sub E2 S T.
Proof.
  intros E1 S T HE1 HS1 Hsub.
  revert HE1 HS1.
  induction Hsub as [ E1 S HE0 HS0
                 | E1 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E1 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E1 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E1 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E1 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E1 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E1 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E1 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E1 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E1 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E1 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E1 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E1 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E1 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
    intros HE1 HS1 E2 HE2 Hincl.
  - apply sub_top; [assumption |].
    apply (wf_typ_incl E1 S HS1 E2). intros X U Hb. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption |].
    apply (wf_typ_incl E1 (typ_fvar X) HS1 E2). intros Y U Hb. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - apply (sub_trans_tvar U E2 T0 X).
    + apply Hincl. assumption.
    + apply (IHsub HE1 (wf_env_binds_sub _ HE1 X U Hb) E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HS1) as [HSa HSb].
    assert (HT1 : wf_typ E1 T1) by (apply (sub_wf_source E1 T1 S1 HE1 HSa H1)).
    apply sub_arrow.
    + apply (IH1 HE1 HT1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
    + apply (IH2 HE1 HSb E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HS1) as [L1 [HSa HSb]].
    apply (sub_all (L0 `union` L1 `union` dom E1 `union` dom E2) E2 S1 S2 T1 T2).
    + assert (HT1 : wf_typ E1 T1) by (apply (sub_wf_source E1 T1 S1 HE1 HSa H1)).
      apply (IH1 HE1 HT1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (HYL0 : Y `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HYL1 : Y `notin` L1) by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HYd1 : Y `notin` dom E1)
        by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; apply notin_union_2 in HY; apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HYd : Y `notin` dom E2)
        by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; apply notin_union_2 in HY; apply notin_union_2 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HT1s : wf_typ E1 T1) by (apply (sub_wf_source E1 T1 S1 HE1 HSa H1)).
      assert (HT1 : wf_typ E2 T1).
      { apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T1 HT1s E2). intros X U Hb. apply Hincl. assumption. }
      assert (Hwe1 : wf_env (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E1)).
      { apply (wf_env_sub E1 Y T1); [exact HE1 | exact HT1s | exact HYd1]. }
      assert (Hwe2 : wf_env (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
      { apply (wf_env_sub E2 Y T1); [exact HE2 | exact HT1 | exact HYd]. }
      apply (IH0 Y HYL0 Hwe1 (HSb Y HYL1) (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2) Hwe2).
      intros x b Hb.
      destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
      * left; assumption.
      * right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - destruct (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS1) as HwT1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E1 T2).
    { apply (sub_wf_target E1 T1 T2 HE1 HwT1 H1). }
    apply sub_box.
    + apply (IH1 HE1 HwT1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
    + apply (IH2 HE1 HwT2 E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - apply sub_readonly. apply (IH1 HE1 (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS1) E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply (IH1 HE1 HS1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E1 T2) by (apply (sub_wf_target E1 T1 T2 HE1 HS1 H1)).
    apply sub_trans with (T2 := T2).
    + apply (IH1 HE1 HS1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
    + apply (IH2 HE1 HT2 E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - apply (sub_inter_left E2 T1 T2); [assumption | |].
    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T1 HSi1 E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T2 HSi2 E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
  - apply (sub_inter_right E2 T1 T2); [assumption | |].
    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T1 HSi2b E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T2 HSi2c E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply (IH1 HE1 HS1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
    + apply (IH2 HE1 HS1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - destruct (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HS1) as HwT1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E1 T2) by (apply (sub_wf_target E1 T1 T2 HE1 HwT1 H1)).
    apply sub_record.
    + apply (IH1 HE1 HwT1 E2 HE2 Hincl).
    + apply (IH2 HE1 HwT2 E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - apply sub_readonly_record.
    apply (IH1 HE1 (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS1)) E2 HE2 Hincl).
  - apply (sub_denormalize E2 T1 T2).
    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T1 HSd1 E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T2 HSd2 E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
    + apply (IHsub HE1 (wf_typ_nf _ _ HSd1) E2 HE2 Hincl).
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfSubst TypeOpen2 SubstTTSnap.

Lemma typing_wf_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
  typing E R e T -> wf_typ E T
with typing_record_comp_wf_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T Hty. induction Hty as
      [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E0 R0 e1 e2 T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E0 R0 e1 T T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
      | S E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
      | L T1 T2 e1 e2 E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e1 e2 T Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
      | E0 R0 l T Hwe Hws Hb
      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 r T Hr IHr
      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e1 a e2 T H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ].
    + apply (wf_env_binds_typ _ Hwe x T0 Hb).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E0 `union` fv_typ T1)) as [x Hx].
      assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (HxE : x `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (HxT : x `notin` fv_typ T1) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; apply notin_union_2 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (Hwb : wf_typ (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) T1) by (apply IHbody; assumption).
      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0))
        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0);
            apply (typing_wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0 (open_ee e1 x) T1);
            apply Hbody; assumption).
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
      assert (HwT1 : wf_typ E0 T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_remove_bind_typ; eauto. intros y b; reflexivity. }
      apply wf_typ_arrow; assumption.
    + apply (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ IH1)).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E0)) as [X HX].
      assert (HXL : X `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HXE : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0))
        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0);
            apply (typing_wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0 (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X));
            apply Hbody; assumption).
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * exact HwV.
      * intros X0 HX0. apply IHbody. assumption.
    + destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ IH1) as [L0 [HwT1 Hwbody]].
      assert (Hwe : wf_env E0) by (apply wf_sig_wf_env with (R := R0); assumption).
      assert (HwT : wf_typ E0 T)
        by (apply (sub_wf_source E0 T T1 Hwe HwT1 Hsub)).
      destruct (atom_fresh (L0 `union` dom E0 `union` fv_typ T2)) as [X HX].
      assert (HXL0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HXE : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HXT2 : X `notin` fv_typ T2) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
      assert (HbodyX : wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_tt T2 X)) by (apply Hwbody; assumption).
      pose (Hres := wf_typ_subst_tt E0 X T1 (open_tt T2 X) HXE HbodyX T (wf_typ_type _ _ HwT) HwT).
      assert (Heq : open_tt T2 T = subst_tt X T (open_tt T2 X)).
      { apply (open_tt_rec_subst_tt 0 T2 X T HXT2). }
      rewrite Heq. exact Hres.
    + apply (sub_wf_target E0 S T (wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0 Hws) IH1 Hsub).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fv_typ T2)) as [x Hx].
      assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (HxT : x `notin` fv_typ T2) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; assumption).
      assert (Hwb : wf_typ (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E0) T2) by (apply IHbody; assumption).
      eapply wf_typ_remove_bind_typ; eauto. intros y b; reflexivity.
    + apply wf_typ_box; assumption.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ IH1).
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ IH1).
    + apply wf_typ_box. apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l T Hws Hb).
    + apply wf_typ_readonly; assumption.
    + apply wf_typ_readonly.
      apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ IH1)).
    + apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E0 R0 r T Hr).
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ IH1).
    + apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ IH1)).
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ IH1).
  - intros E R r T Htr. induction Htr as
      [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
      | E0 R0 a e r T Tr Hnotin Hr IHr He IHe
      | E0 R0 a l r T Tr Hnotin Hr IHr Hb ].
    + constructor.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect.
      * constructor. apply (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e T He).
      * apply IHr.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect.
      * constructor. apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l T (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r Tr Hr) Hb).
      * apply IHr.

(* Add one fresh label/entry, extending the signature with its type.
   [wf_typ E T] is genuinely needed: [typing] does not imply [wf_typ]
   (e.g. [typing_abs] accepts an arbitrary annotation), while [wf_sig_typ]
   does require it.  The absence of [l] from the store is what lets us
   derive [l] notin dom R, so no separate disjointness hypothesis is
   needed. *)
Lemma typing_store_add : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  wf_typ E T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  (forall v0, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v0 s) ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hwt Hts Hfresh Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  assert (Hnot : ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R)) by
    (apply (typing_store_notin_dom E R s l Hts); exact Hfresh).
  assert (Hwf : wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R)) by
    (apply wf_sig_typ; [exact Hws | exact Hwt | exact Hnot]).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb.
    apply (proj1 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Hl HT] | Hb1].
    + subst l0. subst T0.
      exists v. split.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork SubWeaken.

Lemma same_kinds_narrow : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  same_kinds (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y b] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U'; simpl.
  - apply (same_kinds_cons_sub_any E2 E2 X U U'). apply same_kinds_refl.
  - destruct b as [U0 | T0].
    + apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply IH.
    + apply same_kinds_cons_typ. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma dom_narrow_eq : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) [=] dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y b] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U'; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_eq : forall (E1 E2 : env) (x : atom),
  dom E1 [=] dom E2 -> x `notin` dom E1 -> x `notin` dom E2.
Proof. intros. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_narrow : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 ->
  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) ->
  wf_typ E2 U' ->
  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y b] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HU'; simpl in *.
  - destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwe HwU].
    apply (wf_env_sub E2 X U' Hwe HU' Hnd2).
  - destruct b as [U0 | T0].
    + destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwe Hwt].
      assert (Hwe' : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)) by (apply (IH E2 X U U'); assumption).
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) U0).
      { eapply wf_typ_kind. exact Hwt.
        intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow. }
      assert (Hnot : Y `notin` dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (notin_dom_eq (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2)); auto.
        apply dom_narrow_eq. }
      apply (wf_env_sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) Y U0); assumption.
    + destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwe Hwt].
      assert (Hwe' : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)) by (apply (IH E2 X U U'); assumption).
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) T0).
      { eapply wf_typ_kind. exact Hwt.
        intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow. }
      assert (Hnot : Y `notin` dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (notin_dom_eq (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2)); auto.
        apply dom_narrow_eq. }
      apply (wf_env_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) Y T0); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_narrow_neq : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U' Y b,
  Y <> X ->
  (binds Y b (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) <->
   binds Y b (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Z c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U' Y b Hne; simpl.
  - split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. contradiction.
    + right. assumption.
    + right. assumption.
  - split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj1 (IH E2 X U U' Y b Hne)); assumption.
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj2 (IH E2 X U U' Y b Hne)); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_eq : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U0,
  binds X (bind_sub U0) (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) ->
  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 -> U0 = U.
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Z c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U0 Hb Hnd1 Hnd2; simpl in *.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as _ HU. assumption.
    + exfalso. apply Hnd2. apply in_dom_binds in Hin. assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply Hnd1.
      rewrite in_dom_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply (IH E2 X U U0 Hin).
      * intro Hc. apply Hnd1. rewrite in_dom_cons. right. assumption.
      * assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typing_expr : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
  typing E R e T -> expr e
with typing_record_comp_expr : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> record_comp r.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T Hty. induction Hty as
      [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E0 R0 e1 e2 T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
      | T1 E0 R0 e1 T T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
      | S E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
      | L T1 T2 e1 e2 E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e1 e2 T Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
      | E0 R0 l T Hwe Hws Hb
      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 r T Hr IHr
      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
      | E0 R0 e1 a e2 T H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ].
    + apply expr_var.
    + destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0))
        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0);
            apply (typing_wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0 (open_ee e1 x) T1);
            apply Hbody; assumption).
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
      apply (expr_abs L V e1). apply (wf_typ_type E0 V HwV).
      intros x0 Hx0. apply IHbody. assumption.
    + apply expr_app; assumption.
    + destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0))
        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0);
            apply (typing_wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0 (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X));
            apply Hbody; assumption).
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
      apply (expr_tabs L V e1). apply (wf_typ_type E0 V HwV).
      intros X0 HX0. apply IHbody. assumption.
    + assert (HwAll : wf_typ E0 (typ_all T1 T2)) by (apply (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1 (typ_all T1 T2) H1)).
      destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HwAll) as [L0 [HwT1 _]].
      assert (Hwe : wf_env E0) by (apply wf_sig_wf_env with (R := R0); assumption).
      assert (HwT : wf_typ E0 T) by (apply (sub_wf_source E0 T T1 Hwe HwT1 Hsub)).
      apply (expr_tapp e1 T). assumption. apply (wf_typ_type E0 T HwT).
    + assumption.
    + apply (expr_let L e1 e2).
      * assumption.
      * intros x Hx. apply IHbody. assumption.
    + apply expr_box. assumption.
    + apply expr_unbox. assumption.
    + apply expr_set_box; assumption.
    + apply expr_ref.
    + apply expr_seal. assumption.
    + apply expr_unbox. assumption.
    + apply expr_record. apply (typing_record_comp_expr E0 R0 r T Hr).
    + apply expr_record_read. assumption.
    + apply expr_record_read. assumption.
    + apply expr_record_write; assumption.
  - intros E R r T Htr. induction Htr as
      [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
      | E0 R0 a e r T Tr Hnotin Hr IHr He IHe
      | E0 R0 a l r T Tr Hnotin Hr IHr Hb ].
    + apply record_comp_empty.
    + apply record_comp_exp.
      * apply (typing_expr E0 R0 e T He).
      * apply IHr.
    + apply record_comp_ref. apply IHr.
Qed.

From D Require Import SubstTT Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Lemma test_in_dom_subst_env : forall (A E : env) X V Y,
  Y `in` dom (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) <->
  Y `in` dom A \/ Y `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Z b] A IH]; intros E X V Y; simpl.
  - split; intro H.
    + right. exact H.
    + destruct H as [H|H]; [|exact H].
      apply (notin_empty Y); exact H.
  - change (Y `in` dom ((Z, subst_binding X V b) :: (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E))
            <-> Y `in` dom ((Z,b)::A) \/ Y `in` dom E).
    rewrite (in_dom_cons (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) Y Z (subst_binding X V b)).
    rewrite (in_dom_cons A Y Z b).
    rewrite (IH E X V Y).
    tauto.
Qed.

Lemma test_in_dom_app : forall (E F : env) Y,
  Y `in` dom (E ++ F) <-> Y `in` dom E \/ Y `in` dom F.
Proof.
  intros E F Y. rewrite dom_app.
  apply union_iff.
Qed.

Lemma test_notin_dom_app : forall (E F : env) Y,
  Y `notin` dom (E ++ F) -> Y `notin` dom E /\ Y `notin` dom F.
Proof.
  intros E F Y H. rewrite dom_app in H.
  split; [apply notin_union_1 in H|apply notin_union_2 in H]; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma test_notin_dom_subst_env : forall (A E : env) X V Y,
  Y `notin` dom (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) <->
  Y `notin` dom A /\ Y `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - intro H. split; intro Hin.
    + apply H. apply (proj2 (test_in_dom_subst_env A E X V Y)). left. exact Hin.
    + apply H. apply (proj2 (test_in_dom_subst_env A E X V Y)). right. exact Hin.
  - intros [HA HE] Hin.
    destruct (proj1 (test_in_dom_subst_env A E X V Y) Hin) as [H|H]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma test_binds_mid_sub : forall (A E : env) X U (b : binding),
  X `notin` dom A -> X `notin` dom E ->
  binds X b (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) -> b = bind_sub U.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Z c] A IH]; intros E X U b HA HE Hb; simpl in *.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. reflexivity.
    + apply in_dom_binds in Hin. contradiction.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. simpl in HA. rewrite add_iff in HA.
      exfalso. apply HA. left. reflexivity.
    + simpl in HA. rewrite add_iff in HA.
      apply (IH E X U b).
      * intro Hc. apply HA. right. exact Hc.
      * exact HE.
      * exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv : forall (E : env) X T,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma test_wf_env_cons_bind_typ_inv : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ x `notin` dom E.

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.

  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee x v e1) V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)

  end

  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r)

Lemma subst_ee_eq_fvar : forall x v,

Proof.
  intros. simpl.

  exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.

Lemma subst_ee_neq_fvar : forall x y v,

Fixpoint lc_exp (d : nat) (e : exp) {struct e} : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => i < d
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs _ e1 => lc_exp (S d) e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_exp d e1 /\ lc_exp d e2
  | exp_tabs _ e1 => lc_exp d e1
  | exp_tapp e1 _ => lc_exp d e1
  | exp_let e1 e2 => lc_exp d e1 /\ lc_exp (S d) e2
  | exp_box e1 => lc_exp d e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => lc_exp d e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => lc_exp d e1 /\ lc_exp d e2
  | exp_ref _ => True
  | exp_seal e1 => lc_exp d e1
  | exp_record r => lc_rec d r
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => lc_exp d e1
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => lc_exp d e1 /\ lc_exp d e2
  end
with lc_rec (d : nat) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : Prop :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => True
  | rec_exp _ e r => lc_exp d e /\ lc_rec d r
  | rec_ref _ _ r => lc_rec d r
  end.

Lemma max_succ_succ_aux : forall d j,

Qed.

Fixpoint lc_exp_open_ee (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall d, lc_exp d e ->
  forall k w, d <= k -> open_ee_rec k w e = e :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => fun d H k w Hk => lc_exp_open_ee_bvar d i H k w
  | exp_fvar _ => fun d _ k w _ => eq_refl
  | exp_abs V e1 =>
      fun d H k w Hk =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_abs V z)
          (lc_exp_open_ee e1 (S d) H (S k) w (le_n_S d k Hk))
  | exp_app e1 e2 =>
      fun d H k w Hk =>
        f_equal2 exp_app
          (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d (proj1 H) k w Hk)
          (lc_exp_open_ee e2 d (proj2 H) k w Hk)
  | exp_tabs V e1 =>
      fun d H k w Hk =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_tabs V z)
          (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d H k w Hk)
  | exp_tapp e1 V =>
      fun d H k w Hk =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_tapp z V)
          (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d H k w Hk)
  | exp_let e1 e2 =>
      fun d H k w Hk =>
        f_equal2 exp_let
          (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d (proj1 H) k w Hk)
          (lc_exp_open_ee e2 (S d) (proj2 H) (S k) w (le_n_S d k Hk))
  | exp_box e1 =>
      fun d H k w Hk => f_equal exp_box (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d H k w Hk)
  | exp_unbox e1 =>
      fun d H k w Hk => f_equal exp_unbox (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d H k w Hk)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 =>
      fun d H k w Hk =>
        f_equal2 exp_set_box

          (lc_exp_open_ee e2 d (proj2 H) k w Hk)
  | exp_ref l => fun d _ k w _ => eq_refl
  | exp_seal e1 =>
      fun d H k w Hk => f_equal exp_seal (lc_exp_open_ee e1 d H k w Hk)

with lc_rec_open_ee (r : rec_comp) {struct r} :

normal_form_typing =
fix normal_form_typing (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => J
  | typ_fvar X => X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 =>
      typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
  | typ_box T0 => typ_box (normal_form_typing T0)
  | typ_mut M T0 => merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T0) M
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
  | typ_record a T0 => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T0)
  end
     : typ -> typ

Arguments normal_form_typing T /
merge_mutability =
fix merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_bvar _ => typ_mut m T
  | typ_fvar X => typ_mut m X
  | typ_box T0 => typ_mut m (typ_box T0)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m)
  | typ_record a T0 => typ_mut m (typ_record a T0)
  | _ => T
  end
     : typ -> mut -> typ

Arguments merge_mutability T m /
open_tt_rec =
fix open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else J
  | typ_fvar X => X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_box T0 => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T0)
  | typ_mut M T0 => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T0)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
  end
     : nat -> typ -> typ -> typ

Arguments open_tt_rec K%_nat_scope U T
