  lc_at d (open_tt_rec j (typ_fvar X) T) -> lc_at (max d (S j)) T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros d j X H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (j == n) as [Heq|Hneq].
    + subst n. apply Nat.lt_le_trans with (S j).
      * apply Nat.lt_succ_diag_r.
      * apply Nat.le_max_r.
    + apply Nat.lt_le_trans with d.
      * exact H.
      * apply Nat.le_max_l.
  - exact I.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHT1 d j X H1).
    + apply (IHT2 d j X H2).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHT1 d j X H1).
    + apply (lc_at_bound_eq T2 (max (S d) (S (S j))) (S (max d (S j)))
             (max_succ_succ_aux d j) (IHT2 (S d) (S j) X H2)).
  - apply (IHT d j X H).
  - apply (IHT d j X H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHT1 d j X H1).
    + apply (IHT2 d j X H2).
  - apply (IHT d j X H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 5. Closure of all type annotations in a term                     *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Fixpoint annot_lc (d : nat) (e : exp) {struct e} : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => True
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs V e1 => lc_at d V /\ annot_lc d e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => annot_lc d e1 /\ annot_lc d e2
  | exp_tabs V e1 => lc_at d V /\ annot_lc (S d) e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => annot_lc d e1 /\ lc_at d V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => annot_lc d e1 /\ annot_lc d e2
  | exp_box e1 => annot_lc d e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => annot_lc d e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => annot_lc d e1 /\ annot_lc d e2
  | exp_ref _ => True
  | exp_seal e1 => annot_lc d e1
  | exp_record r => annot_rec d r
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => annot_lc d e1
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => annot_lc d e1 /\ annot_lc d e2
  end
with annot_rec (d : nat) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : Prop :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => True
  | rec_exp _ e r => annot_lc d e /\ annot_rec d r
  | rec_ref _ _ r => annot_rec d r
  end.

Lemma annot_lc_bound_eq : forall e d d',
  d = d' -> annot_lc d e -> annot_lc d' e.
Proof. intros e d d' Heq H. subst. exact H. Qed.

Lemma annot_rec_bound_eq : forall r d d',
  d = d' -> annot_rec d r -> annot_rec d' r.
Proof. intros r d d' Heq H. subst. exact H. Qed.

Fixpoint annot_lc_open_te_inv (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall d j X,
    annot_lc d (open_te_rec j (typ_fvar X) e) ->
    annot_lc (max d (S j)) e :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => fun d j X _ => I
  | exp_fvar _ => fun d j X _ => I
  | exp_abs V e1 =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (lc_at_open_fvar_inv V d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X (proj2 H))
  | exp_app e1 e2 =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_te_inv e2 d j X (proj2 H))
  | exp_tabs V e1 =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (lc_at_open_fvar_inv V d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_bound_eq e1 (max (S d) (S (S j))) (S (max d (S j)))
                (max_succ_succ_aux d j)
                (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 (S d) (S j) X (proj2 H)))
  | exp_tapp e1 V =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X (proj1 H))
             (lc_at_open_fvar_inv V d j X (proj2 H))
  | exp_let e1 e2 =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_te_inv e2 d j X (proj2 H))
  | exp_box e1 =>
      fun d j X H => annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X H
  | exp_unbox e1 =>
      fun d j X H => annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X H
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_te_inv e2 d j X (proj2 H))
  | exp_ref _ => fun d j X _ => I
  | exp_seal e1 =>
      fun d j X H => annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X H
  | exp_record r =>
      fun d j X H => annot_rec_open_te_inv r d j X H
  | exp_record_read e1 a =>
      fun d j X H => annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X H
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_te_inv e2 d j X (proj2 H))
  end
with annot_rec_open_te_inv (r : rec_comp) {struct r} :
  forall d j X,
    annot_rec d (open_te_record_rec j (typ_fvar X) r) ->
    annot_rec (max d (S j)) r :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => fun d j X _ => I
  | rec_exp a e r =>
      fun d j X H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_te_inv e d j X (proj1 H))
             (annot_rec_open_te_inv r d j X (proj2 H))
  | rec_ref a l r =>
      fun d j X H => annot_rec_open_te_inv r d j X H
  end.

Fixpoint annot_lc_open_te_id (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall d K X,
    annot_lc d e -> d <= K -> open_te_rec K (typ_fvar X) e = e :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => fun d K X _ _ => eq_refl
  | exp_fvar _ => fun d K X _ _ => eq_refl
  | exp_abs V e1 =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 exp_abs
          (lc_at_open_id V d (proj1 H) K (typ_fvar X) HK)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X (proj2 H) HK)
  | exp_app e1 e2 =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 exp_app
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X (proj1 H) HK)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e2 d K X (proj2 H) HK)
  | exp_tabs V e1 =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 exp_tabs
          (lc_at_open_id V d (proj1 H) K (typ_fvar X) HK)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 (S d) (S K) X (proj2 H) (le_n_S d K HK))
  | exp_tapp e1 V =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 exp_tapp
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X (proj1 H) HK)
          (lc_at_open_id V d (proj2 H) K (typ_fvar X) HK)
  | exp_let e1 e2 =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 exp_let
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X (proj1 H) HK)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e2 d K X (proj2 H) HK)
  | exp_box e1 =>
      fun d K X H HK => f_equal exp_box (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X H HK)
  | exp_unbox e1 =>
      fun d K X H HK => f_equal exp_unbox (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X H HK)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 exp_set_box
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X (proj1 H) HK)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e2 d K X (proj2 H) HK)
  | exp_ref _ => fun d K X _ _ => eq_refl
  | exp_seal e1 =>
      fun d K X H HK => f_equal exp_seal (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X H HK)
  | exp_record r =>
      fun d K X H HK => f_equal exp_record (annot_rec_open_te_id r d K X H HK)
  | exp_record_read e1 a =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal (fun z => exp_record_read z a)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X H HK)
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 (fun z z' => exp_record_write z a z')
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e1 d K X (proj1 H) HK)
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e2 d K X (proj2 H) HK)
  end
with annot_rec_open_te_id (r : rec_comp) {struct r} :
  forall d K X,
    annot_rec d r -> d <= K -> open_te_record_rec K (typ_fvar X) r = r :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => fun d K X _ _ => eq_refl
  | rec_exp a e r =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal2 (fun z z' => rec_exp a z z')
          (annot_lc_open_te_id e d K X (proj1 H) HK)
          (annot_rec_open_te_id r d K X (proj2 H) HK)
  | rec_ref a l r =>
      fun d K X H HK =>
        f_equal (fun z => rec_ref a l z)
          (annot_rec_open_te_id r d K X H HK)
  end.

Lemma annot_lc_closed_open_te : forall v,
  annot_lc 0 v -> forall K X, open_te_rec K (typ_fvar X) v = v.
Proof.
  intros v H K X. apply (annot_lc_open_te_id v 0 K X H). lia.
Qed.

Lemma annot_rec_closed_open_te : forall r,
  annot_rec 0 r -> forall K X, open_te_record_rec K (typ_fvar X) r = r.
Proof.
  intros r H K X. apply (annot_rec_open_te_id r 0 K X H). lia.
Qed.

Fixpoint annot_lc_open_ee_inv (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall d j x,
    annot_lc d (open_ee_rec j (exp_fvar x) e) -> annot_lc d e :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => fun d j x _ => I
  | exp_fvar _ => fun d j x H => H
  | exp_abs V e1 =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (proj1 H) (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d (S j) x (proj2 H))
  | exp_app e1 e2 =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e2 d j x (proj2 H))
  | exp_tabs V e1 =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (proj1 H) (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 (S d) j x (proj2 H))
  | exp_tapp e1 V =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x (proj1 H)) (proj2 H)
  | exp_let e1 e2 =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e2 d (S j) x (proj2 H))
  | exp_box e1 =>
      fun d j x H => annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x H
  | exp_unbox e1 =>
      fun d j x H => annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x H
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e2 d j x (proj2 H))
  | exp_ref _ => fun d j x _ => I
  | exp_seal e1 =>
      fun d j x H => annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x H
  | exp_record r =>
      fun d j x H => annot_rec_open_ee_inv r d j x H
  | exp_record_read e1 a =>
      fun d j x H => annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x H
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 d j x (proj1 H))
             (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e2 d j x (proj2 H))
  end
with annot_rec_open_ee_inv (r : rec_comp) {struct r} :
  forall d j x,
    annot_rec d (open_ee_record_rec j (exp_fvar x) r) -> annot_rec d r :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => fun d j x _ => I
  | rec_exp a e r =>
      fun d j x H =>
        conj (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e d j x (proj1 H))
             (annot_rec_open_ee_inv r d j x (proj2 H))
  | rec_ref a l r =>
      fun d j x H => annot_rec_open_ee_inv r d j x H
  end.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 6. Typed terms are locally closed and their annotations are      *)
(*    locally closed as well.                                       *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Definition typing_lc_annot_P (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ)
    (_ : typing E R e T) : Prop := lc_exp 0 e /\ annot_lc 0 e.

Definition typing_lc_annot_Q (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ)
    (_ : typing_record_comp E R r T) : Prop := lc_rec 0 r /\ annot_rec 0 r.

Lemma typing_lc_annot : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
  typing E R e T -> lc_exp 0 e /\ annot_lc 0 e
with typing_record_comp_lc_annot : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> lc_rec 0 r /\ annot_rec 0 r.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T H. change (typing_lc_annot_P E R e T H).
    apply (typing_induction typing_lc_annot_P typing_lc_annot_Q).
    + (* var *) intros E R x T w w0 b. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* abs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 w Hbody IHbody.
      destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E)) as [x Hx].
      apply notin_union_1 in Hx as HxL.
      apply notin_union_2 in Hx as HxE.
      pose proof (Hbody x HxL) as Hbodyx.
      pose proof (IHbody x HxL) as IHx.
      assert (Hws : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R)
        by (apply typing_wf_sig; exact Hbodyx).
      assert (Hwe : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E)) by (apply wf_sig_wf_env; exact Hws).
      assert (HwV : wf_typ E V) by (apply (proj2 (wf_env_cons_bind_typ E x V Hwe))).
      assert (HlcV : lc_at 0 V) by (apply wf_typ_lc; exact HwV).
      assert (Hlc1 : lc_exp 1 e1).
      { apply (lc_exp_open_inv_apply e1 x). exact (proj1 IHx). }
      assert (Hann1 : annot_lc 0 e1).
      { apply (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e1 0 0 x). exact (proj2 IHx). }
      simpl. split; [exact Hlc1 | split; [exact HlcV | exact Hann1]].
    + (* app *) intros T1 E R e1 e2 T2 w H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IH1).
      * exact (proj1 IH2).
      * exact (proj2 IH1).
      * exact (proj2 IH2).
    + (* tabs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 w Hbody IHbody.
      destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E)) as [X HX].
      apply notin_union_1 in HX as HXL.
      apply notin_union_2 in HX as HXE.
      pose proof (Hbody X HXL) as HbodyX.
      pose proof (IHbody X HXL) as IHX.
      assert (Hws : wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R)
        by (apply typing_wf_sig; exact HbodyX).
      assert (Hwe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E)) by (apply wf_sig_wf_env; exact Hws).
      assert (HwV : wf_typ E V) by (apply (proj2 (wf_env_cons_bind_sub E X V Hwe))).
      assert (HlcV : lc_at 0 V) by (apply wf_typ_lc; exact HwV).
      assert (Hlc0 : lc_exp 0 e1).
      { apply (lc_exp_open_te_inv_apply e1 0 X). exact (proj1 IHX). }
      assert (Hann1 : annot_lc 1 e1).
      { change (annot_lc (max 0 (S 0)) e1).
        apply (annot_lc_open_te_inv e1 0 0 X). exact (proj2 IHX). }
      simpl. split; [exact Hlc0 | split; [exact HlcV | exact Hann1]].
    + (* tapp *) intros T1 E R e1 T T2 w H1 IH1 Hsub.
      assert (Hwe : wf_env E) by (apply wf_sig_wf_env with (R := R); exact w).
      assert (Hwf_all : wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2))
        by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2)); exact H1).
      destruct (wf_typ_inv_all E T1 T2 Hwf_all) as [L [HwT1 _]].
      assert (HwT : wf_typ E T) by (apply (sub_wf_source E T T1 Hwe HwT1 Hsub)).
      assert (HlcT : lc_at 0 T) by (apply wf_typ_lc; exact HwT).
      simpl. split; [exact (proj1 IH1) | split; [exact (proj2 IH1)|exact HlcT]].
    + (* sub *) intros S E R e T w H1 IH1 Hsub. exact IH1.
    + (* let *) intros L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R w H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody.
      destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E)) as [x Hx].
      apply notin_union_1 in Hx as HxL.
      pose proof (IHbody x HxL) as IHx.
      assert (Hlc2 : lc_exp 1 e2).
      { apply (lc_exp_open_inv_apply e2 x). exact (proj1 IHx). }
      assert (Hann2 : annot_lc 0 e2).
      { apply (annot_lc_open_ee_inv e2 0 0 x). exact (proj2 IHx). }
      simpl. split; [split; [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact Hlc2] |
                     split; [exact (proj2 IH1)|exact Hann2]].
    + (* box *) intros E R e T w H1 IH1. exact IH1.
    + (* unbox *) intros E R e T w H1 IH1. exact IH1.
    + (* set_box *) intros E R e1 e2 T w H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IH1).
      * exact (proj1 IH2).
      * exact (proj2 IH1).
      * exact (proj2 IH2).
    + (* ref *) intros E R l T w w0 b. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* seal *) intros E R e T H1 IH1. exact IH1.
    + (* unbox_readonly *) intros E R e T H1 IH1. exact IH1.
    + (* record *) intros E R r T Hr IHr. simpl. exact IHr.
    + (* record_read *) intros E R e a T H1 IH1. exact IH1.
    + (* record_read_readonly *) intros E R e a T H1 IH1. exact IH1.
    + (* record_write *) intros E R e1 a e2 T H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IH1).
      * exact (proj1 IH2).
      * exact (proj2 IH1).
      * exact (proj2 IH2).
    + (* record_empty *) intros E R w w0. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* record_exp *) intros E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr He IHe.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IHe).
      * exact (proj1 IHr).
      * exact (proj2 IHe).
      * exact (proj2 IHr).
    + (* record_ref *) intros E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr b. exact IHr.
  - intros E R r T H. change (typing_lc_annot_Q E R r T H).
    apply (typing_record_induction typing_lc_annot_P typing_lc_annot_Q).
    + (* empty *) intros E R w w0. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* exp *) intros E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr He IHe.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IHe).
      * exact (proj1 IHr).
      * exact (proj2 IHe).
      * exact (proj2 IHr).
    + (* ref *) intros E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr b. exact IHr.
Qed.

Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
    (in_intersection S T).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Lemma sub_to_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros. apply (sub_denormalize E T (normal_form_typing T)); auto.
  - apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_idem. apply sub_refl; auto. apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_of_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E (normal_form_typing T) T.
Proof.
  intros. apply (sub_denormalize E (normal_form_typing T) T); auto.
  - apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_idem. apply sub_refl; auto. apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

    + apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T2 HSi2c E2); intros X U Hb; apply Hincl; assumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply (IH1 HE1 HS1 E2 HE2 Hincl).

Lemma typing_lc_annot : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
  typing E R e T -> lc_exp 0 e /\ annot_lc 0 e
with typing_record_comp_lc_annot : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> lc_rec 0 r /\ annot_rec 0 r.
Proof.
  - intros E0 R0 e0 T0 H0. change (typing_lc_annot_P E0 R0 e0 T0 H0).
    apply (typing_induction typing_lc_annot_P typing_lc_annot_Q).
    + (* var *) intros E R x T w w0 b. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* abs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 w Hbody IHbody.
      destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E)) as [x Hx].
      apply notin_union_1 in Hx as HxL.
      apply notin_union_2 in Hx as HxE.
===
    + (* record_empty *) intros E R w w0. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* record_exp *) intros E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr He IHe.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IHe).
      * exact (proj1 IHr).
      * exact (proj2 IHe).
      * exact (proj2 IHr).
    + (* record_ref *) intros E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr b. exact IHr.
  - intros E0 R0 r0 T0 H0. change (typing_lc_annot_Q E0 R0 r0 T0 H0).
    apply (typing_record_induction typing_lc_annot_P typing_lc_annot_Q).
    + (* empty *) intros E R w w0. simpl. split; exact I.
    + (* exp *) intros E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr He IHe.
      simpl. split; split.
      * exact (proj1 IHe).
      * exact (proj1 IHr).
      * exact (proj2 IHe).
      * exact (proj2 IHr).
    + (* ref *) intros E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hr IHr b. exact IHr.
Qed.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Inductive signature : Set :=
  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_mut M T =>
        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)

  | typ_box T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  end.

Lemma fv_typ_open_tt : forall (T : typ) K (U : typ) X,
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X `notin` fv_typ U ->
  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K U T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros K U X HT HU; simpl in *.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E; simpl.
    + assumption.
    + auto.
  - auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_typ_open_tt_fvar : forall (T : typ) K (Y X : atom),
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X <> Y ->
  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T).
Proof.
  intros T K Y X HT HXY.
  assert (Hnot : X `notin` fv_typ (typ_fvar Y)).
  { simpl. apply notin_singleton. auto. }
  eapply fv_typ_open_tt; eauto.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Well-formed types depend only on the bindings available           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_binds_iff : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env), (forall x b, binds x b E1 <-> binds x b E2) -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hiff.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply (proj1 (Hiff X (bind_sub U))). assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros y b. simpl. split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_app_iff : forall (E E' : env) X (T : binding) y (b : binding),
  binds y b (((X,T)::E') ++ ((X,T)::E)) <-> binds y b ((X,T)::(E'++E)).
Proof. intros. unfold binds. repeat rewrite in_app_iff. simpl. rewrite in_app_iff. tauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T -> forall (E' : env), wf_typ (E' ++ E) T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E'.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U (E' ++ E) X). apply binds_app_2. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
    + auto.
    + intros X HX. eapply wf_typ_binds_iff.
      * apply (H1 X HX (((X, bind_sub T1) :: E'))).
      * apply binds_cons_app_iff.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken_cons1 : forall (E : env) X (b : binding) T,
  wf_typ E T -> wf_typ ((X,b)::E) T.
Proof. intros E X b T H. apply (wf_typ_weaken E T H ((X,b)::nil)). Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* wf_env                                                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros E R H. induction H. assumption. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_typ : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_sub : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_sub T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_typ : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_typ T) E -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
  - inversion Hy.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_sub : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_sub T) E -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
  - inversion Hy.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Strengthening wf_typ                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_cons_iff_lift : forall (E1 E2 : env) (Y : atom) (T : binding),
  (forall y b, binds y b E1 <-> binds y b E2) ->
  forall y b, binds y b ((Y,T)::E1) <-> binds y b ((Y,T)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 Y T Hiff y b. simpl. split; intros [Hc|Hin].
  - left; assumption.
  - right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
  - left; assumption.
  - right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_swap_cons : forall (E : env) X (T : binding) Y (U : binding) y b,
  binds y b ((X,T)::(Y,U)::E) <-> binds y b ((Y,U)::(X,T)::E).
Proof. intros. unfold binds. simpl. tauto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_bind_typ_app : forall (E1 E2 : env) x V (Y : atom) (U : binding) y b,
  (forall z c, binds z c E1 <-> binds z c (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) ->
  (binds y b ((Y,U)::E1) <-> binds y b ((x, bind_typ V)::(Y,U)::E2)).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 x V Y U y b Hiff.

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_mut M T =>
        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
    end.

Arguments merge_mutability T m /.

Arguments normal_form_typing T /.

Inductive in_normal_form : typ -> Prop :=
  | top_in_normal_form :
    in_normal_form typ_top
  | fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom),
    in_normal_form X
  | readonly_fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom) m,
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m X)
  | arrow_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | all_in_normal_form : forall L T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> in_normal_form (open_tt T2 X)) ->
    in_normal_form (typ_all T1 T2)
  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
.

Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | actually_equal : forall S T,
    S = T ->
    in_intersection S T
  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S L ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S R ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).

Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
    (in_intersection S T).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
      typing E R (exp_record r) T

  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
.

Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).

Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)

Lemma wf_typ_remove_bind_typ : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env) x V,
    (forall y b, binds y b E1 <-> binds y b (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) ->
    x `notin` fv_typ T ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H.
  induction H as [ E
                  | U E X Hb
                  | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                  | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                  | E T H1 IH1
                  | E T H1 IH1
                  | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                  | E a T1 H1 IH1 ];
  intros E2 x V Hiff Hfv.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X).
    apply (proj1 (Hiff X (bind_sub U))) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + assumption.
  - constructor.
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
    + apply IH2 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_2 in Hfv. assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{ x }}).
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (HYL : Y `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HYx : Y <> x).
      { assert (Hny : Y `notin` {{ x }}) by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; assumption).
        apply notin_singleton_1' in Hny. symmetry. exact Hny. }
      assert (HfvT2 : x `notin` fv_typ T2) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; assumption).
      assert (Hfvo : x `notin` fv_typ (open_tt T2 Y)).
      { apply fv_typ_open_tt_fvar; auto. }
      apply (IH0 Y HYL (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2) x V).
      * intros y b. eapply binds_cons_bind_typ_app. exact Hiff.
      * assumption.
  - constructor.
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V); auto.
  - constructor.
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V); auto.
  - constructor.
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
    + apply IH2 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_2 in Hfv. assumption.
  - constructor.
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V); auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_fvar : forall (E : env) (X : atom),
  wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) -> exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_arrow : forall (E : env) T1 T2,
  wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1 /\ wf_typ E T2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_all : forall (E : env) T1 T2,
  wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2) ->
  exists L, wf_typ E T1 /\
    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)).
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_box : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E (typ_box T) -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_readonly : forall (E : env) m T,
  wf_typ E (typ_mut m T) -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_inter : forall (E : env) T1 T2,
  wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1 /\ wf_typ E T2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_inv_record : forall (E : env) a T,
  wf_typ E (typ_record a T) -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

(* Subtyping basics                                                 *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Environment equivalence for wf_typ                                *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition same_kinds (E1 E2 : env) : Prop :=
  forall X, (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1) <-> (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E2).

Lemma same_kinds_refl : forall E, same_kinds E E.
Proof. intros. intros X. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub_any : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U')::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U U' Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U'. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_typ : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_typ U)::E1) ((X, bind_typ U)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_kind : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T -> forall (E2 : env), same_kinds E1 E2 -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hsk.
  - constructor.
  - destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
    apply (wf_typ_var U' E2 X). assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)). apply same_kinds_cons_sub. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_both : forall (E : env) S T, sub E S T ->
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E T) /\
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E S).
Proof.
  intros E S T H.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)
  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))
  | value_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_record r)
  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))
with value_record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | value_rec_empty :
      value_record_comp rec_empty
  | value_rec_ref : forall a l r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value_record_comp (rec_ref a l r)
.

Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

Notation empty_store := (LabelMapImpl.empty store).

Definition well_formed_store (s : store) :=
  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

(* The original dependent pair uses this same witness. *)
Definition fresh_label_for_store (s : store) :=
  Label.fresh (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)).

Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,
            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
            typing E R v T /\ value v)
    /\
    (forall v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
    match r with
    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
    | _ => None
    end.

Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value e1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s2 (exp_app e1 e2') s2'
  | red_tapp : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' V,
      type V ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_tapp e1 V) s1 (exp_tapp e1' V) s1'
  | red_abs : forall T e1 s1 v2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value v2 ->
      red (exp_app (exp_abs T e1) v2) s1 (open_ee e1 v2) s1
  | red_tabs : forall T1 e1 s1 T2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      red (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) s1 (open_te e1 T2) s1
  | red_let_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let e1 e2) s1 (exp_let e1' e2) s1'
  | red_let : forall v1 e2 s2,
      well_formed_store s2 ->
      value v1 ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let v1 e2) s2 (open_ee e2 v1) s2
  | red_box_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_box e1) s1 (exp_box e1') s1'
  | red_box_ref : forall v1 l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red (exp_box v1) s1 (exp_ref l) (LabelMapImpl.add l v1 s1)
  | red_unbox_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_unbox e1) s1 (exp_unbox e1') s1'
  | red_unbox_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) s1 v1 s1
  | red_unbox_sealed_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_set_box_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_set_box e1 e2) s1 (exp_set_box e1' e2) s1'
  | red_set_box_2 : forall v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_set_box v1 e2) s2 (exp_set_box v1 e2') s2'
  | red_set_box_ref : forall l v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_set_box (exp_ref l) v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
  | red_seal_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_seal e1) s1 (exp_seal e1') s1'
  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) s1 (exp_abs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_tabs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) s1 (exp_tabs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_ref: forall l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_record : forall r s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_record r)) s1
  | red_record : forall r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record r1) s1 (exp_record r1') s1'
  | red_record_read_1 : forall a e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_read e1 a) s1 (exp_record_read e1' a) s1'
  | red_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_record r) a) s1 v1 s1
  | red_sealed_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_record_write_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_write e1 a e2) s1 (exp_record_write e1' a e2) s1'
  | red_record_write_2 : forall a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_record_write v1 a e2) s2 (exp_record_write v1 a e2') s2'
  | red_record_write_ref : forall a l r v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_write (exp_record r) a v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
with red_record_comp : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_record_exp_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1,
      record_comp r1 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) s1 (rec_exp a e1' r1) s1'
  | red_record_exp_2 : forall a v r1 s1 l,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      record_comp r1 ->
      value v ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1)
  | red_record_ref : forall a l r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_ref a l r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1') s1'
.

Notation "< e1 | s1 > --> < e1' | s1' >" := (red e1 s1 e1' s1') (at level 69).

Notation "< r1 | s1 > -->r < r1' | s1' >" := (red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1') (at level 69).

Inductive redm : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_eq : forall e s e' s',
    e = e' -> s = s' -> redm e s e' s'
  | redm_step : forall e s e'' s'' e' s',
    red e s e'' s'' ->
    redm e'' s'' e' s' ->
    redm e s e' s'.

Notation "< e1 | s1 > -->* < e1' | s1' >" := (redm e1 s1 e1' s1') (at level 69).

Inductive sealcomp : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
  | sealcomp_fvar : forall (x : atom),
      sealcomp x x
  | sealcomp_bvar : forall (n : nat),
      sealcomp n n
  | sealcomp_abs : forall T e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_abs T e1) (exp_abs T e2)
  | sealcomp_app : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app f1 f2)
  | sealcomp_tabs : forall T e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_tabs T e1) (exp_tabs T e2)
  | sealcomp_tapp : forall T e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_tapp e1 T) (exp_tapp e2 T)
  | sealcomp_let : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_let e1 e2) (exp_let f1 f2)
  | sealcomp_box : forall e1 e2,

content.thinking: This is a huge language. Proving preservation for all these cases is enormous. The task is likely intended to be extremely hard—maybe impossible within time. But perhaps the supplied support files already include a full metatheory and the intended solution is just to invoke existing lemmas? The user says support files and target; maybe Fsub library includes a development for a very similar language with preservation lemmas. Search for `preservation` or `progress` in Fsub support (not our target) might reveal a full solution to a nearly identical language. The rule "do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target" — if the support library has a proof of the same theorem, using it as an axiom/import would violate. But perhaps it's part of the intended library and the task adds new constructs (reference immutability)? Let's inspect Fsub directory.

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T

      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->

(* Record-field component analysis of subtyping (one direction)    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Section RecordComp.

Variable a : atom.

Inductive RComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | rc_here : forall A, RComp (typ_record a A) A
  | rc_fvar : forall X A, RComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | rc_rofvar : forall m X A, RComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | rc_int_l : forall X Y A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | rc_int_r : forall X Y A, RComp Y A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | rc_mut : forall m X A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma RComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, RComp (typ_mut m T) A -> RComp T A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply rc_fvar. - assumption. Qed.

Lemma RComp_int_inv : forall X Y A, RComp (typ_int X Y) A -> RComp X A \/ RComp Y A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.

Lemma RComp_record_inv : forall A B, RComp (typ_record a A) B -> B = A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma RComp_mut_record_inv : forall m a0 T A,
  RComp (typ_mut m (typ_record a0 T)) A -> A = T /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); auto;
  split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma RComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  RComp T A -> RComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
Proof.
  intros T m A H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply rc_mut. apply rc_here.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply rc_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply rc_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply rc_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  RComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp T A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. assert (Hc := RComp_mut_inv m T A Hac).
    exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_here; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
Qed.

Lemma RComp_pair_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RComp T A ->
  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ RComp (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - rewrite nf_fvar. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    + rewrite nf_mut. rewrite nf_fvar. rewrite merge_fvar. exists A.
      repeat split; auto; try apply rc_rofvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
    + destruct (IHT A HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
      rewrite nf_mut. exists A0. repeat split; auto.
      apply RComp_merge_fwd with (m := m). assumption.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
    rewrite nf_record. exists (normal_form_typing A).
    split.
    + apply wf_typ_nf. apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT).
    + split.
      * apply rc_here.
      * apply (of_nf_lem E A HE (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)).
Qed.

Lemma RComp_src_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RComp (normal_form_typing T) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp T A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
    destruct (RComp_merge_rev E (normal_form_typing T) m A HE
                (wf_typ_nf _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)) HA Hac)
      as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
    destruct (IHT A1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA1 Hac1)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rc_mut. assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - rewrite nf_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
    exists T. split.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT).
    + split.
      * apply rc_here.
      * apply (to_nf_lem E T HE (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)).
Qed.

Lemma sub_rcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall A, wf_typ E A -> RComp T A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp S A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
  intros A HA Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - assert (Hac2 := RComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_mut. assumption.
  - assert (Hac2 := RComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 HA2']]].
    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rc_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rc_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - destruct (RComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    exists T1. split.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HS).
    + split.
      * apply rc_here.
      * exact H1.
  - destruct (RComp_mut_record_inv mut_readonly a0 T2 A Hac) as [HeqA Heqa].
    subst A. subst a0.
    exists T1. split.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS)).
    + split.
      * apply rc_mut. apply rc_here.
      * exact H1.
  - destruct (RComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    destruct (IHsub HE Hnf A0 HA0 Hac0) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
    destruct (RComp_src_lift E0 T1 A1 HE HSd1 HA1 Hac1) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    eapply sub_trans; [exact HA'' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA0']].
Qed.

End RecordComp.

Lemma sub_record_record : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HB) (rc_here a B))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' H1]]].
  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (RComp_record_inv _ _ _ Hac')).
  subst A'. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_type : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T -> type T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
  - apply type_all with (L := L); auto.
  - apply type_box; assumption.
  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
  - apply type_record; assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
Proof.
  intros T m A H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
Qed.
