From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
Proof.
  intros T m A H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H3); subst.
    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
Qed.


Lemma to_nf_lem : forall (E : env) T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T (normal_form_typing T).
Proof. intros. apply sub_to_nf; assumption. Qed.
Lemma of_nf_lem : forall (E : env) T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E (normal_form_typing T) T.
Proof. intros. apply sub_of_nf; assumption. Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_pair_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> BoxComp T A ->
  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ BoxComp (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\
    sub E A A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - rewrite nf_fvar. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2).
    rewrite nf_box. exists (normal_form_typing A).
    repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box.
    + apply wf_typ_nf. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
    + apply to_nf_lem; auto.
    + apply of_nf_lem; auto.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    + rewrite nf_mut. rewrite nf_fvar. rewrite merge_fvar. exists A.
      repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_rofvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
    + destruct (IHT A HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
      rewrite nf_mut. exists A0. repeat split; auto.
      apply BoxComp_merge_fwd with (m := m). assumption.
  - inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - inversion Hac.
Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_src_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> BoxComp (normal_form_typing T) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
    exists T. split.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
    + split.
      * apply box_comp_box.
      * split.
        -- apply of_nf_lem; auto. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
        -- apply to_nf_lem; auto. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
  - rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
    destruct (BoxComp_merge_rev E (normal_form_typing T) m A HE
                (wf_typ_nf _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)) HA Hac)
      as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (IHT A1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA1 Hac1)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - rewrite nf_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
Qed.


Lemma BoxComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, BoxComp (typ_mut m T) A -> BoxComp T A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply box_comp_fvar. - assumption. Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_int_inv : forall X Y A, BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A -> BoxComp X A \/ BoxComp Y A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.

Lemma BoxComp_box_inv : forall A B, BoxComp (typ_box A) B -> B = A.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sub_boxcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall A, wf_typ E A -> BoxComp T A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp S A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
  intros A HA Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst. exists T1.
    split; [apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS)|].
    split.
    + apply box_comp_box.
    + split.
      * exact H2.
      * exact H1.
  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 [HA2' HA2'']]]].
    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - destruct (BoxComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - destruct (BoxComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    destruct (IHsub HE Hnf A0 HA0 Hac0) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (BoxComp_src_lift E0 T1 A1 HE HSd1 HA1 Hac1) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA0' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA'']].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA''' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1'' | exact HA0'']].
Qed.

Lemma sub_box_box : forall (E : env) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_box A) -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) HE HA Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HB) (box_comp_box B))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' [H1 H2]]]].
  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (BoxComp_box_inv _ _ Hac')).
  subst A'. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ArrComp_arrow_inv : forall A B X Y,
  ArrComp (typ_arrow A B) X Y -> X = A /\ Y = B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma sub_arrow_arrow : forall (E : env) A B C D,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow C D) ->
  sub E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) -> sub E C A /\ sub E B D.
Proof.
  intros E A B C D HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_arrcomp E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) HE HA Hsub C D
              (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HB)) (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HB))
              (arr_comp_arrow C D))
    as [X [Y [HX [HY [Hac [H1 H2]]]]]].
  destruct (ArrComp_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ Hac) as [HXA HYB].
  subst X. subst Y. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma my_wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> forall l T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.

From D Require Import SubstTT Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Lemma test_in_dom_subst_env : forall (A E : env) X V Y,
  Y `in` dom (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) <->
  Y `in` dom A \/ Y `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Z b] A IH]; intros E X V Y; simpl.
  - split; intro H.
    + right. exact H.
    + destruct H as [H|H]; [|exact H].
      exfalso. exact (notin_empty Y H).
  - change (Y `in` dom ((Z, subst_binding X V b) :: (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E))
            <-> Y `in` dom ((Z,b)::A) \/ Y `in` dom E).
    rewrite (in_dom_cons (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) Y Z (subst_binding X V b)).
    rewrite (in_dom_cons A Y Z b).
    rewrite (IH E X V Y).
    tauto.
Qed.

Lemma test_in_dom_app : forall (E F : env) Y,
  Y `in` dom (E ++ F) <-> Y `in` dom E \/ Y `in` dom F.
Proof.
  intros E F Y. rewrite dom_app.
  apply union_iff.
Qed.

Lemma test_notin_dom_app : forall (E F : env) Y,
  Y `notin` dom (E ++ F) -> Y `notin` dom E /\ Y `notin` dom F.
Proof.
  intros E F Y H. rewrite dom_app in H.
  split; [apply notin_union_1 in H|apply notin_union_2 in H]; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma test_notin_dom_subst_env : forall (A E : env) X V Y,
  Y `notin` dom (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) <->
  Y `notin` dom A /\ Y `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - intro H. split; intro Hin.
    + apply H. apply (proj2 (test_in_dom_subst_env A E X V Y)). left. exact Hin.
    + apply H. apply (proj2 (test_in_dom_subst_env A E X V Y)). right. exact Hin.
  - intros [HA HE] Hin.
    destruct (proj1 (test_in_dom_subst_env A E X V Y) Hin) as [H|H]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma test_binds_mid_sub : forall (A E : env) X U (b : binding),
  X `notin` dom A -> X `notin` dom E ->
  binds X b (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) -> b = bind_sub U.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Z c] A IH]; intros E X U b HA HE Hb; simpl in *.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. reflexivity.
    + apply in_dom_binds in Hin. contradiction.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. simpl in HA. rewrite add_iff in HA.
      exfalso. apply HA. left. reflexivity.
    + simpl in HA. rewrite add_iff in HA.
      apply (IH E X U b).
      * intro Hc. apply HA. right. exact Hc.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Theorem preservation : forall E R e s e' s' T,
  typing E R e T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  red e s e' s' ->
  exists R', wf_sig E (R' ++ R) /\
    typing E (R' ++ R) e' T /\
    typing_store E (R' ++ R) s'
with preservation_record : forall E R r s r' s' T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  red_record_comp r s r' s' ->
  exists R', wf_sig E (R' ++ R) /\
    typing_record_comp E (R' ++ R) r' T /\
    typing_store E (R' ++ R) s'.

Theorem progress : forall e s R T,
  typing empty R e T ->
  typing_store empty R s ->
  value e \/ exists e' s', red e s e' s'
with progress_record_comp : forall r s R T,
  typing_record_comp empty R r T ->
  typing_store empty R s ->
  value_record_comp r \/ exists r' s', red_record_comp r s r' s'.

75	  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)

81	  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)

83	  end.

126	  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_ee_rec k f e) a
127	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_ee_rec k f e1) a (open_ee_rec k f e2)
128	  end

8	Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
9	  wf_typ E1 T ->
10	  forall (E2 : env),
11	    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
12	    wf_typ E2 T.
13	Proof.
14	  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
15	  - constructor.
16	  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
17	  - constructor; auto.
18	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
19	    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
20	    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
21	    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
22	    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
23	  - constructor; auto.
24	  - constructor; auto.
25	  - constructor; auto.
26	  - constructor; auto.
27	Qed.

30	  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
31	  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
32	Proof.
33	  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
34	Qed.

47	  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

50	  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.

52	  intros T m A H. induction H.
53	  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
54	  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
55	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
56	  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
57	  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
58	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.

358	Section RecordComp.

360	Variable a : atom.

362	Inductive RComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
363	  | rc_here : forall A, RComp (typ_record a A) A
364	  | rc_fvar : forall X A, RComp (typ_fvar X) A
365	  | rc_rofvar : forall m X A, RComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
366	  | rc_int_l : forall X Y A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
367	  | rc_int_r : forall X Y A, RComp Y A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
368	  | rc_mut : forall m X A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_mut m X) A.

370	Lemma RComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, RComp (typ_mut m T) A -> RComp T A.

386	Lemma RComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
387	  RComp T A -> RComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
388	Proof.
389	  intros T m A H. induction H.
390	  - rewrite merge_record. apply rc_mut. apply rc_here.
391	  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply rc_rofvar.
392	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply rc_rofvar.
393	  - rewrite merge_int. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
394	  - rewrite merge_int. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
395	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply rc_mut. assumption.

398	Lemma RComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
399	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
400	  RComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
401	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp T A' /\ sub E A' A.
402	Proof.
403	  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
404	  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
405	  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
406	  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
407	  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
408	  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
409	  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
410	  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. assert (Hc := RComp_mut_inv m T A Hac).
411	    exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
412	  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
413	    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
414	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
415	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
416	    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
417	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
418	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
419	  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
420	    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_here; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
421	Qed.

423	Lemma RComp_pair_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
424	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RComp T A ->
425	  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ RComp (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
426	Proof.
427	  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
428	  - inversion Hac.
429	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
430	  - rewrite nf_fvar. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
431	  - inversion Hac.
432	  - inversion Hac.
433	  - inversion Hac.
434	  - inversion Hac; subst.
435	    + rewrite nf_mut. rewrite nf_fvar. rewrite merge_fvar. exists A.
436	      repeat split; auto; try apply rc_rofvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
437	    + destruct (IHT A HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA H2)
438	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
439	      rewrite nf_mut. exists A0. repeat split; auto.
440	      apply RComp_merge_fwd with (m := m). assumption.
441	  - inversion Hac; subst.
442	    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
443	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
444	      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
445	    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
446	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
447	      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
448	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
449	    rewrite nf_record. exists (normal_form_typing A).
450	    split.
451	    + apply wf_typ_nf. apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT).
452	    + split.
453	      * apply rc_here.
454	      * apply (of_nf_lem E A HE (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)).
455	Qed.

457	Lemma RComp_src_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
458	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RComp (normal_form_typing T) A ->
459	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp T A' /\ sub E A' A.
460	Proof.
461	  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
462	  - rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
463	  - rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
464	  - rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
465	  - rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
466	  - rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
467	  - rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
468	  - rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
469	    destruct (RComp_merge_rev E (normal_form_typing T) m A HE
470	                (wf_typ_nf _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)) HA Hac)
471	      as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
472	    destruct (IHT A1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA1 Hac1)
473	      as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
474	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
475	    + apply rc_mut. assumption.
476	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
477	  - rewrite nf_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
478	    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
479	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
480	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
481	    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
482	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
483	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
484	  - rewrite nf_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
485	    exists T. split.
486	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT).
487	    + split.
488	      * apply rc_here.
489	      * apply (to_nf_lem E T HE (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)).
490	Qed.

492	Lemma sub_rcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
493	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
494	  forall A, wf_typ E A -> RComp T A ->
495	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp S A' /\ sub E A' A.
496	Proof.
497	  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
498	  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
499	                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
500	                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
501	                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
502	                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
503	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
504	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
505	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
506	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
507	                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
508	                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
509	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
510	                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
511	                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
512	                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
513	  intros A HA Hac.
514	  - inversion Hac.
515	  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
516	  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
517	  - inversion Hac.
518	  - inversion Hac.
519	  - inversion Hac.
520	  - assert (Hac2 := RComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A Hac).
521	    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
522	      as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
523	    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_mut. assumption.
524	  - assert (Hac2 := RComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A Hac).
525	    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
526	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
527	  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
528	    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
529	    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
530	    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 HA2']]].
531	    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
532	    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
533	  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
534	    + apply rc_int_l. assumption.
535	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
536	  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
537	    + apply rc_int_r. assumption.
538	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
539	  - destruct (RComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
540	    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
541	      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
542	    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
543	      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
544	  - inversion Hac; subst.
545	    exists T1. split.
546	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HS).
547	    + split.
548	      * apply rc_here.
549	      * exact H1.
550	  - destruct (RComp_mut_record_inv mut_readonly a0 T2 A Hac) as [HeqA Heqa].
551	    subst A. subst a0.
552	    exists T1. split.
553	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS)).
554	    + split.
555	      * apply rc_mut. apply rc_here.
556	      * exact H1.
557	  - destruct (RComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
558	    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
559	    destruct (IHsub HE Hnf A0 HA0 Hac0) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
560	    destruct (RComp_src_lift E0 T1 A1 HE HSd1 HA1 Hac1) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
561	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
562	    eapply sub_trans; [exact HA'' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA0']].
563	Qed.

565	End RecordComp.

567	Lemma sub_record_record : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
568	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
569	  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B.
570	Proof.
571	  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
572	  destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub B
573	              (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HB) (rc_here a B))
574	    as [A' [HA' [Hac' H1]]].
575	  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (RComp_record_inv _ _ _ Hac')).
576	  subst A'. exact H1.
577	Qed.

580	  wf_typ E T -> type T.

584	  - apply type_var.

587	  - apply type_box; assumption.

1	From D Require Import Dev.
2	From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

4	(* ================================================================ *)
5	(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
6	(* ================================================================ *)
7	
8	Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
9	  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
10	Proof.
11	  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
12	    intro Hb.
13	  - (* empty signature *)
14	    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
15	  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
16	    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
17	    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
18	    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
19	    + apply IH. exact Hin.
20	Qed.
21	
22	Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
23	  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
24	Proof.
25	  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot].
26	  - constructor.
27	  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
28	Qed.
29	
30	Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
31	  wf_sig E R ->
32	  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
33	  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
34	Proof.
35	  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
36	  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (exact (wf_sig_uniq E R Hws)).
37	  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique signature l (bind_sig T1) (bind_sig T2) R
38	                Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
39	  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
40	Qed.
41	
42	(* ================================================================ *)
43	(* 2. Domination lemmas for signature concatenation                 *)
44	(* ================================================================ *)
45	
46	Lemma sig_dom_app : forall (R1 R2 : sig) (l : label),
47	  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2)) <->
48	  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R1) \/ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2).
49	Proof.
50	  intros R1 R2 l.
51	  pose proof (@Signatures.dom_app signature R1 R2) as Heq.
52	  pose proof (@LabelSetFacts.In_m l l eq_refl
53	                (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2))
54	                (LabelSetImpl.union (Signatures.dom R1)
55	                                    (Signatures.dom R2)) Heq) as Hm.
56	  split; intro H.
57	  - apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. apply (proj1 Hm). exact H.
58	  - apply (proj2 Hm). apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. exact H.
59	Qed.
60	
61	Lemma binds_sig_cons : forall (R : sig) (l0 : label) (T0 : typ)
62	                              (l : label) (T : typ),
63	  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) (l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R) <->
64	  (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
65	Proof.
66	  intros.
67	  change (Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) ((l0, bind_sig T0) :: R) <->
68	          (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R).
69	  rewrite Signatures.binds_cons_iff.
70	  split; intro H.
71	  - destruct H as [[Hl Hs] | H].
72	    + left. split; auto. injection Hs as HT. exact HT.
73	    + right. exact H.
74	  - destruct H as [[Hl HT] | H].
75	    + left. split; auto. rewrite HT. reflexivity.
76	    + right. exact H.
77	Qed.
78	
79	Lemma wf_sig_app : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig),
80	  wf_sig E R1 -> wf_sig E R2 ->
81	  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
82	      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R1 ->
83	      ~ (LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2))) ->
84	  wf_sig E (R1 ++ R2).
85	Proof.
86	  intros E R1 R2 H1.
87	  induction H1 as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
88	    intros H2 Hdisj.
89	  - simpl. exact H2.
90	  - change (wf_sig E0 ((l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0) ++ R2)).
91	    simpl. apply wf_sig_typ.
92	    + apply IH.
93	      * exact H2.
94	      * intros l T Hb.
95	        exact (Hdisj l T
96	                 (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l T) (or_intror Hb))).
97	    + exact Hwt.
98	    + intro Hin. apply (proj1 (sig_dom_app R0 R2 l0)) in Hin.
99	      destruct Hin as [Hin1 | Hin2].
100	      * exact (Hnot Hin1).
101	      * exact (Hdisj l0 T0
102	                 (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l0 T0)
103	                        (or_introl (conj eq_refl eq_refl))) Hin2).
104	Qed.

110	Lemma InA_eq_key_elt_fst : forall (p : label * exp)
111	                                  (l : list (label * exp)),
112	  InA (LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt (elt := exp)) p l ->
113	  In (fst p) (List.map fst l).
114	Proof.
115	  intros p l H. induction H as [y l0 HR | y l0 HR IH].
116	  - unfold LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt in HR. simpl in HR.
117	    destruct HR as [Hfst _]. simpl. left. symmetry. exact Hfst.
118	  - simpl. right. exact IH.
119	Qed.

121	Lemma fresh_label_not_maps : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp),
122	  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
123	  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> False.
124	Proof.
125	  intros s l v Hfresh HMaps.
126	  apply LabelMapFacts.elements_mapsto_iff in HMaps.
127	  pose proof (InA_eq_key_elt_fst (l, v) (LabelMapImpl.elements s) HMaps) as Hin.
128	  pose proof (Label.fresh_not_in (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s))) as Hnot.
129	  unfold fresh_label_for_store in Hfresh.
130	  rewrite <- Hfresh in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
131	Qed.

133	Lemma fresh_label_neq : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp) (l0 : label),
134	  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
135	  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l0 v s -> l <> l0.
136	Proof.
137	  intros s l v l0 Hfresh HMaps Heq.
138	  subst l0.
139	  exact (fresh_label_not_maps s l v Hfresh HMaps).
140	Qed.

142	Lemma typing_store_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
143	                                (l : label) (T : typ),
144	  typing_store E R s ->
145	  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
146	  exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
147	Proof.
148	  intros E R s l T Hts Hb.
149	  unfold typing_store in Hts.
150	  destruct (Hts l) as [Hfst _].
151	  destruct (Hfst T Hb) as [v [HMaps _]]. exists v. exact HMaps.
152	Qed.

154	Lemma fresh_label_notin_sig_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
155	                                        (s : store) (l : label),
156	  typing_store E R s ->
157	  l = fresh_label_for_store s ->
158	  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
159	Proof.
160	  intros E R s l Hts Hfresh Hin.
161	  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
162	  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
163	  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HMaps].
164	  apply (fresh_label_not_maps s l v).
165	  - symmetry. exact Hfresh.
166	  - exact HMaps.
167	Qed.

182	(* Extending the environment with one binding preserves a wf signature. *)
183	Lemma wf_sig_env_weaken_cons : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
184	                                     (X : atom) (b : binding),
185	  wf_sig E R -> wf_env (X ~ b ++ E) -> wf_sig (X ~ b ++ E) R.
186	Proof.
187	  intros E R X b Hws Hwe. revert Hwe.
188	  induction Hws as [E0 Hwe0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws0 IH Hwt Hnot];
189	    intro Hwe'.
190	  - apply wf_sig_empty. exact Hwe'.
191	  - apply wf_sig_typ.
192	    + apply IH. exact Hwe'.
193	    + apply wf_typ_weaken_cons1. exact Hwt.
194	    + exact Hnot.
195	Qed.

201	Scheme typing_mut := Induction for typing Sort Prop
202	with typing_record_mut := Induction for typing_record_comp Sort Prop.

204	Lemma typing_sig_weaken_aux : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
205	  typing E R e T ->
206	  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T.
207	Proof.
208	  intros E0 R0 e0 T0 Hty0.
209	  pose (P := fun (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ)
210	                   (_ : typing E R e T) =>
211	               forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T).
212	  pose (Q := fun (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ)
213	                   (_ : typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
214	               forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) ->
215	                         typing_record_comp E (R2 ++ R) r T).
216	  change (P E0 R0 e0 T0 Hty0).
217	  apply (typing_mut P Q).
218	  - (* var *) intros E R x T Hwe Hws Hbind R2 Hws'.
219	    apply (typing_var E (R2 ++ R) x T Hwe Hws' Hbind).
220	  - (* abs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
221	    apply (typing_abs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
222	    intros x Hx.
223	    apply (IHbody x Hx R2).
224	    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ V) Hws').
225	    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R).
226	    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1).
227	    apply Hbody. exact Hx.
228	  - (* app *) intros T1 E R e1 e2 T2 Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
229	    apply (typing_app T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T2 Hws'
230	             (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).
231	  - (* tabs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
232	    apply (typing_tabs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
233	    intros X HX.
234	    apply (IHbody X HX R2).
235	    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) X (bind_sub V) Hws').
236	    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R).
237	    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R
238	             (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)).
239	    apply Hbody. exact HX.
240	  - (* tapp *) intros T1 E R e1 T T2 Hws Hbody IH Hsub R2 Hws'.
241	    apply (typing_tapp T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 T T2 Hws'
242	             (IH R2 Hws') Hsub).
243	  - (* sub *) intros S E R e T Hws Hbody IH Hsub R2 Hws'.
244	    apply (typing_sub S E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws') Hsub).
245	  - (* let *) intros L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
246	    apply (typing_let L T1 T2 e1 e2 E (R2 ++ R) Hws' (IH1 R2 Hws')).
247	    intros x Hx.
248	    apply (IH2 x Hx R2).
249	    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ T1) Hws').
250	    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R).
251	    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2).
252	    apply Hbody2. exact Hx.
253	  - (* box *) intros E R e T Hws Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
254	    apply (typing_box E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws')).
255	  - (* unbox *) intros E R e T Hws Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
256	    apply (typing_unbox E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws')).
257	  - (* set_box *) intros E R e1 e2 T Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
258	    apply (typing_set_box E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T Hws'
259	             (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).
260	  - (* ref *) intros E R l T Hwe Hws Hbind R2 Hws'.
261	    apply (typing_ref E (R2 ++ R) l T Hwe Hws').
262	    apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hbind.
263	  - (* seal *) intros E R e T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
264	    apply (typing_seal E (R2 ++ R) e T (IH R2 Hws')).
265	  - (* unbox_readonly *) intros E R e T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
266	    apply (typing_unbox_readonly E (R2 ++ R) e T (IH R2 Hws')).
267	  - (* record *) intros E R r T Hrecord IHrecord R2 Hws'.
268	    apply (typing_record E (R2 ++ R) r T (IHrecord R2 Hws')).
269	  - (* record_read *) intros E R e a T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
270	    apply (typing_record_read E (R2 ++ R) e a T (IH R2 Hws')).
271	  - (* record_read_readonly *) intros E R e a T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
272	    apply (typing_record_read_readonly E (R2 ++ R) e a T (IH R2 Hws')).
273	  - (* record_write *) intros E R e1 a e2 T Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
274	    apply (typing_record_write E (R2 ++ R) e1 a e2 T (IH1 R2 Hws')
275	             (IH2 R2 Hws')).
276	  - (* record_empty *) intros E R Hwe Hws R2 Hws'.
277	    apply (typing_record_empty E (R2 ++ R) Hwe Hws').
278	  - (* record_exp *) intros E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hrec IHrec Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
279	    apply (typing_record_exp E (R2 ++ R) a e r T Tr Hnd
280	             (IHrec R2 Hws') (IHbody R2 Hws')).
281	  - (* record_ref *) intros E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hrec IHrec Hbind R2 Hws'.
282	    apply (typing_record_ref E (R2 ++ R) a l r T Tr Hnd
283	             (IHrec R2 Hws')).
284	    apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hbind.
285	Qed.

287	Lemma typing_sig_weaken : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),

289	  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T.

299	(* A label absent from the store cannot be bound by the signature. *)
300	Lemma typing_store_notin_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
301	                                      (l : label),
302	  typing_store E R s ->
303	  (forall v, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
304	  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
305	Proof.
306	  intros E R s l Hts Hnot Hin.
307	  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
308	  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
309	  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HM].
310	  exact (Hnot v HM).
311	Qed.
312	
313	(* Generic signature extension for store typings.  The signature grows
314	   from [R1] to [R2 ++ R1]; the store grows from [s] to [s'].  Old entries
315	   persist ([Hmono]); every binding in [R2] has a typed entry in [s']
316	   ([Hext]); and every entry of [s'] is either such a new typed entry or
317	   an old entry.  Old values are retyped under the extended signature via
318	   [typing_sig_weaken]. *)
319	Lemma typing_store_mono_sig : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig)
320	                                     (s s' : store),
321	  wf_sig E (R2 ++ R1) ->
322	  typing_store E R1 s ->
323	  (forall (l : label) (v : exp),
324	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s') ->
325	  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
326	      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R2 ->
327	      exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s' /\
328	                typing E (R2 ++ R1) v T /\ value v) ->
329	  (forall (l : label) (v : exp),
330	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s' ->
331	      (exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R2 /\
332	                 typing E (R2 ++ R1) v T /\ value v) \/
333	      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
334	  typing_store E (R2 ++ R1) s'.
335	Proof.
336	  intros E R1 R2 s s' Hws Hts Hmono Hext Hdec.
337	  unfold typing_store in *.
338	  intro l0. split.
339	  - intros T0 Hb.
340	    apply Signatures.binds_app_iff in Hb.
341	    destruct Hb as [Hb2 | Hb1].
342	    + exact (Hext l0 T0 Hb2).
343	    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
344	      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v [HM [Hty Hval]]].
345	      exists v. split.
346	      * exact (Hmono l0 v HM).
347	      * split.
348	        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
349	        -- exact Hval.
350	  - intros v HM.
351	    destruct (Hdec l0 v HM) as [[T0 [Hb2 [Hty Hval]]] | HM0].
352	    + exists T0. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
353	      * exact Hty.
354	      * exact (Signatures.binds_app_2 signature l0 (bind_sig T0) R2 R1 Hb2).
355	    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
356	      destruct (Hg v HM0) as [T0 [Hval [Hty Hb]]].
357	      exists T0. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
358	      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
359	      * exact (Signatures.binds_app_3 signature l0 (bind_sig T0) R2 R1 Hb).
360	Qed.
361	
362	(* Add one fresh label/entry, extending the signature with its type.
363	   [wf_typ E T] is genuinely needed: [typing] does not imply [wf_typ]
364	   (e.g. [typing_abs] accepts an arbitrary annotation), while [wf_sig_typ]
365	   does require it.  The absence of [l] from the store is what lets us
366	   derive [l] notin dom R, so no separate disjointness hypothesis is
367	   needed. *)
368	Lemma typing_store_add : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
369	                                (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
370	  wf_typ E T ->
371	  typing_store E R s ->
372	  (forall v0, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v0 s) ->
373	  typing E R v T ->
374	  value v ->
375	  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
376	Proof.
377	  intros E R s l v T Hwt Hts Hfresh Hty Hval.
378	  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
379	    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
380	  assert (Hnot : ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R)) by
381	    (apply (typing_store_notin_dom E R s l Hts); exact Hfresh).
382	  assert (Hwf : wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R)) by
383	    (apply wf_sig_typ; [exact Hws | exact Hwt | exact Hnot]).
384	  unfold typing_store in *.
385	  intro l0. split.
386	  - intros T0 Hb.
387	    apply (proj1 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)) in Hb.
388	    destruct Hb as [[Hl HT] | Hb1].
389	    + subst l0. subst T0.
390	      exists v. split.
391	      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
392	      * split.
393	        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
394	        -- exact Hval.
395	    + assert (Hneq : l <> l0).
396	      { intro Heq. subst l0.
397	        apply Hnot.
398	        exact (Signatures.binds_In signature l (bind_sig T0) R Hb1). }
399	      destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
400	      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
401	      exists v0. split.
402	      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0
403	                       Hneq) HM).
404	      * split.
405	        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
406	        -- exact Hval0.
407	  - intros v0 HM.
408	    apply (proj1 (LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff (elt := exp)
409	                    s l l0 v v0)) in HM.
410	    destruct HM as [[Hl Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
411	    + subst l0. subst v0.
412	      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
413	      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
414	      * apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R l T l T)). left.
415	        split; reflexivity.
416	    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
417	      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
418	      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split.
419	      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
420	      * apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)). right. exact Hb0.
421	Qed.
422	
423	(* Replace/insert the store entry at an already-bound label.  The type
424	   is forced by the signature (using well-formedness/uniqueness of
425	   bindings), so the new value simply has to inhabit that type. *)
426	Lemma typing_store_update : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
427	                                   (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
428	  typing_store E R s ->
429	  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
430	  typing E R v T ->
431	  value v ->
432	  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
433	Proof.
434	  intros E R s l v T Hts Hb Hty Hval.
435	  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
436	    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
437	  unfold typing_store in *.
438	  intro l0. split.
439	  - intros T0 Hb0.
440	    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l0) as [Heq | Hneq].
441	    + subst l0.
442	      assert (HT : T0 = T) by
443	        (exact (wf_sig_binds_uniq E R l T0 T Hws Hb0 Hb)).
444	      subst T0.
445	      exists v. split.
446	      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
447	      * split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
448	    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
449	      destruct (Hf T0 Hb0) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
450	      exists v0. split.
451	      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0
452	                       Hneq) HM).
453	      * split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hval0].
454	  - intros v0 HM.
455	    apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff in HM.
456	    destruct HM as [[Heq Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
457	    + subst l0. subst v0.
458	      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split; [exact Hty | exact Hb].
459	    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
460	      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
461	      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hb0].
462	Qed.

4	Lemma typing_wf_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
5	  typing E R e T -> wf_typ E T
6	with typing_record_comp_wf_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
7	  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_typ E T.
8	Proof.
9	  - intros E R e T Hty. induction Hty as
10	      [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
11	      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
12	      | T1 E0 R0 e1 e2 T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
13	      | L E0 R0 V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
14	      | T1 E0 R0 e1 T T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
15	      | S E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
16	      | L T1 T2 e1 e2 E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
17	      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
18	      | E0 R0 e T Hws H1 IH1
19	      | E0 R0 e1 e2 T Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
20	      | E0 R0 l T Hwe Hws Hb
21	      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
22	      | E0 R0 e T H1 IH1
23	      | E0 R0 r T Hr IHr
24	      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
25	      | E0 R0 e a T H1 IH1
26	      | E0 R0 e1 a e2 T H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ].
27	    + apply (wf_env_binds_typ _ Hwe x T0 Hb).
28	    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E0 `union` fv_typ T1)) as [x Hx].
29	      assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
30	      assert (HxE : x `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; apply notin_union_1 in Hx; assumption).
31	      assert (HxT : x `notin` fv_typ T1) by (apply notin_union_2 in Hx; apply notin_union_2 in Hx; assumption).
32	      assert (Hwb : wf_typ (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) T1) by (apply IHbody; assumption).
33	      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0))
34	        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0);
35	            apply (typing_wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E0) R0 (open_ee e1 x) T1);
36	            apply Hbody; assumption).
37	      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
38	      assert (HwT1 : wf_typ E0 T1).
39	      { eapply wf_typ_remove_bind_typ; eauto. intros y b; reflexivity. }
40	      apply wf_typ_arrow; assumption.
41	    + apply (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ IH1)).
42	    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E0)) as [X HX].
43	      assert (HXL : X `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
44	      assert (HXE : X `notin` dom E0) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
45	      assert (Hwenv : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0))
46	        by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0);
47	            apply (typing_wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) R0 (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X));
48	            apply Hbody; assumption).
49	      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwenv) as [HweE HwV].
50	      apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
51	      * exact HwV.
52	      * intros X0 HX0. apply IHbody. assumption.
53	    + destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ IH1) as [L0 [HwT1 Hwbody]].

72	Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
73	  match T with

852	  | exp_unbox e => (seal_count e)
853	  | exp_set_box b e => (seal_count b) + (seal_count e)
854	  | exp_ref l => 0
855	  | exp_seal e => (S (seal_count e))
856	  | exp_record r => (seal_count_record r)
857	  | exp_record_read e a => (seal_count e)
858	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
859	  end
860	with
861	  seal_count_record (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : nat :=
862	  match r with
863	  | rec_empty => 0
864	  | rec_exp a e r => (seal_count e) + (seal_count_record r)
865	  | rec_ref a l r => (seal_count_record r)
866	  end.
867	
868	Arguments seal_count e /.
869	
870	Arguments seal_count_record r /.
871	
872	Notation "| f |" := (seal_count f) (at level 69).

1	From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

3	
4	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
5	(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
6	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
7	
8	Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
9	  wf_typ E1 T ->
10	  forall (E2 : env),
11	    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
12	    wf_typ E2 T.
13	Proof.
14	  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
15	  - constructor.
16	  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
17	  - constructor; auto.
18	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
19	    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
20	    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
21	    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
22	    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
23	  - constructor; auto.
24	  - constructor; auto.
25	  - constructor; auto.
26	  - constructor; auto.
27	Qed.
28	
29	Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
30	  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
31	  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
32	Proof.
33	  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
34	Qed.
35	
36	
37	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
38	(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
39	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
40	
41	Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
42	  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
43	  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
44	  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
45	  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
46	  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
47	  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.
48	
49	Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
50	  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
51	Proof.
52	  intros T m A H. induction H.
53	  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
54	  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
55	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.
56	  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
57	  - rewrite merge_int. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
58	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
59	Qed.
60	
61	Lemma BoxComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
62	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
63	  BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
64	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
65	Proof.
66	  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
67	  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
68	  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
69	  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
70	  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
71	  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
72	  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H3); subst.
73	    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
74	  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
75	  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
76	    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
77	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
78	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
79	    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
80	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
81	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
82	  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
83	Qed.
84	
85	
86	Lemma to_nf_lem : forall (E : env) T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T (normal_form_typing T).
87	Proof. intros. apply sub_to_nf; assumption. Qed.
88	Lemma of_nf_lem : forall (E : env) T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E (normal_form_typing T) T.
89	Proof. intros. apply sub_of_nf; assumption. Qed.
90	
91	Lemma BoxComp_pair_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
92	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> BoxComp T A ->
93	  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ BoxComp (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\
94	    sub E A A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
95	Proof.
96	  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
97	  - inversion Hac.
98	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
99	  - rewrite nf_fvar. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
100	  - inversion Hac.
101	  - inversion Hac.
102	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2).
103	    rewrite nf_box. exists (normal_form_typing A).
104	    repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_box.
105	    + apply wf_typ_nf. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
106	    + apply to_nf_lem; auto.
107	    + apply of_nf_lem; auto.
108	  - inversion Hac; subst.
109	    + rewrite nf_mut. rewrite nf_fvar. rewrite merge_fvar. exists A.
110	      repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_rofvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
111	    + destruct (IHT A HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA H2)
112	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
113	      rewrite nf_mut. exists A0. repeat split; auto.
114	      apply BoxComp_merge_fwd with (m := m). assumption.
115	  - inversion Hac; subst.
116	    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
117	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
118	      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
119	    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
120	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
121	      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
122	  - inversion Hac.
123	Qed.
124	
125	Lemma BoxComp_src_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
126	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> BoxComp (normal_form_typing T) A ->
127	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp T A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
128	Proof.
129	  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
130	  - rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
131	  - rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
132	  - rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
133	  - rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
134	  - rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
135	  - rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
136	    exists T. split.
137	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
138	    + split.
139	      * apply box_comp_box.
140	      * split.
141	        -- apply of_nf_lem; auto. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
142	        -- apply to_nf_lem; auto. apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HT).
143	  - rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
144	    destruct (BoxComp_merge_rev E (normal_form_typing T) m A HE
145	                (wf_typ_nf _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)) HA Hac)
146	      as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
147	    destruct (IHT A1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA1 Hac1)
148	      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
149	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
150	    + apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
151	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
152	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
153	  - rewrite nf_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
154	    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
155	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
156	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
157	    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
158	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
159	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
160	  - rewrite nf_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
161	Qed.
162	
163	
164	Lemma BoxComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, BoxComp (typ_mut m T) A -> BoxComp T A.
165	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply box_comp_fvar. - assumption. Qed.
166	
167	Lemma BoxComp_int_inv : forall X Y A, BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A -> BoxComp X A \/ BoxComp Y A.
168	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.
169	
170	Lemma BoxComp_box_inv : forall A B, BoxComp (typ_box A) B -> B = A.
171	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. reflexivity. Qed.
172	
173	Lemma sub_boxcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
174	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
175	  forall A, wf_typ E A -> BoxComp T A ->
176	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp S A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
177	Proof.
178	  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
179	  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
180	                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
181	                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
182	                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
183	                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
184	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
185	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
186	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
187	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
188	                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
189	                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
190	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
191	                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
192	                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
193	                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
194	  intros A HA Hac.
195	  - inversion Hac.
196	  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
197	  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
198	  - inversion Hac.
199	  - inversion Hac.
200	  - inversion Hac; subst. exists T1.
201	    split; [apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS)|].
202	    split.
203	    + apply box_comp_box.
204	    + split.
205	      * exact H2.
206	      * exact H1.
207	  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
208	    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
209	      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
210	    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
211	  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
212	    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
213	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
214	  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
215	    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
216	    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
217	    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 [HA2' HA2'']]]].
218	    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
219	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
220	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
221	  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
222	    + apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
223	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
224	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
225	  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
226	    + apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
227	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
228	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
229	  - destruct (BoxComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
230	    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
231	      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
232	    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
233	      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
234	  - inversion Hac.
235	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
236	  - destruct (BoxComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
237	    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
238	    destruct (IHsub HE Hnf A0 HA0 Hac0) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
239	    destruct (BoxComp_src_lift E0 T1 A1 HE HSd1 HA1 Hac1) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
240	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
241	    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA0' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA'']].
242	    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA''' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1'' | exact HA0'']].
243	Qed.
244	
245	Lemma sub_box_box : forall (E : env) A B,
246	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_box A) -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
247	  sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
248	Proof.
249	  intros E A B HE HA HB Hsub.
250	  destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) HE HA Hsub B
251	              (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HB) (box_comp_box B))
252	    as [A' [HA' [Hac' [H1 H2]]]].
253	  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (BoxComp_box_inv _ _ Hac')).
254	  subst A'. split; assumption.
255	Qed.
256	
257	Lemma ArrComp_arrow_inv : forall A B X Y,
258	  ArrComp (typ_arrow A B) X Y -> X = A /\ Y = B.
259	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.
260	
261	Lemma sub_arrow_arrow : forall (E : env) A B C D,
262	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow C D) ->
263	  sub E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) -> sub E C A /\ sub E B D.
264	Proof.
265	  intros E A B C D HE HA HB Hsub.
266	  destruct (sub_arrcomp E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) HE HA Hsub C D
267	              (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HB)) (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HB))
268	              (arr_comp_arrow C D))
269	    as [X [Y [HX [HY [Hac [H1 H2]]]]]].
270	  destruct (ArrComp_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ Hac) as [HXA HYB].
271	  subst X. subst Y. split; assumption.
272	Qed.
273	
274	Lemma my_wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
275	  wf_sig E R -> forall l T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
276	Proof.
277	  intros E R H.
278	  induction H as [ E0 HE0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hpre IHpre HT Hnotin ]; intros l1 T1 Hb.
279	  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb.
280	  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
281	    + injection Heq as Hl HT'. subst. assumption.
282	    + apply (IHpre l1 T1). assumption.
283	Qed.
284	
285	Lemma typing_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l S,
286	  typing E R (exp_ref l) S ->
287	  exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R /\ sub E (typ_box T) S.
288	Proof.
289	  intros E R l S H.
290	  remember (exp_ref l) as e eqn:He.
291	  revert l He.
292	  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
293	  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
294	    exists T0. split.
295	    + assumption.
296	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
297	  - (* typing_ref *) injection He as Hl. subst l0.
298	    exists T. split.
299	    + assumption.
300	    + apply sub_refl.
301	      * assumption.
302	      * apply wf_typ_box. eapply my_wf_sig_binds; eauto.
303	Qed.
304	
305	Lemma typing_wf_sig : forall (E : env) (R : sig) e T,
306	  typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R
307	with typing_record_comp_wf_sig : forall (E : env) (R : sig) r T,
308	  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_sig E R.
309	Proof.
310	  - intros E R e T H. induction H; eauto.
311	  - intros E R r T H. induction H; eauto.
312	Qed.
313	
314	Lemma typing_unbox_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l T,
315	  typing E R (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) T ->
316	  exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\ sub E T0 T.
317	Proof.
318	  intros E R l T H.
319	  remember (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) as e0 eqn:He.
320	  revert l He.
321	  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
322	  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
323	    exists T0. split.
324	    + assumption.
325	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
326	  - (* typing_unbox *) injection He as He1. subst e.
327	    assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); apply (typing_wf_sig E R _ _ H0)).
328	    destruct (typing_ref_inv _ _ _ _ H0) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
329	    assert (Hws : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)).

354	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
355	(* Record-field component analysis of subtyping (one direction)    *)
356	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
357	
358	Section RecordComp.
359	
360	Variable a : atom.
361	
362	Inductive RComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
363	  | rc_here : forall A, RComp (typ_record a A) A
364	  | rc_fvar : forall X A, RComp (typ_fvar X) A
365	  | rc_rofvar : forall m X A, RComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
366	  | rc_int_l : forall X Y A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
367	  | rc_int_r : forall X Y A, RComp Y A -> RComp (typ_int X Y) A
368	  | rc_mut : forall m X A, RComp X A -> RComp (typ_mut m X) A.
369	
370	Lemma RComp_mut_inv : forall m T A, RComp (typ_mut m T) A -> RComp T A.
371	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply rc_fvar. - assumption. Qed.
372	
373	Lemma RComp_int_inv : forall X Y A, RComp (typ_int X Y) A -> RComp X A \/ RComp Y A.
374	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.
375	
376	Lemma RComp_record_inv : forall A B, RComp (typ_record a A) B -> B = A.
377	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. reflexivity. Qed.
378	
379	Lemma RComp_mut_record_inv : forall m a0 T A,
380	  RComp (typ_mut m (typ_record a0 T)) A -> A = T /\ a0 = a.
381	Proof.
382	  intros. inversion H; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); auto;
383	  split; reflexivity.
384	Qed.
385	
386	Lemma RComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
387	  RComp T A -> RComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
388	Proof.
389	  intros T m A H. induction H.
390	  - rewrite merge_record. apply rc_mut. apply rc_here.
391	  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply rc_rofvar.
392	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply rc_rofvar.
393	  - rewrite merge_int. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
394	  - rewrite merge_int. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
395	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply rc_mut. assumption.
396	Qed.
397	
398	Lemma RComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A,
399	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
400	  RComp (merge_mutability T m) A ->
401	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp T A' /\ sub E A' A.
402	Proof.
403	  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A HE HT HA Hac.
404	  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
405	  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
406	  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
407	  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
408	  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
409	  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
410	  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. assert (Hc := RComp_mut_inv m T A Hac).
411	    exists A. repeat split; auto; try assumption; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
412	  - rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
413	    + destruct (IHT1 mm A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
414	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
415	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
416	    + destruct (IHT2 mm A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
417	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
418	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
419	  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
420	    exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_here; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
421	Qed.
422	
423	Lemma RComp_pair_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
424	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RComp T A ->
425	  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ RComp (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
426	Proof.
427	  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
428	  - inversion Hac.
429	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
430	  - rewrite nf_fvar. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
431	  - inversion Hac.
432	  - inversion Hac.
433	  - inversion Hac.
434	  - inversion Hac; subst.
435	    + rewrite nf_mut. rewrite nf_fvar. rewrite merge_fvar. exists A.
436	      repeat split; auto; try apply rc_rofvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
437	    + destruct (IHT A HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA H2)
438	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
439	      rewrite nf_mut. exists A0. repeat split; auto.
440	      apply RComp_merge_fwd with (m := m). assumption.
441	  - inversion Hac; subst.
442	    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
443	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
444	      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
445	    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
446	        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
447	      rewrite nf_int. exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
448	  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
449	    rewrite nf_record. exists (normal_form_typing A).
450	    split.
451	    + apply wf_typ_nf. apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT).
452	    + split.
453	      * apply rc_here.
454	      * apply (of_nf_lem E A HE (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)).
455	Qed.
456	
457	Lemma RComp_src_lift : forall (E : env) T A,
458	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RComp (normal_form_typing T) A ->
459	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp T A' /\ sub E A' A.
460	Proof.
461	  intros E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
462	  - rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
463	  - rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
464	  - rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
465	  - rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
466	  - rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
467	  - rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
468	  - rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
469	    destruct (RComp_merge_rev E (normal_form_typing T) m A HE
470	                (wf_typ_nf _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT)) HA Hac)
471	      as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
472	    destruct (IHT A1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HT) HA1 Hac1)
473	      as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
474	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
475	    + apply rc_mut. assumption.
476	    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
477	  - rewrite nf_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
478	    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
479	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
480	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_l. assumption.
481	    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA H2)
482	        as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
483	      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_int_r. assumption.
484	  - rewrite nf_record in Hac. inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); subst.
485	    exists T. split.
486	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT).
487	    + split.
488	      * apply rc_here.
489	      * apply (to_nf_lem E T HE (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HT)).
490	Qed.
491	
492	Lemma sub_rcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
493	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
494	  forall A, wf_typ E A -> RComp T A ->
495	  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RComp S A' /\ sub E A' A.
496	Proof.
497	  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
498	  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
499	                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
500	                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
501	                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
502	                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
503	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
504	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
505	                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
506	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
507	                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
508	                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
509	                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
510	                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
511	                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
512	                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
513	  intros A HA Hac.
514	  - inversion Hac.
515	  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
516	  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply rc_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
517	  - inversion Hac.
518	  - inversion Hac.
519	  - inversion Hac.
520	  - assert (Hac2 := RComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A Hac).
521	    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
522	      as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
523	    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rc_mut. assumption.
524	  - assert (Hac2 := RComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A Hac).
525	    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
526	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
527	  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
528	    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
529	    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
530	    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 HA2']]].
531	    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
532	    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
533	  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
534	    + apply rc_int_l. assumption.
535	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
536	  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
537	    + apply rc_int_r. assumption.
538	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
539	  - destruct (RComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
540	    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
541	      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
542	    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
543	      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
544	  - inversion Hac; subst.
545	    exists T1. split.
546	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HS).
547	    + split.
548	      * apply rc_here.
549	      * exact H1.
550	  - destruct (RComp_mut_record_inv mut_readonly a0 T2 A Hac) as [HeqA Heqa].
551	    subst A. subst a0.
552	    exists T1. split.
553	    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS)).
554	    + split.
555	      * apply rc_mut. apply rc_here.
556	      * exact H1.
557	  - destruct (RComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 HA0']]].
558	    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
559	    destruct (IHsub HE Hnf A0 HA0 Hac0) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 HA1']]].
560	    destruct (RComp_src_lift E0 T1 A1 HE HSd1 HA1 Hac1) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HA'']]].
561	    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
562	    eapply sub_trans; [exact HA'' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA0']].
563	Qed.
564	
565	End RecordComp.
566	
567	Lemma sub_record_record : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
568	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
569	  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B.
570	Proof.
571	  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
572	  destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub B
573	              (wf_typ_inv_record _ _ _ HB) (rc_here a B))
574	    as [A' [HA' [Hac' H1]]].
575	  assert (Heq : A' = A) by (apply (RComp_record_inv _ _ _ Hac')).
576	  subst A'. exact H1.
577	Qed.
578	
579	Lemma wf_typ_type : forall (E : env) T,
580	  wf_typ E T -> type T.
581	Proof.
582	  intros E T H. induction H.
583	  - apply type_top.
584	  - apply type_var.
585	  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
586	  - apply type_all with (L := L); auto.
587	  - apply type_box; assumption.
588	  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
589	  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
590	  - apply type_record; assumption.
591	Qed.
