                HE HWS Hs T HT (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_tabs_inv E R V0 body (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_all V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_all V0 T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                HE HWS Hs T HT (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)
      as [T0 [Hb Hs]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_box T0) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                HE HWS Hs T HT (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_ref l) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                Hty HE HWf) as [St [Href Hs]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly St))
      by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_mut mut_readonly St)
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) HE HWS Hs T HT
                (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T))) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    assert (Hc' : RComp a St A') by (apply (RComp_mut_inv a mut_readonly St A' Hc)).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l St Href) as [T0 [Hb Hs0]].
    assert (HWB : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE
      (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_ref l) St Href) Hs0)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_box T0) St HE HWB Hs0 A' HA' Hc')

5	(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
6	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
7	
8	Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
9	  wf_typ E1 T ->
10	  forall (E2 : env),
11	    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
12	    wf_typ E2 T.
13	Proof.
14	  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
15	  - constructor.
16	  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
17	  - constructor; auto.
18	  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
19	    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
20	    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
21	    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
22	    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
23	  - constructor; auto.
24	  - constructor; auto.
25	  - constructor; auto.
26	  - constructor; auto.
27	Qed.
28	
29	Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
30	  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
31	  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
32	Proof.
33	  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
34	Qed.
35	
36	
37	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
38	(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
39	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
40	
41	Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
42	  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
43	  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
44	  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
45	  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
46	  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
47	  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.
48	
49	Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
50	  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.
51	Proof.
52	  intros T m A H. induction H.
53	  - rewrite merge_box. apply box_comp_mut. apply box_comp_box.
54	  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply box_comp_rofvar.
55	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply box_comp_rofvar.

From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Type substitution for the locally nameless System F<: variant     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Substitute the free type variable X by U in T.  Because type      *)
(* binders are de Bruijn indices there is no capture problem.        *)
Fixpoint subst_tt (X : atom) (U T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar Y => if (Y === X) then U else typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
  | typ_box T1 => typ_box (subst_tt X U T1)
  | typ_mut M T1 => typ_mut M (subst_tt X U T1)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tt X U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (subst_tt X U T1)
  end.

(* Apply subst_tt to every type annotation of an expression.         *)
Fixpoint subst_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te X U e1) (subst_tt X U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (subst_te X U b) (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (subst_te X U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (subst_te_record X U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (subst_te X U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (subst_te X U e1) a (subst_te X U e2)
  end
with subst_te_record (X : atom) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (subst_te X U e) (subst_te_record X U r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (subst_te_record X U r)
  end.

(* Apply subst_tt to the type of a binding, preserving its kind.     *)
Definition subst_binding (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt X U T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt X U T)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tt_env (X : atom) (U : typ) (E : env) {struct E} : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, b) :: E' => (x, subst_binding X U b) :: subst_tt_env X U E'
  end.

(* Free type-variable atoms occurring in the type annotations of an  *)
(* expression / record component.                                    *)
Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => {}
  | exp_fvar _ => {}
  | exp_abs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_te e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => fv_te e1 `union` fv_te e2
  | exp_tabs V e1 => fv_typ V `union` fv_te e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => fv_te e1 `union` fv_typ V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => fv_te e1 `union` fv_te e2
  | exp_box e => fv_te e
  | exp_unbox e => fv_te e
  | exp_set_box b e => fv_te b `union` fv_te e
  | exp_ref _ => {}
  | exp_seal e => fv_te e
  | exp_record r => fv_te_record r
  | exp_record_read e _ => fv_te e

Proof. intros T H K U. apply (lc_at_open_id T 0 H K U). lia. Qed.

Lemma type_closed : forall T, type T -> closed_typ T.

  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_rec_subst_comm : forall K (T : typ) (X : atom) (V : typ) (Y : atom),

Lemma open_tt_rec_subst2 : forall K (T2 : typ) (X : atom) (V : typ) (T : typ),

Lemma fv_typ_dom : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T -> forall X, X `in` fv_typ T -> X `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H as [ E
    | U E Z Hb
    | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
    | E T1 H1 IH1
    | E T1 H1 IH1
    | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | E a T1 H1 IH1 ]; intros X Hfv.
  - simpl in Hfv. exfalso. exact (notin_empty X Hfv).
  - simpl in Hfv. apply singleton_iff in Hfv. subst X.
    apply (in_dom_binds E Z (bind_sub U) Hb).
  - simpl in Hfv. apply union_iff in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hfv|Hfv].
    + apply IH1. exact Hfv.
    + apply IH2. exact Hfv.
  - simpl in Hfv. apply union_iff in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hfv|Hfv].
    + apply IH1. exact Hfv.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` {{ X }})) as [Y HY].
      assert (HYL : Y `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HY; assumption).
      assert (HYX : Y <> X)
        by (apply notin_union_2 in HY; apply notin_singleton_1' in HY; symmetry; exact HY).
      assert (Hfvo : X `in` fv_typ (open_tt T2 Y))
        by (apply (fv_typ_open_tt_fvar_in T2 0 Y X Hfv)).
      pose proof (IHbody Y HYL X Hfvo) as Hdom.
      simpl in Hdom. rewrite add_iff in Hdom. destruct Hdom as [Heq|Hin].
      * exfalso. exact (HYX Heq).
      * exact Hin.
  - simpl in Hfv. apply IH1. exact Hfv.
  - simpl in Hfv. apply IH1. exact Hfv.
  - simpl in Hfv. apply union_iff in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hfv|Hfv].
    + apply IH1. exact Hfv.
    + apply IH2. exact Hfv.
  - simpl in Hfv. apply IH1. exact Hfv.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_weaken_prefix : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R ->
  forall (F : env), wf_env (F ++ E) -> wf_sig (F ++ E) R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [ E0 HE0 | E0 R0 l T Hpre IHpre HT Hnotin ].
  - intros F HF. apply wf_sig_empty. exact HF.
  - intros F HF. apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IHpre. exact HF.
    + apply (wf_typ_weaken E0 T HT F).
    + exact Hnotin.
Qed.

Fixpoint fv_sig (R : sig) : atoms :=
  match R with
  | nil => {}
  | (l, bind_sig T) :: R' => fv_typ T `union` fv_sig R'
  end.

Lemma wf_sig_subst_gen : forall (A E : env) (R : sig) X U,
  wf_env (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) ->
  wf_sig (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) R ->
  X `notin` fv_sig R ->
  forall V, closed_typ V -> wf_typ E V ->
  wf_sig (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E) R.
Proof.
  intros A E R X U Hwf H Hfv V Hc HV.
  remember (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) as E0 eqn:He.
  revert A E X U Hwf Hfv V Hc HV He.
  induction H as [ E0 HE0 | E0 R0 l T Hpre IHpre HT Hnotin ];
    intros A E X U Hwf Hfv V Hc HV He.
  - subst E0. apply wf_sig_empty.
    apply (wf_env_subst_gen A E X U Hwf V Hc HV).
  - subst E0. apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply (IHpre A E X U Hwf).
      * simpl in Hfv. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv. exact Hfv.
      * exact Hc.
      * exact HV.
      * reflexivity.

    + assert (HnotinT : X `notin` fv_typ T)
        by (simpl in Hfv; apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv).
      assert (Heq : subst_tt X V T = T) by (apply subst_tt_id; exact HnotinT).
      rewrite <- Heq.
      destruct (wf_env_mid_notin A E X U Hwf) as [HnotA HnotE].
      apply (wf_typ_subst_gen A X U E T HnotA HnotE HT V Hc).
      apply (wf_typ_weaken E V HV (subst_tt_env X V A)).
    + exact Hnotin.
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork SubWeaken Narrow.

Lemma sub_narrow : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U' S T,
  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 ->
  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) ->
  wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) S ->
  wf_typ E2 U' ->
  sub E2 U' U ->
  sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) S T ->
  sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) S T.
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U U' S T Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HS1 HU' HsubU Hsub.
  remember (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) as E0 eqn:He.
  revert E1 E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HS1 HU' HsubU He.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S HE0 HS0
                 | E0 Y HE0 HS0
                 | U0 E0 T0 Y Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
    intros E1 E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HS1 HU' HsubU He; subst E0.
  - assert (Hwfnew : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2))
      by (apply (wf_env_narrow E1 E2 X U U'); assumption).
    apply sub_top; [assumption |].
    eapply wf_typ_kind.
    + exact HS1.
    + intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow.
  - assert (Hwfnew : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2))
      by (apply (wf_env_narrow E1 E2 X U U'); assumption).
    apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption |].
    eapply wf_typ_kind.
    + exact HS1.
    + intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow.
  - assert (Hwfnew : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2))
      by (apply (wf_env_narrow E1 E2 X U U'); assumption).
    destruct (Y == X) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst Y.
      assert (HeqU : U0 = U) by (apply (binds_mid_eq E1 E2 X U U0 Hb); assumption).
      subst U0.
      assert (HUold : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) U).
      { apply (wf_env_binds_sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) Hwf X U Hb). }
      assert (HpreU : sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) U T0)
        by (apply (IHpre E1 E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HUold HU' HsubU eq_refl)).
      apply (sub_trans_tvar U' (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) T0 X).
      * apply (binds_mid_self E1 E2 X (bind_sub U')).
      * eapply sub_trans; [| exact HpreU].
        apply (sub_weaken_incl E2 U' U (wf_env_app_mid E1 E2 X (bind_sub U) Hwf) HU' HsubU
                 (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) Hwfnew).
        intros x b Hx. apply binds_app_2. apply binds_cons_2. assumption.
    + assert (Hbnew : binds Y (bind_sub U0) (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (proj1 (binds_narrow_neq E1 E2 X U U' Y (bind_sub U0) Hneq)). assumption. }
      assert (HUold : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) U0)
        by (apply (wf_env_binds_sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) Hwf Y U0 Hb)).
      apply (sub_trans_tvar U0 (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) T0 Y Hbnew).
      apply (IHpre E1 E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HUold HU' HsubU eq_refl).
  - assert (Hwfnew : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2))
      by (apply (wf_env_narrow E1 E2 X U U'); assumption).
    destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow _ _ _ HS1) as [HSa HSb].
    assert (HT1 : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) T1)
      by (apply (sub_wf_source _ T1 S1 Hwf HSa H1)).
    apply sub_arrow.
    + apply (IH1 E1 E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HT1 HU' HsubU eq_refl).
    + apply (IH2 E1 E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HSb HU' HsubU eq_refl).
  - assert (Hwfnew : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2))
      by (apply (wf_env_narrow E1 E2 X U U'); assumption).
    destruct (wf_typ_inv_all _ _ _ HS1) as [L1 [HSa HSb]].
    assert (HT1 : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) T1)
      by (apply (sub_wf_source _ T1 S1 Hwf HSa H1)).
    assert (HT1new : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) T1).
    { eapply wf_typ_kind. exact HT1. intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow. }
    apply (sub_all (L0 `union` L1 `union` dom E1 `union` dom E2 `union` {{ X }})
              (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) S1 S2 T1 T2).

Lemma wf_typ_nf_gen : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T ->
  forall (E' : env), same_kinds E E' -> wf_typ E' (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hsk.
  - rewrite nf_top. constructor.
  - rewrite nf_fvar. destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
    apply (wf_typ_var U' E' X). assumption.
  - rewrite nf_arrow. constructor; auto.
  - rewrite nf_all. apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
    + apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
    + intros X HX.
      specialize (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub (normal_form_typing T1) ++ E')).
      assert (Heq : open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) X = normal_form_typing (open_tt T2 X)).
      { symmetry. apply (nf_open_tt 0 X T2). }
      rewrite Heq. apply H1. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_box. constructor. apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_mut. apply merge_wf. apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_int. constructor; auto.
  - rewrite nf_record. constructor. apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E (normal_form_typing T).
Proof. intros. apply (wf_typ_nf_gen _ _ H E). apply same_kinds_refl. Qed.

(* Reflexivity of subtyping and normal-form conversion              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma sub_refl : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T T.
Proof.
  intros E T HE H. revert HE.
  induction H as [ E0
                 | U E0 X Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ]; intros HE.
  - apply sub_top; [assumption | constructor].
  - apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption | eapply wf_typ_var; eauto].
  - apply sub_arrow; auto.
  - apply (sub_all (L `union` dom E0) E0 T1 T2 T1 T2).
    + apply IH1; assumption.
    + intros X HX.
      apply (IH0 X).
      * apply notin_union_1 in HX. assumption.
      * apply (wf_env_sub E0 X T1); auto.
  - apply sub_box; [apply IH1; assumption | apply IH1; assumption].
  - apply sub_readonly; apply IH1; assumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply (sub_inter_left E0 T1 T2); assumption.
    + apply (sub_inter_right E0 T1 T2); assumption.
  - apply sub_record; [apply IH1; assumption | apply IH1; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma sub_to_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros. apply (sub_denormalize E T (normal_form_typing T)); auto.
  - apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_idem. apply sub_refl; auto. apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_of_nf : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E (normal_form_typing T) T.
Proof.
  intros. apply (sub_denormalize E (normal_form_typing T) T); auto.
  - apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_idem. apply sub_refl; auto. apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_narrow : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  same_kinds (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y b] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U'; simpl.
  - apply (same_kinds_cons_sub_any E2 E2 X U U'). apply same_kinds_refl.
  - destruct b as [U0 | T0].
    + apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply IH.
    + apply same_kinds_cons_typ. apply IH.

Lemma dom_narrow_eq : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) [=] dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y b] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U'; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (H := IH E2 X U U'). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_eq : forall (E1 E2 : env) (x : atom),
  dom E1 [=] dom E2 -> x `notin` dom E1 -> x `notin` dom E2.
Proof. intros. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_sub_full : forall (E : env) X T,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_typ_full : forall (E : env) X T,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_typ T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_narrow : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 ->
  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) ->
  wf_typ E2 U' ->
  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y b] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U' Hnd1 Hnd2 Hwf HU'; simpl in *.
  - destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwe HwU].
    apply (wf_env_sub E2 X U' Hwe HU' Hnd2).
  - destruct b as [U0 | T0].
    + destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub_full _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwe [Hwt Ynotin]].
      assert (Hwe' : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (IH E2 X U U').
        - intro Hc. apply Hnd1. apply (proj2 (in_dom_cons E1 X Y (bind_sub U0))). right. assumption.
        - exact Hnd2. - exact Hwe. - exact HU'. }
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) U0).
      { eapply wf_typ_kind. exact Hwt.
        intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow. }
      assert (Hnot : Y `notin` dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (notin_dom_eq (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2)).
        - apply dom_narrow_eq. - exact Ynotin. }
      apply (wf_env_sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) Y U0); assumption.
    + destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ_full _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwe [Hwt Ynotin]].
      assert (Hwe' : wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (IH E2 X U U').
        - intro Hc. apply Hnd1. apply (proj2 (in_dom_cons E1 X Y (bind_typ T0))). right. assumption.
        - exact Hnd2. - exact Hwe. - exact HU'. }
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) T0).
      { eapply wf_typ_kind. exact Hwt.
        intros Z. apply same_kinds_narrow. }
      assert (Hnot : Y `notin` dom (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
      { apply (notin_dom_eq (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2)).
        - apply dom_narrow_eq. - exact Ynotin. }
      apply (wf_env_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) Y T0); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_narrow_neq : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U' Y b,
  Y <> X ->
  (binds Y b (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) <->
   binds Y b (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2)).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Z c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U' Y b Hne; simpl.
  - split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY Hb. subst Y. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + right. assumption.
    + injection Heq as HY Hb. subst Y. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + right. assumption.
  - split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj1 (IH E2 X U U' Y b Hne)); assumption.
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj2 (IH E2 X U U' Y b Hne)); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_eq : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U0,
  binds X (bind_sub U0) (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) ->
  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 -> U0 = U.
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Z c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X U U0 Hb Hnd1 Hnd2; simpl in *.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hnd2. apply in_dom_binds in Hin. assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HX Hc. exfalso. apply Hnd1.
      apply (proj2 (in_dom_cons E1 X Z c)). left. symmetry. exact HX.
    + apply (IH E2 X U U0 Hin).
      * intro Hc. apply Hnd1. apply (proj2 (in_dom_cons E1 X Z c)). right. assumption.
      * assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_self : forall (E1 E2 : env) X (b : binding),
  binds X b (E1 ++ X ~ b ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X b; simpl.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - right. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_app_mid : forall (E1 E2 : env) X (b : binding),
  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ b ++ E2) -> wf_env E2.
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [Y c] E1 IH]; intros E2 X b Hwf; simpl in *.
  - destruct b as [U0|T0];
    [ destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub_full _ _ _ Hwf) as [H _] |
      destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ_full _ _ _ Hwf) as [H _] ]; exact H.
  - destruct c as [U0|T0].
    + destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_sub_full _ _ _ Hwf) as [H _].
      apply (IH E2 X b H).
    + destruct (wf_env_cons_bind_typ_full _ _ _ Hwf) as [H _].
      apply (IH E2 X b H).
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_app_mid : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U T,
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) T.
Proof.
  intros. apply (wf_typ_incl E1 T H (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2)).
  intros Y U0 Hb. apply in_or_app. left. exact Hb.
Qed.

  dom (E1 ++ E2) [=] dom E1 `union` dom E2.

  - fsetdec.

Lemma typing_record_inv : forall E R r T,
  typing E R (exp_record r) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\ sub E Tr T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T H. remember (exp_record r) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [Tr [Hr' Hs]].
    exists Tr. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - injection He as Hx. subst rb.
    exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 T0 HE Ht).
Qed.

Lemma typing_exp_record_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing E R (exp_record r) T ->
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\ sub E Tr T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T Hty.
  remember (exp_record r) as e eqn:He.
  revert He.
  revert r.
  induction Hty; intros rr Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHHty rr Heq) as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
    exists Tr. split; [exact Hrc | eapply sub_trans; eauto].
  - (* typing_record *)
    injection Heq as Hrr. subst rr.
    exists T. split.
    + exact H.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R).
        apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r T H).
      * apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r T H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Component analysis: a ref field of a value record component.     *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* If a value record [r] (whose components are all [rec_ref]) has a *)
(* component [A] at label [a], then [a] is a ref field of [r] whose *)
(* label is bound in [R] with some type [Tf], and [Tf] is a         *)
(* subtype of [A].                                                  *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_field :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ) (a : atom) (A : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    value_record_comp r ->
   NOTE (close variant).  The requested conclusion was
   [sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T)].  The one-directional
   component analysis [sub_rcomp] only gives [sub E Tf T], which is
   the statement proved here.  The record-level conclusion additionally
   needs the reverse component subtyping [sub E T Tf] (record subtyping
   [sub_record] is invariant); with both it follows immediately from
   [sub_record].  The field component relation below is exactly what
   [typing_sub] needs to retype the store value read at the label. *)
Lemma record_field_nonro : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                  (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [H|H].
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [y b'] E IH]; intros x b Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - apply (in_dom_cons E x y b'). simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply (IH x b). assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Free atoms of a type                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}
Lemma wf_typ_weaken_cons1 : forall (E : env) X (b : binding) T,
  wf_typ E T -> wf_typ ((X,b)::E) T.
Proof. intros E X b T H. apply (wf_typ_weaken E T H ((X,b)::nil)). Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* wf_env                                                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros E R H. induction H. assumption. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_typ : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_sub : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_sub T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_typ : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_typ T) E -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
  - inversion Hy.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_sub : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_sub T) E -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
  - inversion Hy.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Strengthening wf_typ                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

      * exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv : forall (E : env) X T,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma test_wf_env_cons_bind_typ_inv : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) ->
  wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T /\ x `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_mid_notin : forall (A E : env) X U,
  wf_env (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) ->
  X `notin` dom A /\ X `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Y b] A IH]; intros E X U H; simpl in *.
  - destruct (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv E X U H) as [_ [_ Hnot]].
    split; [simpl; apply notin_empty | exact Hnot].
  - destruct b.
    + destruct (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y t H)
        as [Htail [Htyp HnotY]].
      destruct (IH E X U Htail) as [HnotA HnotE].
      split; [|exact HnotE].
      simpl. rewrite add_iff. intros [Heq|Hin].
      * rewrite Heq in HnotY.
        apply HnotY.
        apply (proj2 (test_in_dom_app A (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) X)). right.
        apply in_dom_cons. left. reflexivity.
      * apply HnotA. exact Hin.
    + destruct (test_wf_env_cons_bind_typ_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y t H)
        as [Htail [Htyp HnotY]].
      destruct (IH E X U Htail) as [HnotA HnotE].
      split; [|exact HnotE].
      simpl. rewrite add_iff. intros [Heq|Hin].
      * rewrite Heq in HnotY.
        apply HnotY.
        apply (proj2 (test_in_dom_app A (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) X)). right.
        apply in_dom_cons. left. reflexivity.
      * apply HnotA. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_tail_mid : forall (A E : env) X U,
  wf_env (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Y b] A IH]; intros E X U H; simpl in *.
  - apply (proj1 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv E X U H)).
  - destruct b.
    + apply (IH E X U (proj1 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y t H))).
    + apply (IH E X U (proj1 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_typ_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y t H))).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_mid_typ : forall (A E : env) X U,
  wf_env (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) -> wf_typ E U.
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Y b] A IH]; intros E X U H; simpl in *.
  - apply (proj1 (proj2 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv E X U H))).
  - destruct b.
    + apply (IH E X U (proj1 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y t H))).
    + apply (IH E X U (proj1 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_typ_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y t H))).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_subst_gen : forall (A E : env) X U,
  wf_env (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) ->
  forall V, closed_typ V -> wf_typ E V ->
  wf_env (subst_tt_env X V A ++ E).
Proof.
  induction A as [| [Y b] A IH]; intros E X U H V Hc HV; simpl in *.
  - apply (proj1 (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv E X U H)).
  - destruct b as [T|T].
    + destruct (test_wf_env_cons_bind_sub_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y T H)
        as [Htail [Htyp HnotY]].
      destruct (wf_env_mid_notin A E X U Htail) as [HnotA HnotE].
      apply wf_env_sub.
      * apply (IH E X U Htail V Hc HV).
      * apply (wf_typ_subst_gen A X U E T HnotA HnotE Htyp V Hc).
        apply (wf_typ_weaken E V HV (subst_tt_env X V A)).
      * apply (proj2 (test_notin_dom_subst_env A E X V Y)).
        split.
        -- destruct (test_notin_dom_app A (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y HnotY) as [HA _].
           exact HA.
        -- destruct (test_notin_dom_app A (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y HnotY) as [_ HXE].
           destruct (test_notin_dom_app (X ~ bind_sub U) E Y HXE) as [_ HE].
           exact HE.
    + destruct (test_wf_env_cons_bind_typ_inv (A ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) Y T H)
        as [Htail [Htyp HnotY]].

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Basic list / environment facts                                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_app_1 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. left. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_app_2 : forall (E F : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b F -> binds x b (E ++ F).
Proof. intros. apply in_or_app. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_1 : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b ((x,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. left. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_2 : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a E -> binds x a ((y,b)::E).
Proof. intros. simpl. right. assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_inv : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> (x,a) = (y,b) \/ binds x a E.
Proof. intros. simpl in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_neq : forall (E : env) x y (a b : binding),
  x <> y -> binds x a ((y,b)::E) -> binds x a E.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Heq | Hin].
  inversion Heq. subst. exfalso. apply H. reflexivity. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_cons : forall (E : env) x y (b : binding),
  x `in` dom ((y,b)::E) <-> x = y \/ x `in` dom E.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite add_iff. split; intros [H|H].
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. symmetry. assumption.
  - right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_binds : forall (E : env) x (b : binding),
  binds x b E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [y b'] E IH]; intros x b Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - apply (in_dom_cons E x y b'). simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply (IH x b). assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Free atoms of a type                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_bvar _ => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_box T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_mut _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  | typ_int T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 `union` fv_typ T2
  | typ_record _ T1 => fv_typ T1
  end.

Lemma fv_typ_open_tt : forall (T : typ) K (U : typ) X,
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X `notin` fv_typ U ->
  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K U T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros K U X HT HU; simpl in *.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K == n) eqn:E; simpl.
    + assumption.
    + auto.
  - auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
  - simpl. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_typ_open_tt_fvar : forall (T : typ) K (Y X : atom),
  X `notin` fv_typ T -> X <> Y ->
  X `notin` fv_typ (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T).
Proof.
  intros T K Y X HT HXY.
  assert (Hnot : X `notin` fv_typ (typ_fvar Y)).
  { simpl. apply notin_singleton. auto. }
  eapply fv_typ_open_tt; eauto.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Well-formed types depend only on the bindings available           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_binds_iff : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env), (forall x b, binds x b E1 <-> binds x b E2) -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hiff.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply (proj1 (Hiff X (bind_sub U))). assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros y b. simpl. split; intros [Heq | Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
    + left; assumption.
    + right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_app_iff : forall (E E' : env) X (T : binding) y (b : binding),
  binds y b (((X,T)::E') ++ ((X,T)::E)) <-> binds y b ((X,T)::(E'++E)).
Proof. intros. unfold binds. repeat rewrite in_app_iff. simpl. rewrite in_app_iff. tauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T -> forall (E' : env), wf_typ (E' ++ E) T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E'.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U (E' ++ E) X). apply binds_app_2. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
    + auto.
    + intros X HX. eapply wf_typ_binds_iff.
      * apply (H1 X HX (((X, bind_sub T1) :: E'))).
      * apply binds_cons_app_iff.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken_cons1 : forall (E : env) X (b : binding) T,
  wf_typ E T -> wf_typ ((X,b)::E) T.
Proof. intros E X b T H. apply (wf_typ_weaken E T H ((X,b)::nil)). Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* wf_env                                                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros E R H. induction H. assumption. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_typ : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_bind_sub : forall (E : env) x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_sub T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_typ : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_typ T) E -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
  - inversion Hy.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_sub : forall (E : env), wf_env E ->
  forall x T, binds x (bind_sub T) E -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros y Ty Hy.
  - inversion Hy.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hy' Hu. subst. eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
  - apply binds_cons_inv in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_cons1; eauto.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Strengthening wf_typ                                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma binds_cons_iff_lift : forall (E1 E2 : env) (Y : atom) (T : binding),
  (forall y b, binds y b E1 <-> binds y b E2) ->
  forall y b, binds y b ((Y,T)::E1) <-> binds y b ((Y,T)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 Y T Hiff y b. simpl. split; intros [Hc|Hin].
  - left; assumption.
  - right. apply (proj1 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
  - left; assumption.
  - right. apply (proj2 (Hiff y b)); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_swap_cons : forall (E : env) X (T : binding) Y (U : binding) y b,
  binds y b ((X,T)::(Y,U)::E) <-> binds y b ((Y,U)::(X,T)::E).
Proof. intros. unfold binds. simpl. tauto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_bind_typ_app : forall (E1 E2 : env) x V (Y : atom) (U : binding) y b,
  (forall z c, binds z c E1 <-> binds z c (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) ->
  (binds y b ((Y,U)::E1) <-> binds y b ((x, bind_typ V)::(Y,U)::E2)).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 x V Y U y b Hiff.
  etransitivity.
  - apply (binds_cons_iff_lift E1 (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) Y U Hiff).
  - apply binds_swap_cons.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_remove_bind_typ : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env) x V,
    (forall y b, binds y b E1 <-> binds y b (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) ->
    x `notin` fv_typ T ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H.
  induction H as [ E
                  | U E X Hb
                  | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                  | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                  | E T H1 IH1
                  | E T H1 IH1
                  | E T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                  | E a T1 H1 IH1 ];
  intros E2 x V Hiff Hfv.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X).
    apply (proj1 (Hiff X (bind_sub U))) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + assumption.
  - constructor.
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
    + apply IH2 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_2 in Hfv. assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{ x }}).
    + apply IH1 with (x := x) (V := V).
      * assumption.
      * apply notin_union_1 in Hfv. assumption.
    + intros Y HY.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork SubNarrow.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* All-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive AllComp : typ -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | all_comp_all : forall A B, AllComp (typ_all A B) A B
  | all_comp_fvar : forall X A B, AllComp (typ_fvar X) A B
  | all_comp_rofvar : forall m X A B, AllComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A B
  | all_comp_int_l : forall X Y A B, AllComp X A B -> AllComp (typ_int X Y) A B
  | all_comp_int_r : forall X Y A B, AllComp Y A B -> AllComp (typ_int X Y) A B
  | all_comp_mut : forall m X A B, AllComp X A B -> AllComp (typ_mut m X) A B.

Lemma AllComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A B,
  AllComp T A B -> AllComp (merge_mutability T m) A B.
Proof.
  intros T m A B H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_all. apply all_comp_all.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply all_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply all_comp_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply all_comp_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply all_comp_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply all_comp_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma AllComp_mut_inv : forall m T A B, AllComp (typ_mut m T) A B -> AllComp T A B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply all_comp_fvar. - assumption. Qed.

Lemma AllComp_int_inv : forall X Y A B,
  AllComp (typ_int X Y) A B -> AllComp X A B \/ AllComp Y A B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.

Lemma AllComp_all_inv : forall A B C D,
  AllComp (typ_all A B) C D -> C = A /\ D = B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_sig_cons : forall (R : sig) (l0 : label) (T0 : typ)
                              (l : label) (T : typ),
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) (l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R) <->
  (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros.
  change (Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) ((l0, bind_sig T0) :: R) <->
          (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R).
  rewrite Signatures.binds_cons_iff.
  split; intro H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl Hs] | H].
    + left. split; auto. injection Hs as HT. exact HT.
    + right. exact H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl HT] | H].
    + left. split; auto. rewrite HT. reflexivity.
    + right. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_app : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig),
  wf_sig E R1 -> wf_sig E R2 ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R1 ->
      ~ (LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2))) ->
  wf_sig E (R1 ++ R2).
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 H1.
  induction H1 as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intros H2 Hdisj.
  - simpl. exact H2.
  - change (wf_sig E0 ((l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0) ++ R2)).
    simpl. apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IH.
      * exact H2.
      * intros l T Hb.
        exact (Hdisj l T
                 (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l T) (or_intror Hb))).
    + exact Hwt.
    + intro Hin. apply (proj1 (sig_dom_app R0 R2 l0)) in Hin.
      destruct Hin as [Hin1 | Hin2].
      * exact (Hnot Hin1).
      * exact (Hdisj l0 T0
                 (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l0 T0)
                        (or_introl (conj eq_refl eq_refl))) Hin2).
Qed.

(* 3. Fresh label properties                                         *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma fresh_label_notin_sig_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
                                        (s : store) (l : label),
  typing_store E R s ->
  l = fresh_label_for_store s ->
  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hfresh Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HMaps].
  apply (fresh_label_not_maps s l v).
  - symmetry. exact Hfresh.
  - exact HMaps.
Qed.

  typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R
with typing_record_wf_sig_mut : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),

  (forall v, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hnot Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HM].
  exact (Hnot v HM).
Qed.

   an old entry.  Old values are retyped under the extended signature via

                                (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),

  typing_store E R s ->
  (forall v0, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v0 s) ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).

  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  assert (Hnot : ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R)) by
    (apply (typing_store_notin_dom E R s l Hts); exact Hfresh).
  assert (Hwf : wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R)) by
    (apply wf_sig_typ; [exact Hws | exact Hwt | exact Hnot]).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb.
    apply (proj1 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Hl HT] | Hb1].
    + subst l0. subst T0.
      exists v. split.
      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
      * split.
        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
        -- exact Hval.
    + assert (Hneq : l <> l0).
      { intro Heq. subst l0.
        apply Hnot.
        exact (Signatures.binds_In signature l (bind_sig T0) R Hb1). }
      destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
      exists v0. split.
      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0
                       Hneq) HM).
      * split.
        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
        -- exact Hval0.
  - intros v0 HM.
    apply (proj1 (LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff (elt := exp)
                    s l l0 v v0)) in HM.
    destruct HM as [[Hl Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
    + subst l0. subst v0.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
      * apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R l T l T)). left.
        split; reflexivity.
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
      * apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)). right. exact Hb0.
Qed.

(* Replace/insert the store entry at an already-bound label.  The type
   is forced by the signature (using well-formedness/uniqueness of
   bindings), so the new value simply has to inhabit that type. *)
Lemma typing_store_update : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                   (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hts Hb Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb0.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst l0.
      assert (HT : T0 = T) by
        (exact (wf_sig_binds_uniq E R l T0 T Hws Hb0 Hb)).
      subst T0.
      exists v. split.
      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
      * split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb0) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
      exists v0. split.
      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0
                       Hneq) HM).
      * split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hval0].
  - intros v0 HM.
    apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff in HM.
    destruct HM as [[Heq Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
    + subst l0. subst v0.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split; [exact Hty | exact Hb].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hb0].
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_add : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)

  typing_store E R s ->

  typing E R v T ->

      exists v0. split.
      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0

      * split.
        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
        -- exact Hval0.

Lemma typing_store_update : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                   (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hts Hb Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb0.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst l0.

      subst T0.

      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
      * split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].

      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hb0].

4	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
5	(* All-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
6	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
7	
8	Inductive AllComp : typ -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
9	  | all_comp_all : forall A B, AllComp (typ_all A B) A B
10	  | all_comp_fvar : forall X A B, AllComp (typ_fvar X) A B
11	  | all_comp_rofvar : forall m X A B, AllComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A B
12	  | all_comp_int_l : forall X Y A B, AllComp X A B -> AllComp (typ_int X Y) A B
13	  | all_comp_int_r : forall X Y A B, AllComp Y A B -> AllComp (typ_int X Y) A B
14	  | all_comp_mut : forall m X A B, AllComp X A B -> AllComp (typ_mut m X) A B.
15	
16	Lemma AllComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A B,
17	  AllComp T A B -> AllComp (merge_mutability T m) A B.
18	Proof.
19	  intros T m A B H. induction H.
20	  - rewrite merge_all. apply all_comp_all.
21	  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply all_comp_rofvar.
22	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply all_comp_rofvar.
23	  - rewrite merge_int. apply all_comp_int_l. assumption.
24	  - rewrite merge_int. apply all_comp_int_r. assumption.
25	  - rewrite merge_mut. apply all_comp_mut. assumption.
26	Qed.
27	
28	Lemma AllComp_mut_inv : forall m T A B, AllComp (typ_mut m T) A B -> AllComp T A B.
29	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply all_comp_fvar. - assumption. Qed.
30	
31	Lemma AllComp_int_inv : forall X Y A B,
32	  AllComp (typ_int X Y) A B -> AllComp X A B \/ AllComp Y A B.
33	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.
34	
35	Lemma AllComp_all_inv : forall A B C D,
36	  AllComp (typ_all A B) C D -> C = A /\ D = B.
37	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

39	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
40	(* Basic body-relation helpers                                      *)
41	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
42	
43	Lemma wf_body_kind : forall (E : env) A A' B L0,
44	  (forall X, X `notin` L0 -> wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B X)) ->
45	  exists L, forall X, X `notin` L ->
46	    wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A' ++ E) (open_tt B X).
47	Proof.
48	  intros E A A' B L0 H. exists L0. intros X HX.
49	  eapply wf_typ_kind.
50	  - apply H. assumption.
51	  - intros Z. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. apply same_kinds_refl.
52	Qed.

54	Lemma body_sub_refl : forall (E : env) A B L0,
55	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
56	  (forall X, X `notin` L0 -> wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B X)) ->
57	  exists L, forall X, X `notin` L ->
58	    sub (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B X) (open_tt B X).
59	Proof.
60	  intros E A B L0 HE HA Hbody.
61	  exists (L0 `union` dom E). intros X HX.
62	  assert (HX0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
63	  assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
64	  apply sub_refl.
65	  - apply (wf_env_sub E X A HE HA HXd).
66	  - apply Hbody. assumption.
67	Qed.

70	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
71	  (forall X, X `notin` L1 ->
72	    wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B X)) ->
73	  (forall X, X `notin` L0 ->
74	    sub (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X)) ->
75	  exists L, forall X, X `notin` L ->
76	    wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B' X).
77	Proof.
78	  intros E A B' B L0 L1 HE HA HwB Hsub.
79	  exists ((L0 `union` L1) `union` dom E). intros X HX.
80	  assert (HX01 : X `notin` (L0 `union` L1))
81	    by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; assumption).
82	  assert (HX0 : X `notin` L0) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX01; assumption).
83	  assert (HX1 : X `notin` L1) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX01; assumption).
84	  assert (HXd : X `notin` dom E) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; assumption).
85	  apply (sub_wf_source (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X)).
86	  - apply (wf_env_sub E X A HE HA HXd).
87	  - apply HwB. assumption.
88	  - apply Hsub. assumption.
89	Qed.

91	Lemma body_sub_narrow : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U' B' B,
92	  X `notin` dom E1 -> X `notin` dom E2 ->
93	  wf_env (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) ->
94	  wf_typ (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) (open_tt B' X) ->
95	  wf_typ E2 U' ->
96	  sub E2 U' U ->
97	  sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E2) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X) ->
98	  sub (E1 ++ X ~ bind_sub U' ++ E2) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X).
99	Proof.
100	  intros. eapply sub_narrow; eauto.
101	Qed.
102	
103	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
104	(* merge_mutability inversion                                       *)
105	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
106	
107	Lemma AllComp_merge_rev : forall (E : env) T m A B L0,
108	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
109	  (forall X, X `notin` L0 -> wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B X)) ->
110	  AllComp (merge_mutability T m) A B ->
111	  exists A' B' L, wf_typ E A' /\ AllComp T A' B' /\ sub E A A' /\
112	    (forall X, X `notin` L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X)).
113	Proof.
114	  intros E T. induction T; intros mm A B L0 HE HT HA Hbody Hac.
115	  - (* top *) rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
116	  - (* bvar *) rewrite merge_bvar in Hac.
117	    inversion Hac; subst; try discriminate; try (inversion H2).
118	  - (* fvar *) rewrite merge_fvar in Hac.
119	    inversion Hac; subst.
120	    + exists A, B. repeat split; auto.
121	      * apply all_comp_fvar.
122	      * apply sub_refl; assumption.
123	      * apply body_sub_refl; assumption.
124	    + exists A, B. repeat split; auto.
125	      * assumption.
126	      * apply sub_refl; assumption.
127	      * apply body_sub_refl; assumption.
128	  - (* arrow *) rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
129	  - (* all *) rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
130	    exists A, B. repeat split; auto.
131	    + apply all_comp_all.
132	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
133	    + apply body_sub_refl; assumption.
134	  - (* box *) rewrite merge_box in Hac.
135	    inversion Hac; subst; try discriminate; try (inversion H2).
136	  - (* mut *) rewrite merge_mut in Hac.
137	    assert (Hac0 : AllComp T A B)
138	      by (apply AllComp_mut_inv with (m := mm); exact Hac).
139	    exists A, B. repeat split; auto.
140	    + exact Hac.
141	    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
142	    + apply body_sub_refl; assumption.
143	  - (* int *) rewrite merge_int in Hac. inversion Hac; subst.
144	    + destruct (IHT1 mm A B L0 HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA Hbody H2)
145	        as [A' [B' [L [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HB']]]]]].
146	      exists A', B', L. repeat split; auto. apply all_comp_int_l. assumption.
147	    + destruct (IHT2 mm A B L0 HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter _ _ _ HT)) HA Hbody H2)
148	        as [A' [B' [L [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HB']]]]]].
149	      exists A', B', L. repeat split; auto. apply all_comp_int_r. assumption.
150	  - (* record *) rewrite merge_record in Hac.
151	    inversion Hac; subst; try discriminate; try (inversion H2).
152	Qed.

Lemma sub_boxcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall A, wf_typ E A -> BoxComp T A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ BoxComp S A' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E A' A.
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
  intros A HA Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - exists A. repeat split; auto; try apply box_comp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.

    split; [apply (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ HS)|].
    split.
    + apply box_comp_box.
    + split.
      * exact H2.
      * exact H1.
  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE (wf_typ_inv_readonly _ _ _ HS) A HA Hac2)
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply box_comp_mut. assumption.
  - assert (Hac2 := BoxComp_mut_inv _ _ _ Hac).
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
    exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A HA Hac) as [A1 [HA1 [Hac1 [HA1' HA1'']]]].
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 HA1 Hac1) as [A2 [HA2 [Hac2 [HA2' HA2'']]]].
    exists A2. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - exists A. repeat split; auto.
    + apply box_comp_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - destruct (BoxComp_int_inv _ _ _ Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A HA Hac2) as [A' [HA' [Hac' [HA'' HA''']]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3); try (inversion H4).
  - destruct (BoxComp_pair_lift E0 T2 A HE HSd2 HA Hac) as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [HA0' HA0'']]]].
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).

        as [A' [B' [HA' [HB' [Hac' [HA'' HB'']]]]]].
      exists A', B'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A B HA HB H4)
        as [A' [B' [HA' [HB' [Hac' [HA'' HB'']]]]]].
      exists A', B'. repeat split; auto.
  - (* trans *) assert (HT2 : wf_typ E0 T2).
    { apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E0 T1 T2 H1)); assumption. }
    destruct (IH2 HE HT2 A B HA HB Hac) as [A1 [B1 [HA1 [HB1 [Hac1 [HA1' HB1']]]]]].
    destruct (IH1 HE HS A1 B1 HA1 HB1 Hac1) as [A2 [B2 [HA2 [HB2 [Hac2 [HA2' HB2']]]]]].
    exists A2, B2. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* inter left *) exists A, B. repeat split; auto.
    + apply arr_comp_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - (* inter right *) exists A, B. repeat split; auto.
    + apply arr_comp_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - (* inter *) inversion Hac; subst.
    + destruct (IH1 HE HS A B HA HB H5) as [A' [B' [HA' [HB' [Hac' [HA'' HB'']]]]]].
      exists A', B'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 HE HS A B HA HB H5) as [A' [B' [HA' [HB' [Hac' [HA'' HB'']]]]]].
      exists A', B'. repeat split; auto.
  - (* record *) inversion Hac.
  - (* readonly record *) inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H4).
  - (* denormalize *)
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).

    exists A', B'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HA0' | eapply sub_trans; [exact HA1' | exact HA'']].

Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)

(* ---------------- lc-conditioned commutation ---------------- *)

Fixpoint subst_ee_open_ee_lc (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall x v (k : nat) f,
    lc_exp 0 v ->
    subst_ee x v (open_ee_rec k f e) =
    open_ee_rec k (subst_ee x v f) (subst_ee x v e)
with subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc (r : rec_comp) {struct r} :
  forall x v (k : nat) f,
    lc_exp 0 v ->
    subst_ee_rec_comp x v (open_ee_record_rec k f r) =
    open_ee_record_rec k (subst_ee x v f) (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r).
Proof.
  - destruct e; intros x v k f Hlc; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (k == n); reflexivity.
    + destruct (x === a) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * symmetry. apply (lc_exp_open_ee_apply v Hlc k (subst_ee x v f)).
      * reflexivity.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
    + f_equal; [apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc | apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc]; exact Hlc.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
    + f_equal; try reflexivity; apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc; exact Hlc.
    + f_equal; [apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc | apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc]; exact Hlc.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
    + f_equal; [apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc | apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc]; exact Hlc.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
    + f_equal; try reflexivity; apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc; exact Hlc.
    + f_equal; try reflexivity; apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc; exact Hlc.
  - destruct r; intros x v k f Hlc; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [apply subst_ee_open_ee_lc | apply subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc]; exact Hlc.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc. exact Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ee_open_ee_lc_apply : forall x v e f,
  lc_exp 0 v ->
  subst_ee x v (open_ee e f) = open_ee (subst_ee x v e) (subst_ee x v f).
Proof. intros. apply (subst_ee_open_ee_lc e x v 0 f H). Qed.

Lemma subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_lc : forall x v e y,
  lc_exp 0 v -> y <> x ->
  subst_ee x v (open_ee e (exp_fvar y)) =
  open_ee (subst_ee x v e) (exp_fvar y).
Proof.
  intros x v e y Hlc Hneq. rewrite (subst_ee_open_ee_lc_apply x v e (exp_fvar y) Hlc).
  rewrite subst_ee_neq_fvar; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

Lemma subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc_apply : forall x v r f,
  lc_exp 0 v ->
  subst_ee_rec_comp x v (open_ee_record_rec 0 f r) =
  open_ee_record_rec 0 (subst_ee x v f) (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r).
Proof. intros. apply (subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc r x v 0 f H). Qed.

Lemma subst_ee_rec_open_ee_fvar_lc : forall x v r y,
  lc_exp 0 v -> y <> x ->
  subst_ee_rec_comp x v (open_ee_record_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) r) =
  open_ee_record_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) (subst_ee_rec_comp x v r).
Proof.
  intros x v r y Hlc Hneq.
  rewrite (subst_ee_rec_open_ee_lc_apply x v r (exp_fvar y) Hlc).
  rewrite subst_ee_neq_fvar; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

(* ---------------- free-variable commutation ---------------- *)

Fixpoint subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv (e : exp) {struct e} :
  forall x v (k : nat),
    x `notin` fv_exp e ->
    subst_ee x v (open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar x) e) = open_ee_rec k v e

    x `notin` fv_rec_comp r ->
    subst_ee_rec_comp x v (open_ee_record_rec k (exp_fvar x) r) =
    open_ee_record_rec k v r.
Proof.
  - destruct e; intros x v k H; simpl in *.
    + destruct (k == n); [apply subst_ee_eq_fvar|reflexivity].
    + apply subst_ee_neq_fvar. apply (notin_singleton_1' a x H).
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv.

    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv.

    + f_equal; try reflexivity; apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv.
      apply notin_union_1 in H. exact H.
    + f_equal.
      * apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. apply notin_union_1 in H. exact H.
      * apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. apply notin_union_2 in H. exact H.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. exact H.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. exact H.
    + f_equal.
      * apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. apply notin_union_1 in H. exact H.
      * apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. apply notin_union_2 in H. exact H.
    + reflexivity.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv. exact H.
    + f_equal. apply subst_ee_rec_open_ee_fvar_fv. exact H.
    + f_equal; try reflexivity; apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv.

    + f_equal.

  - destruct r; intros x v k H; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + f_equal.
      * apply subst_ee_open_ee_fvar_fv.
        apply notin_union_1 in H. apply notin_union_2 in H. exact H.

Lemma wf_typ_kind : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T -> forall (E2 : env), same_kinds E1 E2 -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hsk.
  - constructor.
  - destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
    apply (wf_typ_var U' E2 X). assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)). apply same_kinds_cons_sub. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_both : forall (E : env) S T, sub E S T ->
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E T) /\
  (wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E S).
Proof.
  intros E S T H.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
  - (* denormalize *) split; intros; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_target : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T -> wf_typ E T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (sub_wf_both E S T H1)); assumption. Qed.

  - cbn [open_tt_rec]. rewrite nf_record. rewrite nf_record. cbn [open_tt_rec].

Lemma wf_typ_nf_gen : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_typ E T ->
  forall (E' : env), same_kinds E E' -> wf_typ E' (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hsk.
  - rewrite nf_top. constructor.
  - rewrite nf_fvar. destruct (proj1 (Hsk X) (ex_intro _ U H)) as [U' HU'].
    apply (wf_typ_var U' E' X). assumption.
  - rewrite nf_arrow. constructor; auto.
  - rewrite nf_all. apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
    + apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
    + intros X HX.
      specialize (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub (normal_form_typing T1) ++ E')).
      assert (Heq : open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) X = normal_form_typing (open_tt T2 X)).

      rewrite Heq. apply H1. apply same_kinds_cons_sub_any. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_box. constructor. apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_mut. apply merge_wf. apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
  - rewrite nf_int. constructor; auto.
  - rewrite nf_record. constructor. apply IHwf_typ. assumption.
Qed.

  wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E (normal_form_typing T).

Lemma record_lookup_ref_in_dom : forall (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) (l : label),
  record_lookup_ref a r = Some l -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros a r. induction r as [| a' e r IH | a' l' r IH]; intros l H;
    simpl in *.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hneq].
    + apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. symmetry. exact Heq.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH l H).
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a l r) = Some l.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_neq : forall (a a' : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  a <> a' ->
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a' l r) = record_lookup_ref a r.
Proof.
  intros a a' l r Hneq. simpl.
  destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hn].
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma RComp_record_inv_label : forall (a a0 : atom) (A B : typ),
  RComp a (typ_record a0 A) B -> B = A /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros a a0 A B H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

(* Non-readonly record: the field is a ref field, its label is bound
   in the signature, and its field type is a subtype of the field type
   of the ascribed record type.

   NOTE (close variant).  The requested conclusion was
   [sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T)].  The one-directional
   component analysis [sub_rcomp] only gives [sub E Tf T], which is
   the statement proved here.  The record-level conclusion additionally
   needs the reverse component subtyping [sub E T Tf] (record subtyping
   [sub_record] is invariant); with both it follows immediately from
   [sub_record].  The field component relation below is exactly what
   [typing_sub] needs to retype the store value read at the label. *)
Lemma record_field_nonro : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                  (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (Hrec : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) Hty)).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T)
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T Hrec)).
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E Tr (typ_record a T) HE HTr Hsub T HT
              (rc_here a T)) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HsubA]]].
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a A' Hrc Hval Hac')
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind |]].
  eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Readonly record: the field is a ref field, its label is bound in
   the signature, and its field type is a subtype of the readonly
   record's field type. *)
Lemma record_field_readonly : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                     (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (Hrec : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_record r)
                 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)).
  assert (Hrec' : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly (typ_record a T) Hrec)).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T)
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T Hrec')).
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E Tr (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
              HE HTr Hsub T HT
              (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' HsubA]]].
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a A' Hrc Hval Hac')
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind |]].
  eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.
