Lemma typing_sig_weaken_aux : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T ->
  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T.
Proof.
  intros E0 R0 e0 T0 Hty0.
  pose (P := fun (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ)
                   (_ : typing E R e T) =>
               forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T).
  pose (Q := fun (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ)
                   (_ : typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
               forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) ->
                         typing_record_comp E (R2 ++ R) r T).
  change (P E0 R0 e0 T0 Hty0).
  apply (typing_mut P Q).
  - (* var *) intros E R x T Hwe Hws Hbind R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_var E (R2 ++ R) x T Hwe Hws' Hbind).
  - (* abs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_abs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
    intros x Hx.
    apply (IHbody x Hx R2).
    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ V) Hws').
    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R).
    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1).
    apply Hbody. exact Hx.
  - (* app *) intros T1 E R e1 e2 T2 Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_app T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T2 Hws'
             (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).
  - (* tabs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_tabs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
    intros X HX.
    apply (IHbody X HX R2).
    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) X (bind_sub V) Hws').
    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R).
    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R
             (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)).
    apply Hbody. exact HX.
  - (* tapp *) intros T1 E R e1 T T2 Hws Hbody IH Hsub R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_tapp T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 T T2 Hws'
             (IH R2 Hws') Hsub).
  - (* sub *) intros S E R e T Hws Hbody IH Hsub R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_sub S E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws') Hsub).
  - (* let *) intros L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_let L T1 T2 e1 e2 E (R2 ++ R) Hws' (IH1 R2 Hws')).
    intros x Hx.
    apply (IH2 x Hx R2).
    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ T1) Hws').
    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R).
    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2).
    apply Hbody2. exact Hx.
  - (* box *) intros E R e T Hws Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_box E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws')).
  - (* unbox *) intros E R e T Hws Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_unbox E (R2 ++ R) e T Hws' (IH R2 Hws')).
  - (* set_box *) intros E R e1 e2 T Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_set_box E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T Hws'
             (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).
  - (* ref *) intros E R l T Hwe Hws Hbind R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_ref E (R2 ++ R) l T Hwe Hws').
    apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hbind.
  - (* seal *) intros E R e T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_seal E (R2 ++ R) e T (IH R2 Hws')).
  - (* unbox_readonly *) intros E R e T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_unbox_readonly E (R2 ++ R) e T (IH R2 Hws')).
  - (* record *) intros E R r T Hrecord IHrecord R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record E (R2 ++ R) r T (IHrecord R2 Hws')).
  - (* record_read *) intros E R e a T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record_read E (R2 ++ R) e a T (IH R2 Hws')).
  - (* record_read_readonly *) intros E R e a T Hbody IH R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record_read_readonly E (R2 ++ R) e a T (IH R2 Hws')).
  - (* record_write *) intros E R e1 a e2 T Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record_write E (R2 ++ R) e1 a e2 T (IH1 R2 Hws')
             (IH2 R2 Hws')).
  - (* record_empty *) intros E R Hwe Hws R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record_empty E (R2 ++ R) Hwe Hws').
  - (* record_exp *) intros E R a e r T Tr Hnd Hrec IHrec Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record_exp E (R2 ++ R) a e r T Tr Hnd
             (IHrec R2 Hws') (IHbody R2 Hws')).
  - (* record_ref *) intros E R a l r T Tr Hnd Hrec IHrec Hbind R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_record_ref E (R2 ++ R) a l r T Tr Hnd
             (IHrec R2 Hws')).
    apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hbind.
Qed.

Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Stripping [typing_sub] from a typing of a record literal.        *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_exp_record_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing E R (exp_record r) T ->
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\ sub E Tr T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T Hty.
  remember (exp_record r) as e eqn:He.
  revert He.
  revert r.
  induction Hty; intros rr Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHHty rr Heq) as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
    exists Tr. split; [exact Hrc | eapply sub_trans; eauto].
  - (* typing_record *)
    injection Heq as Hrr. subst rr.
    exists T. split.
    + exact H.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R).
        apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r T H).
      * apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r T H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Component analysis: a ref field of a value record component.     *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* If a value record [r] (whose components are all [rec_ref]) has a *)
(* component [A] at label [a], then [a] is a ref field of [r] whose *)
(* label is bound in [R] with some type [Tf], and [Tf] is a         *)
(* subtype of [A].                                                  *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_field :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ) (a : atom) (A : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    RComp a Tr A ->
    exists l Tf,
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
      sub E Tf A.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr a A Hrc.
  revert a A.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hval Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp: impossible for a value *) inversion Hval.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    inversion Hval as [| a1 l1 r1 Hval0]; subst.
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac)
      as [Hac1 | Hac1].
    + (* component is the record field of the head *)
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A Hac1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exists l0, T0. split; [| split].
      * apply record_lookup_ref_here.
      * exact Hb.
      * apply sub_refl.
        -- apply (wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0).
           apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        -- apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l0 T0).
           ++ apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
           ++ exact Hb.
    + (* component comes from the tail *)
      destruct (IH a A Hval0 Hac1)
        as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind Hsub]]]].
      exists l, Tf. split; [| split].
      * assert (Hneq : a <> a0).
        { intro Heq. apply Hnotin. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (record_lookup_ref_in_dom a r0 l Hlook). }
        rewrite (record_lookup_ref_neq a a0 l0 r0 Hneq).
        exact Hlook.
      * exact Hbind.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Every [rec_ref] occurring in a well-typed record component is     *)
(* bound in the signature.                                           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Inductive rec_ref_occ : rec_comp -> atom -> label -> rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | rec_ref_occ_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a l r
  | rec_ref_occ_exp : forall (a : atom) (e : exp) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_exp a e r) a0 l r0
  | rec_ref_occ_ref : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l0 : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l0 r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a0 l0 r0.

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_binds :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a l r0 ->
      exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l rr Hocc.
  - inversion Hocc.
  - inversion Hocc; subst. apply (IH a l rr). assumption.
  - inversion Hocc; subst.
    + exists T0. exact Hb.
    + apply (IH a l rr). assumption.
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork.

(* Existence-only all-component analysis.  This is the part needed to show
   that a subtyping derivation with an all target must start from a type
   with an all component; no body relations are tracked. *)

Inductive AComp : typ -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ac_all : forall A B, AComp (typ_all A B) A B
  | ac_fvar : forall X A B, AComp (typ_fvar X) A B
  | ac_rofvar : forall m X A B, AComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A B
  | ac_int_l : forall X Y A B, AComp X A B -> AComp (typ_int X Y) A B
  | ac_int_r : forall X Y A B, AComp Y A B -> AComp (typ_int X Y) A B
  | ac_mut : forall m X A B, AComp X A B -> AComp (typ_mut m X) A B.

Lemma AComp_mut_inv : forall m T A B, AComp (typ_mut m T) A B -> AComp T A B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - apply ac_fvar. - assumption. Qed.

Lemma AComp_int_inv : forall X Y A B,
  AComp (typ_int X Y) A B -> AComp X A B \/ AComp Y A B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption. Qed.

Lemma AComp_all_inv : forall A B C D,
  AComp (typ_all A B) C D -> C = A /\ D = B.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. auto. Qed.

(* Merging a mutability preserves the existence of a component. *)
Lemma AComp_merge_fwd : forall T m A B,
  AComp T A B -> exists A' B', AComp (merge_mutability T m) A' B'.
Proof.
  intros T m A B H. induction H as
    [A0 B0 | X A0 B0 | m0 X A0 B0 | X Y A0 B0 H IH | X Y A0 B0 H IH | m0 X A0 B0 H IH].
  - rewrite merge_all. exists A0, B0. apply ac_all.
  - rewrite merge_fvar. exists A0, B0. apply ac_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_mut. exists A0, B0. apply ac_rofvar.
  - rewrite merge_int. destruct IH as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_l. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int. destruct IH as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_r. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. exists A0, B0. apply ac_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma AComp_merge_rev_exists : forall T m A B,
  AComp (merge_mutability T m) A B -> exists A' B', AComp T A' B'.
Proof.
  induction T; intros mm A B H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. exists A, B. apply ac_fvar.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. exists A, B. apply ac_all.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - simpl in H.
    destruct (IHT mm A B H) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_mut. assumption.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 mm A B H3) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 mm A B H3) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_r. assumption.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
Qed.

(* normal_form_typing preserves a component in both directions (existence). *)
Lemma AComp_nf_fwd : forall T A B,
  AComp T A B -> exists A' B', AComp (normal_form_typing T) A' B'.
Proof.
  induction T; intros A B H.
  - simpl. inversion H.
  - simpl. inversion H.
  - simpl. inversion H; subst. exists A, B. apply ac_fvar.
  - simpl. inversion H.
  - simpl. inversion H; subst. exists A, B. apply ac_all.
  - simpl. inversion H.
  - simpl. apply AComp_merge_fwd. assumption.
  - simpl. inversion H; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A B H3) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A B H3) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_r. assumption.
  - simpl. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma AComp_nf_rev : forall T A B,
  AComp (normal_form_typing T) A B -> exists A' B', AComp T A' B'.
Proof.
  induction T; intros A B H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst. exists A, B. apply ac_fvar.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst. exists A, B. apply ac_all.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H.
    destruct (AComp_merge_rev_exists (normal_form_typing T) m A B H)
      as [A0 [B0 Hc]].
    destruct (IHT A0 B0 Hc) as [A' [B' Hc']].
    exists A', B'. apply ac_mut. assumption.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst.
    + destruct (IHT1 A B H3) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A B H3) as [A' [B' Hc]]. exists A', B'. apply ac_int_r. assumption.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
Qed.

(* Lifting a target component through a subtyping derivation. *)
Lemma AComp_lift_sub : forall E S T,
  sub E S T -> forall A B, AComp T A B -> exists A' B', AComp S A' B'.
Proof.
  intros E S T Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub IHsub
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub IHsub ];
  intros A B Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - exists A, B. apply ac_fvar.
  - inversion Hac.
  - exists A, B. apply ac_all.
  - inversion Hac.
  - destruct (IH1 A B (AComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A B Hac))
      as [A' [B' Hc]].
    exists A', B'. apply ac_mut. assumption.
  - destruct (IH1 A B (AComp_mut_inv mut_readonly T2 A B Hac))
      as [A' [B' Hc]]. exact (ex_intro _ A' (ex_intro _ B' Hc)).
  - destruct (IH2 A B Hac) as [A0 [B0 Hc]].
    destruct (IH1 A0 B0 Hc) as [A' [B' Hc']].
    exists A', B'. assumption.
  - exists A, B. apply ac_int_l. assumption.
  - exists A, B. apply ac_int_r. assumption.
  - destruct (AComp_int_inv _ _ _ _ Hac) as [Hc | Hc].
    + destruct (IH1 A B Hc) as [A' [B' Hc']]. exists A', B'. assumption.
    + destruct (IH2 A B Hc) as [A' [B' Hc']]. exists A', B'. assumption.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2); try (inversion H3).
  - destruct (AComp_nf_rev T2 A B Hac) as [A0 [B0 Hc]].
    destruct (IHsub A0 B0 Hc) as [A1 [B1 Hc1]].
    destruct (AComp_nf_fwd T1 A1 B1 Hc1) as [A' [B' Hc']].
    exists A', B'. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_to_all_comp : forall E S A B,
  sub E S (typ_all A B) -> exists A' B', AComp S A' B'.
Proof.
  intros. apply (AComp_lift_sub E S (typ_all A B) H A B (ac_all A B)).
Qed.

Lemma AComp_record_comp_false : forall E R r Tr A B,
  typing_record_comp E R r Tr -> AComp Tr A B -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr A B H. induction H as
    [ E0 R0 HE HS
    | E0 R0 a e rb T Tr Hnot Hr IHr Hty
    | E0 R0 a l rb T Tr Hnot Hr IHr Hb ];
    intros Hac.
  - inversion Hac.
  - inversion Hac; subst;
      try match goal with H : AComp (typ_record _ _) _ _ |- False => inversion H end;
      auto.
  - inversion Hac; subst;
      try match goal with H : AComp (typ_record _ _) _ _ |- False => inversion H end;
      auto.
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part A: record field invariance.                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We introduce a "plain" record-component relation [RCompP] which     *)
(* is like [RComp] but has no constructor descending under [typ_mut].  *)
(* This is the relation along which record subtyping is genuinely      *)
(* invariant.  (The unrestricted [RComp] forgets the reverse subtyping *)
(* at [sub_readonly_record], where records are covariant in the mut    *)
(* wrapper.)                                                          *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Inductive RCompP (a : atom) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | rcp_here : forall A, RCompP a (typ_record a A) A
  | rcp_fvar : forall (X : atom) A, RCompP a X A
  | rcp_int_l : forall X Y A, RCompP a X A -> RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A
  | rcp_int_r : forall X Y A, RCompP a Y A -> RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A.

Lemma RCompP_int_inv : forall (a : atom) X Y A,
  RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A -> RCompP a X A \/ RCompP a Y A.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RCompP_record_inv : forall (a a0 : atom) A B,
  RCompP a (typ_record a0 A) B -> B = A /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. auto.
Qed.

Lemma RCompP_heads : forall (a : atom) S C,
  RCompP a S C ->
  (exists A, S = typ_record a A /\ C = A) \/
  (exists X, S = typ_fvar X) \/
  (exists U V, S = typ_int U V).
Proof.
  intros a S C H. induction H.
  - left. exists A. split; reflexivity.
  - right. left. exists X. reflexivity.
  - right. right. exists X, Y. reflexivity.
  - right. right. exists X, Y. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A merge_mutability result never has a plain record component. *)
Lemma RCompP_merge_false : forall (a : atom) W m C,
  RCompP a (merge_mutability W m) C -> False.
Proof.
  intros a W. induction W; intros mm C Hac.
  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a (merge_mutability W1 mm) (merge_mutability W2 mm) C Hac)
      as [Hc | Hc].
    + apply (IHW1 mm C Hc).
    + apply (IHW2 mm C Hc).
  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac.
Qed.

(* Lifting a plain component through normalisation, preserving the
   component up to subtyping in both directions. *)
Lemma RCompP_pair_lift_both : forall (a : atom) (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RCompP a T A ->
  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ RCompP a (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\
    sub E A A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
Proof.
  intros a E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - (* top *) inversion Hac.
  - (* bvar *) inversion Hac.
  - (* fvar *) rewrite nf_fvar. exists A.
    repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* arrow *) inversion Hac.
  - (* all *) inversion Hac.
  - (* box *) inversion Hac.
  - (* mut *) inversion Hac.
  - (* int *) rewrite nf_int.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a T1 T2 A Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_r. assumption.
  - (* record *) rewrite nf_record.
    destruct (RCompP_record_inv a a0 T0 A Hac) as [HeqA Heqa].
    subst A. subst a0.
    assert (HwT0 : wf_typ E T0) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T0 HT)).
    exists (normal_form_typing T0). repeat split; auto.
    + apply wf_typ_nf. assumption.
    + apply rcp_here.
    + apply sub_to_nf; assumption.
    + apply sub_of_nf; assumption.
Qed.

(* Lifting a plain component out of a normal form.  The [mut] case is
   vacuous: merging a mutability never produces a plain component. *)
Lemma RCompP_src_lift_both : forall (a : atom) (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  RCompP a (normal_form_typing T) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RCompP a T A' /\ sub E A' A /\ sub E A A'.
Proof.
  intros a E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - (* top *) rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* bvar *) rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* fvar *) rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A.
    repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* arrow *) rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* all *) rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* box *) rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* mut *) rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
    exfalso. apply (RCompP_merge_false a (normal_form_typing T) m A Hac).
  - (* int *) rewrite nf_int in Hac.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) A Hac)
      as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_r. assumption.
  - (* record *) rewrite nf_record in Hac.
    destruct (RCompP_record_inv a a0 T0 A Hac) as [HeqA Heqa].
    subst A. subst a0.
    assert (HwT0 : wf_typ E T0) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T0 HT)).
    exists T0. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rcp_here.
    + apply sub_to_nf; assumption.
    + apply sub_of_nf; assumption.
Qed.

(* Reverse-directed transport of a plain component along a subtyping. *)
Lemma RCompP_rev_transport : forall (a : atom) (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall C, wf_typ E C -> RCompP a T C ->
  exists C', wf_typ E C' /\ RCompP a S C' /\ sub E C' C /\ sub E C C'.
Proof.
  intros a E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros C HC Hac.
  - (* top *) inversion Hac.
  - (* refl tvar *) exists C. repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar;
      try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* trans tvar *) exists C. repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar;
      try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* arrow *) inversion Hac.
  - (* all *) inversion Hac.
  - (* box *) inversion Hac.
  - (* readonly *) inversion Hac.
  - (* readonly mutable *) inversion Hac.
  - (* trans *)
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2) by (apply (sub_wf_target E0 T1 T2 HE HS H1)).
    destruct (IH2 C HC Hac) as [C2 [HC2 [Hcp2 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    destruct (IH1 C2 HC2 Hcp2) as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub3 Hsub4]]]].
    exists C'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* inter left *) exists C. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rcp_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - (* inter right *) exists C. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rcp_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - (* inter *) destruct (RCompP_int_inv a T2 T3 C Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IH1 C HC Hac2) as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists C'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 C HC Hac2) as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists C'. repeat split; auto.
  - (* record *)
    destruct (RCompP_record_inv a a0 T2 C Hac) as [HeqC Heqa].
    subst C. subst a0.
    exists T1. repeat split; auto.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T1 HS).
    + apply rcp_here.
    + exact H1.
    + exact H2.
  - (* readonly record *) inversion Hac.
  - (* denormalize *)
    destruct (RCompP_pair_lift_both a E0 T2 C HE HSd2 HC Hac)
      as [C0 [HC0 [Hcp0 [HsubC1 HsubC2]]]].
    assert (Hnf1 : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    destruct (IHsub0 C0 HC0 Hcp0) as [C1 [HC1 [Hcp1 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    destruct (RCompP_src_lift_both a E0 T1 C1 HE HSd1 HC1 Hcp1)
      as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub3 Hsub4]]]].
    exists C'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub3 | eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub1 | exact HsubC1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HsubC2 | eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub2 | exact Hsub4]].
Qed.

(* Main inversion: if a *record* subtypes something with a plain component
   [C], then its field is equivalent to [C]. *)
Lemma record_src_rcompp : forall (E : env) (S T : typ),
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall (a : atom) A C,
    S = typ_record a A -> wf_typ E C -> RCompP a T C ->
    sub E A C /\ sub E C A.
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros a A C Heq HC Hac.
  - (* top *) inversion Hac.
  - (* refl tvar *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* trans tvar *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* arrow *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* box *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* readonly *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* readonly mutable *) inversion Hac.
  - (* trans *)
    subst S0.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2)
      by (apply (sub_wf_target E0 (typ_record a A) T2 HE HS H1)).
    destruct (RCompP_rev_transport a E0 T2 T3 HE HwT2 H2 C HC Hac)
      as [C2 [HC2 [Hcp2 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    destruct (IH1 a A C2 eq_refl HC2 Hcp2) as [HAC2 HCA2].
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* inter left *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* inter right *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* inter *)
    subst S0.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a T2 T3 C Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + apply (IH1 a A C eq_refl HC Hac2).
    + apply (IH2 a A C eq_refl HC Hac2).
  - (* record *)
    inversion Heq as [Ha Ht]. subst a0. subst T1.
    destruct (RCompP_record_inv a a T2 C Hac) as [HeqC _].
    subst C. split; assumption.
  - (* readonly record *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* denormalize *)
    subst S0.
    assert (HA : wf_typ E0 A) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E0 a A HSd1)).
    rewrite nf_record in Hsub0.
    destruct (RCompP_pair_lift_both a E0 T2 C HE HSd2 HC Hac)
      as [C0 [HC0 [Hcp0 [HsubC1 HsubC2]]]].
    destruct (IHsub0 a (normal_form_typing A) C0 nf_record HC0 Hcp0)
      as [HAC0 HCA0].
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_to_nf; assumption |].
      eapply sub_trans; [exact HAC0 | exact HsubC1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HsubC2 |].
      eapply sub_trans; [exact HCA0 | apply sub_of_nf; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma sub_record_record_both : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  apply (record_src_rcompp E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub
           a A B eq_refl (wf_typ_inv_record E a B HB) (rcp_here a B)).
Qed.

(* Precise source characterisation of a record target: the source has a
   plain record component equivalent to the target field.  The naive
   "record or fvar" disjunction is false (e.g. the source may be
   [typ_int (typ_record a B) typ_top]); [RCompP] is the correct shape. *)
Lemma sub_to_record_src : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  exists C, wf_typ E C /\ RCompP a S C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C.
Proof.
  intros E S a B HE HS Hsub.
  apply (RCompP_rev_transport a E S (typ_record a B) HE HS Hsub B
           (wf_typ_inv_record E a B (sub_wf_target E S (typ_record a B) HE HS Hsub))
           (rcp_here a B)).
Qed.

(* Weaker head-shape corollary. *)
Lemma sub_to_record_src_shapes : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  (exists C, S = typ_record a C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C) \/
  (exists X, S = typ_fvar X) \/
  (exists U V, S = typ_int U V).
Proof.
  intros E S a B HE HS Hsub.
  destruct (sub_to_record_src E S a B HE HS Hsub) as [C [HC [Hcp [H1 H2]]]].
  destruct (RCompP_heads a S C Hcp) as [Hrec | [Hfvar | Hint]].
  - destruct Hrec as [A [HeqS HeqC]]. subst S. subst C.
    left. exists A. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
  - right. left. assumption.
  - right. right. assumption.
Qed.

(* A record never subtypes a type variable.  We use a reachability
   predicate for targets of record-headed sources. *)
Inductive RR : typ -> Prop :=
  | RR_top : RR typ_top
  | RR_record : forall (a : atom) C, RR (typ_record a C)
  | RR_int : forall U V, RR U -> RR V -> RR (typ_int U V)
  | RR_mut : forall m T, RR T -> RR (typ_mut m T).

Lemma RR_merge : forall T m, RR T -> RR (merge_mutability T m).
Proof.
  intros T m H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply RR_mut. apply RR_record.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply RR_int; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply RR_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RR_merge_rev : forall T m, RR (merge_mutability T m) -> RR T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros mm H.
  - rewrite merge_top in H. exact H.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_fvar in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_all in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_box in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_mut in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]. apply RR_mut. exact Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_int in H. inversion H as [U V HU HV].
    apply RR_int.
    + apply (IHT1 mm HU).
    + apply (IHT2 mm HV).
  - rewrite merge_record in H. inversion H as [| a C | | Hpre]. apply RR_record.
Qed.

Lemma RR_nf : forall T, RR T -> RR (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H.
  - rewrite nf_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite nf_record. apply RR_record.
  - rewrite nf_int. apply RR_int; assumption.
  - rewrite nf_mut. apply RR_merge. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RR_of_nf : forall T, RR (normal_form_typing T) -> RR T.
Proof.
  induction T; simpl; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - rewrite nf_mut in H. apply RR_mut. apply IHT. apply (RR_merge_rev _ _ H).
  - rewrite nf_int in H. inversion H as [U V HU HV].
    apply RR_int.
    + apply IHT1. exact HU.
    + apply IHT2. exact HV.
  - rewrite nf_record in H. apply RR_record.
Qed.

Lemma sub_rr_closed : forall E S T, RR S -> sub E S T -> RR T.
Proof.
  intros E S T HNR Hsub. revert HNR.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros HNR.
  - apply RR_top.
  - inversion HNR.
  - inversion HNR.
  - inversion HNR.
  - inversion HNR.
  - inversion HNR.
  - inversion HNR.
  - inversion HNR.
  - assert (H2' : RR T2) by (apply IH1; assumption).
    apply (IH2 H2').
  - inversion HNR; subst. assumption.
  - inversion HNR; subst. assumption.
  - apply RR_int.
    + apply (IH1 HNR).
    + apply (IH2 HNR).
  - inversion HNR.
  - apply RR_mut. apply RR_record.
  - assert (Hnf : RR (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply RR_nf; assumption).
    assert (Hnft : RR (normal_form_typing T2)) by (apply IHsub0; assumption).
    apply RR_of_nf. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_record_fvar_false : forall E (a : atom) A X,
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_fvar X) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E a A X H.
  assert (HRR : RR (typ_fvar X)).
  { apply (sub_rr_closed E (typ_record a A) (typ_fvar X)).
    - apply RR_record.
    - exact H. }
  inversion HRR.
Qed.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part B: dropping readonly from a source.                           *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Lemma sub_to_merge_readonly : forall (E : env) U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E U -> sub E U (merge_mutability U mut_readonly).
Proof.
  intros E U HE H. induction H as [ E0
                 | U0 E0 X Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ].
  - rewrite merge_top. apply sub_top; [assumption | constructor].
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption | apply wf_typ_var; assumption].
  - rewrite merge_arrow. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_all. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int.
    apply sub_inter.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inter_left E0 T1 T2); assumption.
      * apply IH1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inter_right E0 T1 T2); assumption.
      * apply IH2.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply sub_refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_drop : forall (E : env) T T',
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E T' ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'.
Proof.
  intros E T T' HE HT HT' H.
  remember (typ_mut mut_readonly T) as S eqn:HS.
  revert T HT HT' HS.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros T HT HT' HS.
  - (* top *) apply sub_top; assumption.
  - (* refl tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* trans tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* arrow *) discriminate HS.
  - (* all *) discriminate HS.
  - (* box *) discriminate HS.
  - (* readonly *)
    injection HS as Heq. subst T1.
    apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact H1.
  - (* readonly mutable *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E0 mut_readonly T2 HT')).
    apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply (IH1 T HT HwT2 eq_refl).
  - (* trans *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2) by (apply (sub_wf_target E0 T2 T3 HE H1)).
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply (IH1 T HT HwT2 eq_refl).
    + exact H2.
  - (* inter left *) discriminate HS.
  - (* inter right *) discriminate HS.
  - (* inter *)
    subst T1.
    destruct (wf_typ_inv_inter E0 T2 T3 HT') as [HwT2 HwT3].
    apply sub_inter.
    + apply (IH1 T HT HwT2 HS).
    + apply (IH2 T HT HwT3 HS).
  - (* record *) discriminate HS.
  - (* readonly record *)
    injection HS as Heq. subst T1.
    apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact H1.
  - (* denormalize *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HA : wf_typ E T) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly T HT)).
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E (normal_form_typing T)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    assert (Hmt : sub E (normal_form_typing T)
                    (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) mut_readonly))
      by (apply sub_to_merge_readonly; assumption).
    rewrite nf_mut in Hsub0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_to_nf; assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact Hmt.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- exact Hsub0.
        -- apply sub_of_nf; assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part C: target box characterisation.                               *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Lemma sub_to_box : forall (E : env) S B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E S (typ_box B) ->
  exists A, wf_typ E A /\ sub E A B /\ sub E B A /\
    (S = typ_box A \/ BoxComp S A).
Proof.
  intros E S B HE HS HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_boxcomp E S (typ_box B) HE HS Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_box E B HB) (box_comp_box B))
    as [A [HA [Hac [HAB HBA]]]].
  exists A. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part D: target arrow characterisation.                             *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Lemma sub_to_arrow : forall (E : env) S A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) ->
  sub E S (typ_arrow A B) ->
  exists A' B', wf_typ E A' /\ wf_typ E B' /\
    ArrComp S A' B' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E B' B.
Proof.
  intros E S A B HE HS HA Hsub.
  destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow E A B HA) as [HA1 HB1].
  apply (sub_arrcomp E S (typ_arrow A B) HE HS Hsub A B HA1 HB1
           (arr_comp_arrow A B)).
Qed.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
  end

Lemma sub_record_record_both : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  apply (record_src_rcompp E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub
           a A B eq_refl (wf_typ_inv_record E a B HB) (rcp_here a B)).
Qed.

(* Precise source characterisation of a record target: the source has a
   plain record component equivalent to the target field.  The naive
   "record or fvar" disjunction is false (e.g. the source may be
   [typ_int (typ_record a B) typ_top]); [RCompP] is the correct shape. *)
Lemma sub_to_record_src : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  exists C, wf_typ E C /\ RCompP a S C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C.
Proof.
  intros E S a B HE HS Hsub.
  apply (RCompP_rev_transport a E S (typ_record a B) HE HS Hsub B
           (wf_typ_inv_record E a B (sub_wf_target E S (typ_record a B) HE HS Hsub))
           (rcp_here a B)).
Qed.

(* Weaker head-shape corollary. *)
Lemma sub_to_record_src_shapes : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  (exists C, S = typ_record a C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C) \/
  (exists X, S = typ_fvar X) \/
  (exists U V, S = typ_int U V).
Proof.
  intros E S a B HE HS Hsub.
  destruct (sub_to_record_src E S a B HE HS Hsub) as [C [HC [Hcp [H1 H2]]]].
  destruct (RCompP_heads a S C Hcp) as [Hrec | [Hfvar | Hint]].
  - destruct Hrec as [A [HeqS HeqC]]. subst S. subst C.
    left. exists A. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
  - right. left. assumption.
  - right. right. assumption.
Qed.

(* A record never subtypes a type variable.  We use a reachability
   predicate for targets of record-headed sources. *)
Inductive RR : typ -> Prop :=
  | RR_top : RR typ_top
  | RR_record : forall (a : atom) C, RR (typ_record a C)
  | RR_int : forall U V, RR U -> RR V -> RR (typ_int U V)
  | RR_mut : forall m T, RR T -> RR (typ_mut m T).

Lemma sub_to_merge_readonly : forall (E : env) U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E U -> sub E U (merge_mutability U mut_readonly).
Proof.
  intros E U HE H. induction H as [ E0
                 | U0 E0 X Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ].
  - rewrite merge_top. apply sub_top; [assumption | constructor].
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption | apply wf_typ_var; assumption].
  - rewrite merge_arrow. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_all. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int.
    apply sub_inter.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inter_left E0 T1 T2); assumption.
      * apply IH1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inter_right E0 T1 T2); assumption.
      * apply IH2.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply sub_refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_drop : forall (E : env) T T',
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E T' ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'.
Proof.
  intros E T T' HE HT HT' H.
  remember (typ_mut mut_readonly T) as S eqn:HS.
  revert T HT HT' HS.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
Lemma sub_to_box : forall (E : env) S B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E S (typ_box B) ->
  exists A, wf_typ E A /\ sub E A B /\ sub E B A /\
    (S = typ_box A \/ BoxComp S A).
Proof.
  intros E S B HE HS HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_boxcomp E S (typ_box B) HE HS Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_box E B HB) (box_comp_box B))
    as [A [HA [Hac [HAB HBA]]]].
  exists A. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_to_arrow : forall (E : env) S A B,

Proof.
  intros E S A B HE HS HA Hsub.
  destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow E A B HA) as [HA1 HB1].
  apply (sub_arrcomp E S (typ_arrow A B) HE HS Hsub A B HA1 HB1
           (arr_comp_arrow A B)).
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part A: record field invariance.                                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We introduce a "plain" record-component relation [RCompP] which     *)
(* is like [RComp] but has no constructor descending under [typ_mut].  *)
(* This is the relation along which record subtyping is genuinely      *)
(* invariant.  (The unrestricted [RComp] forgets the reverse subtyping *)
(* at [sub_readonly_record], where records are covariant in the mut    *)
(* wrapper.)                                                          *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Inductive RCompP (a : atom) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | rcp_here : forall A, RCompP a (typ_record a A) A
  | rcp_fvar : forall (X : atom) A, RCompP a X A
  | rcp_int_l : forall X Y A, RCompP a X A -> RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A
  | rcp_int_r : forall X Y A, RCompP a Y A -> RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A.

Lemma RCompP_int_inv : forall (a : atom) X Y A,
  RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A -> RCompP a X A \/ RCompP a Y A.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. - left; assumption. - right; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RCompP_record_inv : forall (a a0 : atom) A B,
  RCompP a (typ_record a0 A) B -> B = A /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. auto.
Qed.

Lemma RCompP_heads : forall (a : atom) S C,
  RCompP a S C ->
  (exists A, S = typ_record a A /\ C = A) \/
  (exists X, S = typ_fvar X) \/
  (exists U V, S = typ_int U V).
Proof.
  intros a S C H. induction H.
  - left. exists A. split; reflexivity.
  - right. left. exists X. reflexivity.
  - right. right. exists X, Y. reflexivity.
  - right. right. exists X, Y. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A merge_mutability result never has a plain record component. *)
Lemma RCompP_merge_false : forall (a : atom) W m C,
  RCompP a (merge_mutability W m) C -> False.
Proof.
  intros a W. induction W; intros mm C Hac.
  - rewrite merge_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_fvar in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_box in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_mut in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - rewrite merge_int in Hac.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a (merge_mutability W1 mm) (merge_mutability W2 mm) C Hac)
      as [Hc | Hc].
    + apply (IHW1 mm C Hc).
    + apply (IHW2 mm C Hc).
  - rewrite merge_record in Hac. inversion Hac.
Qed.

(* Lifting a plain component through normalisation, preserving the
   component up to subtyping in both directions. *)
Lemma RCompP_pair_lift_both : forall (a : atom) (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A -> RCompP a T A ->
  exists A0, wf_typ E A0 /\ RCompP a (normal_form_typing T) A0 /\
    sub E A A0 /\ sub E A0 A.
Proof.
  intros a E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - (* top *) inversion Hac.
  - (* bvar *) inversion Hac.
  - (* fvar *) rewrite nf_fvar. exists A.
    repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* arrow *) inversion Hac.
  - (* all *) inversion Hac.
  - (* box *) inversion Hac.
  - (* mut *) inversion Hac.
  - (* int *) rewrite nf_int.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a T1 T2 A Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A0 [HA0 [Hac0 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A0. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_r. assumption.
  - (* record *) rewrite nf_record.
    inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2).
    exists (normal_form_typing A). repeat split; auto.
    + apply (wf_typ_nf E A HA).
    + apply rcp_here.
    + apply (sub_to_nf E A HE HA).
    + apply (sub_of_nf E A HE HA).
Qed.

(* Lifting a plain component out of a normal form.  The [mut] case is
   vacuous: merging a mutability never produces a plain component. *)
Lemma RCompP_src_lift_both : forall (a : atom) (E : env) T A,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E A ->
  RCompP a (normal_form_typing T) A ->
  exists A', wf_typ E A' /\ RCompP a T A' /\ sub E A' A /\ sub E A A'.
Proof.
  intros a E T. induction T; intros A HE HT HA Hac.
  - (* top *) rewrite nf_top in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* bvar *) rewrite nf_bvar in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* fvar *) rewrite nf_fvar in Hac. exists A.
    repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar; try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* arrow *) rewrite nf_arrow in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* all *) rewrite nf_all in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* box *) rewrite nf_box in Hac. inversion Hac.
  - (* mut *) rewrite nf_mut in Hac.
    exfalso. apply (RCompP_merge_false a (normal_form_typing T) m A Hac).
  - (* int *) rewrite nf_int in Hac.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) A Hac)
      as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IHT1 A HE (proj1 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_l. assumption.
    + destruct (IHT2 A HE (proj2 (wf_typ_inv_inter E T1 T2 HT)) HA Hac2)
        as [A' [HA' [Hac' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists A'. repeat split; auto. apply rcp_int_r. assumption.
  - (* record *) rewrite nf_record in Hac.
    inversion Hac; subst; try (inversion H2).
    exists T. repeat split; auto.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a0 T HT).
    + apply rcp_here.
    + apply (sub_to_nf E T HE (wf_typ_inv_record E a0 T HT)).
    + apply (sub_of_nf E T HE (wf_typ_inv_record E a0 T HT)).
Qed.

(* Reverse-directed transport of a plain component along a subtyping. *)
Lemma RCompP_rev_transport : forall (a : atom) (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall C, wf_typ E C -> RCompP a T C ->
  exists C', wf_typ E C' /\ RCompP a S C' /\ sub E C' C /\ sub E C C'.
Proof.
  intros a E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros C HC Hac.
  - (* top *) inversion Hac.
  - (* refl tvar *) exists C. repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar;
      try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* trans tvar *) exists C. repeat split; auto; try apply rcp_fvar;
      try (apply sub_refl; assumption).
  - (* arrow *) inversion Hac.
  - (* all *) inversion Hac.
  - (* box *) inversion Hac.
  - (* readonly *) inversion Hac.
  - (* readonly mutable *) inversion Hac.
  - (* trans *)
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2) by (apply (sub_wf_target E0 T1 T2 HE HS H1)).
    destruct (IH2 C HC Hac) as [C2 [HC2 [Hcp2 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    destruct (IH1 C2 HC2 Hcp2) as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub3 Hsub4]]]].
    exists C'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* inter left *) exists C. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rcp_int_l. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - (* inter right *) exists C. repeat split; auto.
    + apply rcp_int_r. assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
    + apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - (* inter *) destruct (RCompP_int_inv a T2 T3 C Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + destruct (IH1 C HC Hac2) as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists C'. repeat split; auto.
    + destruct (IH2 C HC Hac2) as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
      exists C'. repeat split; auto.
  - (* record *)
    destruct (RCompP_record_inv a a0 T2 C Hac) as [HeqC Heqa].
    subst C. subst a0.
    exists T1. repeat split; auto.
    + apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T1 HS).
    + apply rcp_here.
    + exact H1.
    + exact H2.
  - (* readonly record *) inversion Hac.
  - (* denormalize *)
    destruct (RCompP_pair_lift_both a E0 T2 C HE HSd2 HC Hac)
      as [C0 [HC0 [Hcp0 [HsubC1 HsubC2]]]].
    assert (Hnf1 : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T1)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    destruct (IHsub0 C0 HC0 Hcp0) as [C1 [HC1 [Hcp1 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    destruct (RCompP_src_lift_both a E0 T1 C1 HE HSd1 HC1 Hcp1)
      as [C' [HC' [Hcp' [Hsub3 Hsub4]]]].
    exists C'. repeat split; auto.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub3 | eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub1 | exact HsubC1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HsubC2 | eapply sub_trans; [exact Hsub2 | exact Hsub4]].
Qed.

(* Main inversion: if a *record* subtypes something with a plain component
   [C], then its field is equivalent to [C]. *)
Lemma record_src_rcompp : forall (E : env) (S T : typ),
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall (a : atom) A C,
    S = typ_record a A -> wf_typ E C -> RCompP a T C ->
    sub E A C /\ sub E C A.
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros a A C Heq HC Hac.
  - (* top *) inversion Hac.
  - (* refl tvar *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* trans tvar *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* arrow *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* box *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* readonly *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* readonly mutable *) inversion Hac.
  - (* trans *)
    subst S0.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2)
      by (apply (sub_wf_target E0 (typ_record a A) T2 HE HS H1)).
    destruct (RCompP_rev_transport a E0 T2 T3 HE HwT2 H2 C HC Hac)
      as [C2 [HC2 [Hcp2 [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    destruct (IH1 a A C2 eq_refl HC2 Hcp2) as [HAC2 HCA2].
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* inter left *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* inter right *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* inter *)
    subst S0.
    destruct (RCompP_int_inv a T2 T3 C Hac) as [Hac2 | Hac2].
    + apply (IH1 a A C eq_refl HC Hac2).
    + apply (IH2 a A C eq_refl HC Hac2).
  - (* record *)
    inversion Heq as [Ha Ht]. subst a0. subst T1.
    destruct (RCompP_record_inv a a T2 C Hac) as [HeqC _].
    subst C. split; assumption.
  - (* readonly record *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* denormalize *)
    subst S0.
    assert (HA : wf_typ E0 A) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E0 a A HSd1)).
    rewrite nf_record in Hsub0.
    destruct (RCompP_pair_lift_both a E0 T2 C HE HSd2 HC Hac)
      as [C0 [HC0 [Hcp0 [HsubC1 HsubC2]]]].
    destruct (IHsub0 a (normal_form_typing A) C0 nf_record HC0 Hcp0)
      as [HAC0 HCA0].
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply (sub_to_nf E0 A HE HA) |].
      eapply sub_trans; [exact HAC0 | exact HsubC1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact HsubC2 |].
      eapply sub_trans; [exact HCA0 | apply (sub_of_nf E0 A HE HA)].
Qed.

Lemma sub_record_record_both : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A B HE HA HB Hsub.
  apply (record_src_rcompp E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) HE HA Hsub
           a A B eq_refl (wf_typ_inv_record E a B HB) (rcp_here a B)).
Qed.

(* Precise source characterisation of a record target: the source has a
   plain record component equivalent to the target field.  The naive
   "record or fvar" disjunction is false (e.g. the source may be
   [typ_int (typ_record a B) typ_top]); [RCompP] is the correct shape. *)
Lemma sub_to_record_src : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  exists C, wf_typ E C /\ RCompP a S C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C.
Proof.
  intros E S a B HE HS Hsub.
  apply (RCompP_rev_transport a E S (typ_record a B) HE HS Hsub B
           (wf_typ_inv_record E a B (sub_wf_target E S (typ_record a B) HE HS Hsub))
           (rcp_here a B)).
Qed.

(* Weaker head-shape corollary. *)
Lemma sub_to_record_src_shapes : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  (exists C, S = typ_record a C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C) \/
  (exists X, S = typ_fvar X) \/
  (exists U V, S = typ_int U V).
Proof.
  intros E S a B HE HS Hsub.
  destruct (sub_to_record_src E S a B HE HS Hsub) as [C [HC [Hcp [H1 H2]]]].
  destruct (RCompP_heads a S C Hcp) as [Hrec | [Hfvar | Hint]].
  - destruct Hrec as [A [HeqS HeqC]]. subst S. subst C.
    left. exists A. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
  - right. left. assumption.
  - right. right. assumption.
Qed.

(* A record never subtypes a type variable.  We use a reachability
   predicate for targets of record-headed sources. *)
Inductive RR : typ -> Prop :=
  | RR_top : RR typ_top
  | RR_record : forall (a : atom) C, RR (typ_record a C)
  | RR_int : forall U V, RR U -> RR V -> RR (typ_int U V)
  | RR_mut : forall m T, RR T -> RR (typ_mut m T).

Lemma RR_merge : forall T m, RR T -> RR (merge_mutability T m).
Proof.
  intros T m H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply RR_mut. apply RR_record.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfTyping.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about [record_lookup_ref] and [record_dom]           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma record_lookup_ref_in_dom : forall (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) (l : label),
  record_lookup_ref a r = Some l -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros a r. induction r as [| a' e r IH | a' l' r IH]; intros l H;
    simpl in *.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hneq].
    + apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. symmetry. exact Heq.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH l H).
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a l r) = Some l.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_neq : forall (a a' : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  a <> a' ->
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a' l r) = record_lookup_ref a r.
Proof.
  intros a a' l r Hneq. simpl.
  destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hn].
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma RComp_record_inv_label : forall (a a0 : atom) (A B : typ),
  RComp a (typ_record a0 A) B -> B = A /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros a a0 A B H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Stripping [typing_sub] from a typing of a record literal.        *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_exp_record_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing E R (exp_record r) T ->
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\ sub E Tr T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T Hty.
  remember (exp_record r) as e eqn:He.
  revert He.
  revert r.
  induction Hty; intros rr Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHHty rr Heq) as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
    exists Tr. split; [exact Hrc | eapply sub_trans; eauto].
  - (* typing_record *)
    injection Heq as Hrr. subst rr.
    exists T. split.
    + exact H.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R).
        apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r T H).
      * apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r T H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Component analysis: a ref field of a value record component.     *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* If a value record [r] (whose components are all [rec_ref]) has a *)
(* component [A] at label [a], then [a] is a ref field of [r] whose *)
(* label is bound in [R] with some type [Tf], and [Tf] is a         *)
(* subtype of [A].                                                  *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_field :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ) (a : atom) (A : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    RComp a Tr A ->
    exists l Tf,
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
      sub E Tf A.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr a A Hrc.
  revert a A.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hval Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp: impossible for a value *) inversion Hval.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    inversion Hval as [| a1 l1 r1 Hval0]; subst.
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac)
      as [Hac1 | Hac1].
    + (* component is the record field of the head *)
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A Hac1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exists l0, T0. split; [| split].
      * apply record_lookup_ref_here.
      * exact Hb.
      * apply sub_refl.
        -- apply (wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0).
           apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        -- apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l0 T0).
           ++ apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
           ++ exact Hb.
    + (* component comes from the tail *)
      destruct (IH a A Hval0 Hac1)
        as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind Hsub]]]].
      exists l, Tf. split; [| split].
      * assert (Hneq : a <> a0).
        { intro Heq. apply Hnotin. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (record_lookup_ref_in_dom a r0 l Hlook). }
        rewrite (record_lookup_ref_neq a a0 l0 r0 Hneq).
        exact Hlook.
      * exact Hbind.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Every [rec_ref] occurring in a well-typed record component is     *)
(* bound in the signature.                                           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Inductive rec_ref_occ : rec_comp -> atom -> label -> rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | rec_ref_occ_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a l r
  | rec_ref_occ_exp : forall (a : atom) (e : exp) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_exp a e r) a0 l r0
  | rec_ref_occ_ref : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l0 : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l0 r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a0 l0 r0.

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_binds :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a l r0 ->
      exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l rr Hocc.
  - inversion Hocc.
  - inversion Hocc; subst. apply (IH a l rr). assumption.
  - inversion Hocc; subst.
    + exists T0. exact Hb.
    + apply (IH a l rr). assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Main lemmas                                                      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

(* Non-readonly record: the field is a ref field, its label is bound
   in the signature, and its field type is a subtype of the field type
   of the ascribed record type.

   NOTE (close variant).  The requested conclusion was
   [sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T)].  The one-directional
   component analysis [sub_rcomp] only gives [sub E Tf T], which is
   the statement proved here.  The record-level conclusion additionally
   needs the reverse component subtyping [sub E T Tf] (record subtyping
   [sub_record] is invariant); with both it follows immediately from
   [sub_record].  The field component relation below is exactly what
   [typing_sub] needs to retype the store value read at the label. *)
Lemma record_field_nonro : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                  (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (Hrec : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) Hty)).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T)
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T Hrec)).
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E Tr (typ_record a T) HE HTr Hsub T HT
              (rc_here a T)) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HsubA]]].
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a A' Hrc Hval Hac')
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind |]].
  eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Readonly record: the field is a ref field, its label is bound in
   the signature, and its field type is a subtype of the readonly
   record's field type. *)
Lemma record_field_readonly : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                     (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (Hrec : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_record r)
                 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)).
  assert (Hrec' : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly (typ_record a T) Hrec)).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T)
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T Hrec')).
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E Tr (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
              HE HTr Hsub T HT
              (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' HsubA]]].
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a A' Hrc Hval Hac')
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind |]].
  eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma value_all_tabs : forall E R e A B,
  value e -> typing E R e (typ_all A B) -> wf_env E ->
  exists V body, e = exp_tabs V body.
Proof.
  intros E R e A B Hv Hty HE.
  assert (HWf : wf_typ E (typ_all A B))

      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    destruct (sub_to_all_comp E (typ_arrow V0 T1) A B Hs) as [A' [B' Hc]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exists V0, body. reflexivity.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_all A B) Hty) as [T0 [Hb Hs]].
    destruct (sub_to_all_comp E (typ_box T0) A B Hs) as [A' [B' Hc]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_ref l) (typ_all A B) Hty HE HWf)
      as [St [Href Hs]].
    destruct (sub_to_all_comp E (typ_mut mut_readonly St) A B Hs)
      as [A' [B' Hc]].
    assert (Hc' : AComp St A' B') by (apply (AComp_mut_inv mut_readonly St A' B' Hc)).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l St Href) as [T0 [Hb Hs0]].
    destruct (AComp_lift_sub E (typ_box T0) St Hs0 A' B' Hc')

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Component analysis of subtyping for all-types                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma sub_allcomp : forall (E : env) S T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S T ->
  forall A B L0, wf_typ E A ->
    (forall X, X `notin` L0 -> wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B X)) ->
    AllComp T A B ->
    exists A' B' L, wf_typ E A' /\ AllComp S A' B' /\ sub E A A' /\
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X)).
Proof.
  intros E S T HE HS Hsub.
  induction Hsub as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hsub0 IHsub0
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | Lr E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2a HSi2b
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];

Lemma sub_to_merge_readonly : forall (E : env) U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E U -> sub E U (merge_mutability U mut_readonly).
Proof.
  intros E U HE H. induction H as [ E0
                 | U0 E0 X Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ].
  - rewrite merge_top. apply sub_top; [assumption | constructor].
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption | apply wf_typ_var; assumption].
  - rewrite merge_arrow. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_all. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_box. apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply sub_refl; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int.
    apply sub_inter.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inter_left E0 T1 T2); assumption.
      * apply IH1.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inter_right E0 T1 T2); assumption.
      * apply IH2.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply sub_refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_drop : forall (E : env) T T',
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E T' ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'.
Proof.
  intros E T T' HE HT HT' H.
  remember (typ_mut mut_readonly T) as S eqn:HS.
  revert T HT HT' HS.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi1 HSi1 HSi2
                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros T HT HT' HS.
  - (* top *) apply sub_top; assumption.
  - (* refl tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* trans tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* arrow *) discriminate HS.
  - (* all *) discriminate HS.
  - (* box *) discriminate HS.
  - (* readonly *)
    injection HS as Heq. subst T1.
    apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact H1.
  - (* readonly mutable *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E0 mut_readonly T2 HT')).
    apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply (IH1 T HT HwT2 eq_refl).
  - (* trans *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2) by (apply (sub_wf_target E0 T2 T3 HE H1)).
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply (IH1 T HT HwT2 eq_refl).
    + exact H2.
  - (* inter left *) discriminate HS.
  - (* inter right *) discriminate HS.
  - (* inter *)
    subst T1.
    destruct (wf_typ_inv_inter E0 T2 T3 HT') as [HwT2 HwT3].
    apply sub_inter.
    + apply (IH1 T HT HwT2 HS).
    + apply (IH2 T HT HwT3 HS).
  - (* record *) discriminate HS.
  - (* readonly record *)
    injection HS as Heq. subst T1.
    apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact H1.
  - (* denormalize *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HA : wf_typ E T) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly T HT)).
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E (normal_form_typing T)) by (apply wf_typ_nf; assumption).
    assert (Hmt : sub E (normal_form_typing T)
                    (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) mut_readonly))
      by (apply sub_to_merge_readonly; assumption).
    rewrite nf_mut in Hsub0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply (sub_to_nf E0 T HE HA).
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact Hmt.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- exact Hsub0.
        -- apply (sub_of_nf E0 T2 HSd2).
Qed.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part C: target box characterisation.                               *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Lemma sub_to_box : forall (E : env) S B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E S (typ_box B) ->
  exists A, wf_typ E A /\ sub E A B /\ sub E B A /\
    (S = typ_box A \/ BoxComp S A).
Proof.
  intros E S B HE HS HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_boxcomp E S (typ_box B) HE HS Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_box E B HB) (box_comp_box B))
    as [A [HA [Hac [HAB HBA]]]].
  exists A. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part D: target arrow characterisation.                             *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Lemma sub_to_arrow : forall (E : env) S A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) ->
  sub E S (typ_arrow A B) ->
  exists A' B', wf_typ E A' /\ wf_typ E B' /\
    ArrComp S A' B' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E B' B.
Proof.
  intros E S A B HE HS HA Hsub.
  destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow E A B HA) as [HA1 HB1].
  apply (sub_arrcomp E S (typ_arrow A B) HE HS Hsub A B HA1 HB1
           (arr_comp_arrow A B)).
Qed.

(* A record never subtypes a type variable.  We use a reachability
   predicate for targets of record-headed sources. *)
Inductive RR : typ -> Prop :=
  | RR_top : RR typ_top
  | RR_record : forall (a : atom) C, RR (typ_record a C)
  | RR_int : forall U V, RR U -> RR V -> RR (typ_int U V)
  | RR_mut : forall m T, RR T -> RR (typ_mut m T).

Lemma RR_merge : forall T m, RR T -> RR (merge_mutability T m).
Proof.
  intros T m H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply RR_mut. apply RR_record.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply RR_int; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply RR_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RR_merge_rev : forall T m, RR (merge_mutability T m) -> RR T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros mm H.
  - rewrite merge_top in H. exact H.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_fvar in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_all in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_box in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_mut in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]. apply RR_mut. exact Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_int in H. inversion H as [U V HU HV].
    apply RR_int.
    + apply (IHT1 mm HU).
    + apply (IHT2 mm HV).

(* A record never subtypes a type variable.  We use a reachability
   predicate for targets of record-headed sources. *)
Inductive RR : typ -> Prop :=
  | RR_top : RR typ_top
  | RR_record : forall (a : atom) C, RR (typ_record a C)
  | RR_int : forall U V, RR U -> RR V -> RR (typ_int U V)
  | RR_mut : forall m T, RR T -> RR (typ_mut m T).

Lemma RR_merge : forall T m, RR T -> RR (merge_mutability T m).
Proof.
  intros T m H. induction H.
  - rewrite merge_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite merge_record. apply RR_mut. apply RR_record.
  - rewrite merge_int. apply RR_int; assumption.
  - rewrite merge_mut. apply RR_mut. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RR_merge_rev : forall T m, RR (merge_mutability T m) -> RR T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros mm H.
  - rewrite merge_top in H. exact H.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_fvar in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_all in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_box in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]; inversion Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_mut in H. inversion H as [| | | Hpre]. apply RR_mut. exact Hpre.
  - rewrite merge_int in H. inversion H as [U V HU HV].
    apply RR_int.
    + apply (IHT1 mm HU).
    + apply (IHT2 mm HV).
  - rewrite merge_record in H. inversion H as [| a C | | Hpre]. apply RR_record.
Qed.

Lemma RR_nf : forall T, RR T -> RR (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H.
  - rewrite nf_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite nf_record. apply RR_record.
  - rewrite nf_int. apply RR_int; assumption.
  - rewrite nf_mut. apply RR_merge. assumption.

Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros mm H.
  - rewrite merge_top in H. exact H.
  - rewrite merge_bvar in H. inversion H; subst;
      try match goal with H' : RR (typ_bvar _) |- _ => inversion H' end.
  - rewrite merge_fvar in H. inversion H; subst;
      try match goal with H' : RR (typ_fvar _) |- _ => inversion H' end.
  - rewrite merge_arrow in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_all in H. inversion H.
  - rewrite merge_box in H. inversion H; subst;
      try match goal with H' : RR (typ_box _) |- _ => inversion H' end.
  - rewrite merge_mut in H. inversion H; subst. apply RR_mut. assumption.
  - rewrite merge_int in H. inversion H as [U V HU HV].
    apply RR_int.
    + apply (IHT1 mm HU).
    + apply (IHT2 mm HV).
  - rewrite merge_record in H. inversion H; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RR_nf : forall T, RR T -> RR (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H.
  - rewrite nf_top. apply RR_top.
  - rewrite nf_record. apply RR_record.
  - rewrite nf_int. apply RR_int; assumption.
  - rewrite nf_mut. apply RR_merge. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma RR_of_nf : forall T, RR (normal_form_typing T) -> RR T.
Proof.
  induction T; simpl; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - rewrite nf_mut in H. apply RR_mut. apply IHT. apply (RR_merge_rev _ _ H).
