From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hb.
  - (* empty signature *)
    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
    + apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot].
  - constructor.
  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
  wf_sig E R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (exact (wf_sig_uniq E R Hws)).
  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique signature l (bind_sig T1) (bind_sig T2) R
                Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 2. Domination lemmas for signature concatenation                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma sub_all_all : forall (E : env) A B C D,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_all A B) -> wf_typ E (typ_all C D) ->
  sub E (typ_all A B) (typ_all C D) ->

    exists L, forall X, X `notin` L ->

Proof.

  destruct (sub_allcomp E (typ_all A B) (typ_all C D) HE HA Hsub C D L0

  destruct (AllComp_all_inv _ _ _ _ Hac') as [HeqA HeqB].
  subst A'. subst B'.
  split.
  - exact HwC.
  - split.
    + exact HCA.
    + exists L. exact HB'.
Qed.
EOF

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Uniqueness of the component carried by a well-typed record at a  *)
(* given label.  These facts let us identify the component [C]      *)
(* produced by the reverse record-subtyping analysis with the       *)
(* actual field type [Tf] of the record literal.                    *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_unique :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A B : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> RComp a Tr B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A B HA HB.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion HA.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
Qed.

(* A successful lookup exposes the corresponding component of the
   record's type.  Only [rec_ref] nodes are visible to
   [record_lookup_ref]; a [rec_exp] node in front makes the lookup
   fail. *)
Lemma typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (Tf : typ),
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R ->
      RComp a Tr Tf.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l Tf Hlook Hbind.
  - (* rec_empty *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_exp *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    simpl in Hlook.
    destruct (a === a0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + injection Hlook as Hl. subst l. subst a0.
      assert (HTf : Tf = T0).
      { eapply (wf_sig_binds_uniq E0 R0 l0 T0 Tf).
        - apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        - exact Hb.
        - exact Hbind. }
      subst Tf. apply rc_int_l. apply rc_here.
    + apply rc_int_r. apply (IH a l Tf Hlook Hbind).
Qed.

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_unique :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A B : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> RComp a Tr B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A B HA HB.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion HA.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.

Qed.

(* A successful lookup exposes the corresponding component of the
   record's type.  Only [rec_ref] nodes are visible to

Lemma typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (Tf : typ),
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R ->
      RComp a Tr Tf.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l Tf Hlook Hbind.
  - (* rec_empty *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_exp *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    simpl in Hlook.
    destruct (a === a0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + injection Hlook as Hl. subst l. subst a0.
      assert (HTf : T0 = Tf).
      { eapply (wf_sig_binds_uniq E0 R0 l0 T0 Tf).
        - apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        - exact Hb.
        - exact Hbind. }
      subst Tf. apply rc_int_l. apply rc_here.
    + apply rc_int_r. apply (IH a l Tf Hlook Hbind).
Qed.

(* Plain record subtyping is invariant: [sub_record] requires both  *)
(* component directions.  Consequently the component [C] found by   *)

(* readonly record subtyping is covariant through                    *)
(* [sub_readonly_record], so a plain record can be ascribed to       *)
(* [typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)] using only [Tf <: T].     *)

Lemma RCompP_RComp : forall (a : atom) (S C : typ),
  RCompP a S C -> RComp a S C.
Proof.
  intros a S C H. induction H.
  - apply rc_here.
  - apply rc_fvar.
  - apply rc_int_l. assumption.
  - apply rc_int_r. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_field_nonro_strong :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (a : atom) (T : typ),
    value_record_comp r ->
    typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
    exists l Tf,
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
      sub E Tf T /\
      sub E T Tf /\
      sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T).
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  (* Reverse record-subtyping analysis: [Tr] has a plain component
     [C] at [a], and [C] is equivalent to the target field [T]. *)
  destruct (sub_to_record_src E Tr a T HE HTr Hsub)
    as [C [HC [Hcp [HsubCT HsubTC]]]].
  assert (HRCompC : RComp a Tr C) by (apply RCompP_RComp; exact Hcp).
  (* The actual field type [Tf] is the component carried at [a]. *)
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a C Hrc Hval HRCompC)
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubTfC]]]].
  assert (HRCompTf : RComp a Tr Tf)
    by (eapply typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp; eauto).
  assert (Heq : C = Tf)
    by (eapply typing_record_comp_RComp_unique; eauto).
  subst C.
  exists l, Tf. repeat split; auto.
  (* [Tf <: T] is exactly the reverse-analysis equivalence. *)
  - exact HsubCT.
  (* [T <: Tf] is the missing direction. *)
  - exact HsubTC.
  (* Record-level invariance follows from the two component directions. *)
  - apply sub_record; assumption.
Qed.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Inductive signature : Set :=
  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_mut M T =>
        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
    end.

Arguments merge_mutability T m /.

Arguments normal_form_typing T /.

Inductive in_normal_form : typ -> Prop :=
  | top_in_normal_form :
    in_normal_form typ_top
  | fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom),
    in_normal_form X
  | readonly_fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom) m,
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m X)
  | arrow_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | all_in_normal_form : forall L T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> in_normal_form (open_tt T2 X)) ->
    in_normal_form (typ_all T1 T2)
  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
.

Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | actually_equal : forall S T,
    S = T ->
    in_intersection S T
  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S L ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S R ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).

Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
    (in_intersection S T).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
      typing E R (exp_record r) T

  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
.

Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).

Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)
  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))
  | value_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_record r)
  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))
with value_record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | value_rec_empty :
      value_record_comp rec_empty
  | value_rec_ref : forall a l r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value_record_comp (rec_ref a l r)
.

Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

Notation empty_store := (LabelMapImpl.empty store).

Definition well_formed_store (s : store) :=
  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

(* The original dependent pair uses this same witness. *)
Definition fresh_label_for_store (s : store) :=
  Label.fresh (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)).

Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,
            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
            typing E R v T /\ value v)
    /\
    (forall v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
    match r with
    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
    | _ => None
    end.

Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value e1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s2 (exp_app e1 e2') s2'
  | red_tapp : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' V,
      type V ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_tapp e1 V) s1 (exp_tapp e1' V) s1'
  | red_abs : forall T e1 s1 v2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value v2 ->
      red (exp_app (exp_abs T e1) v2) s1 (open_ee e1 v2) s1
  | red_tabs : forall T1 e1 s1 T2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      red (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) s1 (open_te e1 T2) s1
  | red_let_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let e1 e2) s1 (exp_let e1' e2) s1'
  | red_let : forall v1 e2 s2,
      well_formed_store s2 ->
      value v1 ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let v1 e2) s2 (open_ee e2 v1) s2
  | red_box_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_box e1) s1 (exp_box e1') s1'
  | red_box_ref : forall v1 l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red (exp_box v1) s1 (exp_ref l) (LabelMapImpl.add l v1 s1)
  | red_unbox_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_unbox e1) s1 (exp_unbox e1') s1'
  | red_unbox_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) s1 v1 s1
  | red_unbox_sealed_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_set_box_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_set_box e1 e2) s1 (exp_set_box e1' e2) s1'
  | red_set_box_2 : forall v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_set_box v1 e2) s2 (exp_set_box v1 e2') s2'
  | red_set_box_ref : forall l v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_set_box (exp_ref l) v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
  | red_seal_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_seal e1) s1 (exp_seal e1') s1'
  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) s1 (exp_abs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_tabs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) s1 (exp_tabs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_ref: forall l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_record : forall r s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_record r)) s1
  | red_record : forall r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record r1) s1 (exp_record r1') s1'
  | red_record_read_1 : forall a e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_read e1 a) s1 (exp_record_read e1' a) s1'
  | red_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_record r) a) s1 v1 s1
  | red_sealed_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_record_write_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_write e1 a e2) s1 (exp_record_write e1' a e2) s1'
  | red_record_write_2 : forall a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_record_write v1 a e2) s2 (exp_record_write v1 a e2') s2'
  | red_record_write_ref : forall a l r v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_write (exp_record r) a v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
with red_record_comp : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_record_exp_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1,
      record_comp r1 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) s1 (rec_exp a e1' r1) s1'
  | red_record_exp_2 : forall a v r1 s1 l,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      record_comp r1 ->
      value v ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1)
  | red_record_ref : forall a l r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_ref a l r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1') s1'
.

Notation "< r1 | s1 > -->r < r1' | s1' >" := (red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1') (at level 69).

Inductive redm : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_eq : forall e s e' s',
    e = e' -> s = s' -> redm e s e' s'

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfTyping TypingExpr Readonly.

(* Shape-directed inversions of typing, stripping any outer typing_sub. *)

Lemma typing_app_inv : forall E R e1 e2 T,
  typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists A B, typing E R e1 (typ_arrow A B) /\
    typing E R e2 A /\ sub E B T.
Proof.
  intros E R e1 e2 T H. remember (exp_app e1 e2) as e eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - injection He as Hx Hy. subst e1b e2b.
    exists T1, T2. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    apply (sub_refl E0 T2 HE Ht).
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e0 S H1))
      as [A [B [HA [HB Hs]]]].
    exists A, B. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_box_inv : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_box e) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists S, typing E R e S /\ sub E (typ_box S) T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. remember (exp_box e) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [S0 [Hty Hs]].
    exists S0. split; [assumption|].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - injection He as Hx. subst e1b.
    exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_box T0) HE Ht).
Qed.

Lemma typing_unbox_inv : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_unbox e) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (exists S, typing E R e (typ_box S) /\ sub E S T) \/
  (exists S, typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box S)) /\
     sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. remember (exp_unbox e) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [[S0 [Hty Hs]] | [S0 [Hty Hs]]].
    + left. exists S0. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + right. exists S0. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - injection He as Hx. subst e1b.
    left. exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 T0 HE Ht).
  - injection He as Hx. subst e1b.
    right. exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly T0) HE Ht).
Qed.

                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [[S0 [Hty Hs]] | [S0 [Hty Hs]]].
    + left. exists S0. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
    + right. exists S0. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - injection He as Hx Hy. subst e1b a0.
    left. exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 T0 HE Ht).
  - injection He as Hx Hy. subst e1b a0.
    right. exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly T0) HE Ht).
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_write_inv : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
  typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists S, typing E R e1 (typ_record a S) /\
    typing E R e2 S /\ sub E S T.
Proof.
  intros E R e1 a e2 T H. remember (exp_record_write e1 a e2) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [S0 [H1' [H2' Hs]]].
    exists S0. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - injection He as Hx Hy Hz. subst e1b a0 e2b.
    exists T0. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    apply (sub_refl E0 T0 HE Ht).
Qed.

Lemma typing_var_inv : forall E R x T,
  typing E R (exp_fvar x) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists S, binds x (bind_typ S) E /\ sub E S T.
Proof.
  intros E R x T H. remember (exp_fvar x) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x0 T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - injection He as Hx. subst x0.
    exists T0. split; [assumption|].
    apply (sub_refl E0 T0 HE Ht).
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [S0 [Hb Hs]].
    exists S0. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_abs_inv : forall E R V e1 T,
  typing E R (exp_abs V e1) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists T1 L, sub E (typ_arrow V T1) T /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L ->
      typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1).
Proof.
  intros E R V e1 T H. remember (exp_abs V e1) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V0 e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V0 e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - injection He as HV Hee. subst V0 e1b.
    exists T1, L. split; [|assumption].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_arrow V T1) HE Ht).
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [T1 [L [Hs Hbody]]].
    exists T1, L. split; [|assumption].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_tabs_inv : forall E R V e1 T,
  typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists T1 L, sub E (typ_all V T1) T /\
    (forall X, X `notin` L ->
      typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)).
Proof.
  intros E R V e1 T H. remember (exp_tabs V e1) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V0 e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V0 e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - injection He as HV Hee. subst V0 e1b.
    exists T1, L. split; [|assumption].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_all V T1) HE Ht).
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [T1 [L [Hs Hbody]]].
    exists T1, L. split; [|assumption].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_let_inv : forall E R e1 e2 T,
  typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists T1 T2 L,
    typing E R e1 T1 /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L ->
      typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) /\
    sub E T2 T.
Proof.
  intros E R e1 e2 T H. remember (exp_let e1 e2) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targ T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 rb T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a0 e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - destruct (IH1 He HE (typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e1b S H1))
      as [T1 [T2 [L [H1' [Hbody Hs]]]]].
    exists T1, T2, L. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - injection He as Hx Hy. subst e1b e2b.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfTyping SubInv.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about [record_lookup_ref] and [record_dom]           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma record_lookup_ref_in_dom : forall (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) (l : label),
  record_lookup_ref a r = Some l -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros a r. induction r as [| a' e r IH | a' l' r IH]; intros l H;
    simpl in *.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hneq].
    + apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. symmetry. exact Heq.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH l H).
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a l r) = Some l.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_neq : forall (a a' : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  a <> a' ->
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a' l r) = record_lookup_ref a r.
Proof.
  intros a a' l r Hneq. simpl.
  destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hn].
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma RComp_record_inv_label : forall (a a0 : atom) (A B : typ),
  RComp a (typ_record a0 A) B -> B = A /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros a a0 A B H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Stripping [typing_sub] from a typing of a record literal.        *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_exp_record_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing E R (exp_record r) T ->
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\ sub E Tr T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T Hty.
  remember (exp_record r) as e eqn:He.
  revert He.
  revert r.
  induction Hty; intros rr Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHHty rr Heq) as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
    exists Tr. split; [exact Hrc | eapply sub_trans; eauto].
  - (* typing_record *)
    injection Heq as Hrr. subst rr.
    exists T. split.
    + exact H.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R).
        apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r T H).
      * apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r T H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Component analysis: a ref field of a value record component.     *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* If a value record [r] (whose components are all [rec_ref]) has a *)
(* component [A] at label [a], then [a] is a ref field of [r] whose *)
(* label is bound in [R] with some type [Tf], and [Tf] is a         *)
(* subtype of [A].                                                  *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_field :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ) (a : atom) (A : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    RComp a Tr A ->
    exists l Tf,
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
      sub E Tf A.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr a A Hrc.
  revert a A.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hval Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp: impossible for a value *) inversion Hval.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    inversion Hval as [| a1 l1 r1 Hval0]; subst.
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac)
      as [Hac1 | Hac1].
    + (* component is the record field of the head *)
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A Hac1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exists l0, T0. split; [| split].
      * apply record_lookup_ref_here.
      * exact Hb.
      * apply sub_refl.
        -- apply (wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0).
           apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        -- apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l0 T0).
           ++ apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
           ++ exact Hb.
    + (* component comes from the tail *)
      destruct (IH a A Hval0 Hac1)
        as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind Hsub]]]].
      exists l, Tf. split; [| split].
      * assert (Hneq : a <> a0).
        { intro Heq. apply Hnotin. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (record_lookup_ref_in_dom a r0 l Hlook). }
        rewrite (record_lookup_ref_neq a a0 l0 r0 Hneq).
        exact Hlook.
      * exact Hbind.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Uniqueness of the component carried by a well-typed record at a  *)
(* given label.  These facts let us identify the component [C]      *)
(* produced by the reverse record-subtyping analysis with the       *)
(* actual field type [Tf] of the record literal.                    *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_unique :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A B : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> RComp a Tr B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A B HA HB.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion HA.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
Qed.

(* A successful lookup exposes the corresponding component of the
   record's type.  Only [rec_ref] nodes are visible to
   [record_lookup_ref]; a [rec_exp] node in front makes the lookup
   fail. *)
Lemma typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (Tf : typ),
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R ->
      RComp a Tr Tf.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l Tf Hlook Hbind.
  - (* rec_empty *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_exp *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    simpl in Hlook.
    destruct (a === a0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + injection Hlook as Hl. subst l. subst a0.
      assert (HTf : T0 = Tf).
      { eapply (wf_sig_binds_uniq E0 R0 l0 T0 Tf).
        - apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        - exact Hb.
        - exact Hbind. }
      subst Tf. apply rc_int_l. apply rc_here.
    + apply rc_int_r. apply (IH a l Tf Hlook Hbind).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Every [rec_ref] occurring in a well-typed record component is     *)
(* bound in the signature.                                           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Inductive rec_ref_occ : rec_comp -> atom -> label -> rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | rec_ref_occ_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a l r
  | rec_ref_occ_exp : forall (a : atom) (e : exp) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_exp a e r) a0 l r0
  | rec_ref_occ_ref : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l0 : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l0 r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a0 l0 r0.

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_binds :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a l r0 ->
      exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l rr Hocc.
  - inversion Hocc.
  - inversion Hocc; subst. apply (IH a l rr). assumption.
  - inversion Hocc; subst.
    + exists T0. exact Hb.
    + apply (IH a l rr). assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Main lemmas                                                      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

(* Non-readonly record: the field is a ref field, its label is bound
   in the signature, and its field type is a subtype of the field type
   of the ascribed record type.

   NOTE (close variant).  The requested conclusion was
   [sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T)].  The one-directional
   component analysis [sub_rcomp] only gives [sub E Tf T], which is
   the statement proved here.  The record-level conclusion additionally
   needs the reverse component subtyping [sub E T Tf] (record subtyping
   [sub_record] is invariant); with both it follows immediately from
   [sub_record].  The field component relation below is exactly what
   [typing_sub] needs to retype the store value read at the label. *)
Lemma record_field_nonro : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                  (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (Hrec : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) Hty)).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T)
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T Hrec)).
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E Tr (typ_record a T) HE HTr Hsub T HT
              (rc_here a T)) as [A' [HA' [Hac' HsubA]]].
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a A' Hrc Hval Hac')
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind |]].
  eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Readonly record: the field is a ref field, its label is bound in
   the signature, and its field type is a subtype of the readonly
   record's field type. *)
Lemma record_field_readonly : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                     (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (Hrec : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_record r)
                 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)).
  assert (Hrec' : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly (typ_record a T) Hrec)).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T)
    by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T Hrec')).
  destruct (sub_rcomp a E Tr (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
              HE HTr Hsub T HT
              (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
    as [A' [HA' [Hac' HsubA]]].
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a A' Hrc Hval Hac')
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind |]].
  eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Strengthened non-readonly field lemma.                            *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* Plain record subtyping is invariant: [sub_record] requires both  *)
(* component directions.  Consequently the component [C] found by   *)
(* [sub_to_record_src] at label [a] is equivalent to the target      *)
(* field [T], and uniqueness of record components identifies it      *)
(* with the actual field type [Tf] of the literal.  This yields the  *)
(* missing reverse component subtyping [sub E T Tf] as well as the   *)
(* record-level derivation [sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T)]. *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* No analogous reverse fact is available for the readonly target:   *)
(* readonly record subtyping is covariant through                    *)
(* [sub_readonly_record], so a plain record can be ascribed to       *)
(* [typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)] using only [Tf <: T].     *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma RCompP_RComp : forall (a : atom) (S C : typ),
  RCompP a S C -> RComp a S C.
Proof.
  intros a S C H. induction H.
  - apply rc_here.
  - apply rc_fvar.
  - apply rc_int_l. assumption.
  - apply rc_int_r. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_field_nonro_strong :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (a : atom) (T : typ),
    value_record_comp r ->
    typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
    exists l Tf,
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
      sub E Tf T /\
      sub E T Tf /\
      sub E (typ_record a Tf) (typ_record a T).
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  (* Reverse record-subtyping analysis: [Tr] has a plain component
     [C] at [a], and [C] is equivalent to the target field [T]. *)
  destruct (sub_to_record_src E Tr a T HE HTr Hsub)
    as [C [HC [Hcp [HsubCT HsubTC]]]].
  assert (HRCompC : RComp a Tr C) by (apply RCompP_RComp; exact Hcp).
  (* The actual field type [Tf] is the component carried at [a]. *)
  destruct (typing_record_comp_ref_field E R r Tr a C Hrc Hval HRCompC)
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubTfC]]]].
  assert (HRCompTf : RComp a Tr Tf)
    by (eapply typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp; eauto).
  assert (Heq : C = Tf)
    by (eapply typing_record_comp_RComp_unique; eauto).
  subst C.
  exists l, Tf. split.
  - exact Hlook.
  - split.
    + exact Hbind.
    + split.
      * (* [Tf <: T] is exactly the reverse-analysis equivalence. *)
        exact HsubCT.
      * split.
        -- (* [T <: Tf] is the missing direction. *)
           exact HsubTC.
        -- (* Record-level invariance follows from both directions. *)
           apply sub_record; assumption.
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfTyping TypingExpr TypingInv Readonly RecordInv SubInv.

Lemma RCompP_RComp : forall (a : atom) S A,
  RCompP a S A -> RComp a S A.
Proof.
  intros a S A H. induction H.
  - apply rc_here.
  - apply rc_fvar.
  - apply rc_int_l. assumption.
  - apply rc_int_r. assumption.
Qed.

(* For a non-readonly record target, the store field type and the target
   field type are equivalent: both directions are available. *)
Lemma record_field_nonro_both : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp)
                                       (a : atom) (T : typ),
  value_record_comp r ->
  typing E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) ->
  exists l Tf,
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
    sub E Tf T /\ sub E T Tf.
Proof.
  intros E R r a T Hval Hty.
  destruct (record_field_nonro E R r a T Hval Hty)
    as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind HsubT]]]].
  destruct (typing_exp_record_inv E R r (typ_record a T) Hty)
    as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r Tr Hrc)).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hws)).
  assert (HTr : wf_typ E Tr)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r Tr Hrc)).
  destruct (sub_to_record_src E Tr a T HE HTr Hsub)
    as [C [HC [Hcp [HCT HTC]]]].
  assert (HcR : RComp a Tr C) by (apply (RCompP_RComp a Tr C); assumption).
  assert (HfR : RComp a Tr Tf)
    by (apply (typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp E R r Tr Hrc a l Tf Hlook Hbind)).
  assert (Heq : C = Tf) by (apply (typing_record_comp_RComp_unique E R r Tr Hrc a C Tf HcR HfR)).
  subst C.
  exists l, Tf. split; [exact Hlook | split; [exact Hbind | split; [exact HCT | exact HTC]]].
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Lemma well_formed_store_of_typing_store : forall E R s,
  typing_store E R s -> well_formed_store s.
Proof.
  intros E R s H l v Hmap.
  destruct (proj2 (H l) v Hmap) as [T [Hval _]]. exact Hval.
Qed.

Lemma typing_body_e : forall E R L e T,
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> typing E R (open_ee e x) T) -> body_e e.
Proof.
  intros E R L e T H. exists L. intros x Hx.
  apply (typing_expr E R (open_ee e x) T (H x Hx)).
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_record : forall E R r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> record_comp r.
Proof.
  intros E R r T H. induction H as
    [ E0 R0 HE HS
    | E0 R0 a e rb T0 Tr Hnot Hr IHr Hty
    | E0 R0 a l rb T0 Tr Hnot Hr IHr Hb ].
  - apply record_comp_empty.
  - apply record_comp_exp.
    + apply (typing_expr E0 R0 e T0 Hty).
    + apply IHr.
  - apply record_comp_ref. apply IHr.
Qed.

Lemma no_binds_empty : forall (x : atom) (b : binding),
  binds x b empty -> False.
Proof.
  intros x b H. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_sig_weaken : forall E R r T,
  typing_record_comp E R r T ->
  forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing_record_comp E (R2 ++ R) r T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T H. induction H as
    [ E0 R0 HE HS
    | E0 R0 a e rb T0 Tr Hnot Hr IHr Hty
    | E0 R0 a l rb T0 Tr Hnot Hr IHr Hb ];
    intros R2 Hws.
  - apply typing_record_empty; assumption.
  - apply (typing_record_exp E0 (R2 ++ R0) a e rb T0 Tr Hnot
             (IHr R2 Hws) (typing_sig_weaken E0 R0 e T0 Hty R2 Hws)).
  - apply (typing_record_ref E0 (R2 ++ R0) a l rb T0 Tr Hnot
             (IHr R2 Hws)).
    apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma typing_readonly_wrap : forall E R e S,
  typing E R e S -> typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly S).
Proof.
  intros E R e S Hty.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by (apply (typing_wf_sig_mut E R e S); assumption).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); assumption).
  assert (HS : wf_typ E S) by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R e S); assumption).
  apply (typing_sub S E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly S) Hws Hty).
  apply sub_readonly_mutable.
  apply (sub_refl E S HE HS).
Qed.

From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hb.
  - (* empty signature *)
    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
    + apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot].
  - constructor.
  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
  wf_sig E R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (exact (wf_sig_uniq E R Hws)).
  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique signature l (bind_sig T1) (bind_sig T2) R
                Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 2. Domination lemmas for signature concatenation                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma sig_dom_app : forall (R1 R2 : sig) (l : label),
  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2)) <->
  LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R1) \/ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2).
Proof.
  intros R1 R2 l.
  pose proof (@Signatures.dom_app signature R1 R2) as Heq.
  pose proof (@LabelSetFacts.In_m l l eq_refl
                (Signatures.dom (R1 ++ R2))
                (LabelSetImpl.union (Signatures.dom R1)
                                    (Signatures.dom R2)) Heq) as Hm.
  split; intro H.
  - apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. apply (proj1 Hm). exact H.
  - apply (proj2 Hm). apply LabelSetFacts.union_iff. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sig_cons : forall (R : sig) (l0 : label) (T0 : typ)
                              (l : label) (T : typ),
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) (l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R) <->
  (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.
  intros.
  change (Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) ((l0, bind_sig T0) :: R) <->
          (l = l0 /\ T = T0) \/ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R).
  rewrite Signatures.binds_cons_iff.
  split; intro H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl Hs] | H].
    + left. split; auto. injection Hs as HT. exact HT.
    + right. exact H.
  - destruct H as [[Hl HT] | H].
    + left. split; auto. rewrite HT. reflexivity.
    + right. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_app : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig),
  wf_sig E R1 -> wf_sig E R2 ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R1 ->
      ~ (LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R2))) ->
  wf_sig E (R1 ++ R2).
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 H1.
  induction H1 as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intros H2 Hdisj.
  - simpl. exact H2.
  - change (wf_sig E0 ((l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0) ++ R2)).
    simpl. apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IH.
      * exact H2.
      * intros l T Hb.
        exact (Hdisj l T
                 (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l T) (or_intror Hb))).
    + exact Hwt.
    + intro Hin. apply (proj1 (sig_dom_app R0 R2 l0)) in Hin.
      destruct Hin as [Hin1 | Hin2].
      * exact (Hnot Hin1).
      * exact (Hdisj l0 T0
                 (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R0 l0 T0 l0 T0)
                        (or_introl (conj eq_refl eq_refl))) Hin2).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 3. Fresh label properties                                         *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma InA_eq_key_elt_fst : forall (p : label * exp)
                                  (l : list (label * exp)),
  InA (LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt (elt := exp)) p l ->
  In (fst p) (List.map fst l).
Proof.
  intros p l H. induction H as [y l0 HR | y l0 HR IH].
  - unfold LabelMapImpl.eq_key_elt in HR. simpl in HR.
    destruct HR as [Hfst _]. simpl. left. symmetry. exact Hfst.
  - simpl. right. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_not_maps : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp),
  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> False.
Proof.
  intros s l v Hfresh HMaps.
  apply LabelMapFacts.elements_mapsto_iff in HMaps.
  pose proof (InA_eq_key_elt_fst (l, v) (LabelMapImpl.elements s) HMaps) as Hin.
  pose proof (Label.fresh_not_in (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s))) as Hnot.
  unfold fresh_label_for_store in Hfresh.
  rewrite <- Hfresh in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_neq : forall (s : store) (l : label) (v : exp) (l0 : label),
  fresh_label_for_store s = l ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l0 v s -> l <> l0.
Proof.
  intros s l v l0 Hfresh HMaps Heq.
  subst l0.
  exact (fresh_label_not_maps s l v Hfresh HMaps).
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                (l : label) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
Proof.
  intros E R s l T Hts Hb.
  unfold typing_store in Hts.
  destruct (Hts l) as [Hfst _].
  destruct (Hfst T Hb) as [v [HMaps _]]. exists v. exact HMaps.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_notin_sig_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
                                        (s : store) (l : label),
  typing_store E R s ->
  l = fresh_label_for_store s ->
  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hfresh Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HMaps].
  apply (fresh_label_not_maps s l v).
  - symmetry. exact Hfresh.
  - exact HMaps.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Auxiliary: typing entails well-formedness of the signature       *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_wf_sig_mut : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R
with typing_record_wf_sig_mut : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> wf_sig E R.
Proof.
  - intros E R e T Hty. induction Hty; eauto.
  - intros E R r T Htr. induction Htr; eauto.
Qed.

(* Extending the environment with one binding preserves a wf signature. *)
Lemma wf_sig_env_weaken_cons : forall (E : env) (R : sig)
                                     (X : atom) (b : binding),
  wf_sig E R -> wf_env (X ~ b ++ E) -> wf_sig (X ~ b ++ E) R.
Proof.
  intros E R X b Hws Hwe. revert Hwe.
  induction Hws as [E0 Hwe0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws0 IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hwe'.
  - apply wf_sig_empty. exact Hwe'.
  - apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IH. exact Hwe'.
    + apply wf_typ_weaken_cons1. exact Hwt.
    + exact Hnot.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Signature weakening for typing                                   *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Scheme typing_mut := Induction for typing Sort Prop
with typing_record_mut := Induction for typing_record_comp Sort Prop.

Lemma typing_sig_weaken_aux : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T ->
  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T.
Proof.
  intros E0 R0 e0 T0 Hty0.
  pose (P := fun (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ)
                   (_ : typing E R e T) =>
               forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T).
  pose (Q := fun (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ)
                   (_ : typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
               forall R2, wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) ->
                         typing_record_comp E (R2 ++ R) r T).
  change (P E0 R0 e0 T0 Hty0).
  apply (typing_mut P Q).
  - (* var *) intros E R x T Hwe Hws Hbind R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_var E (R2 ++ R) x T Hwe Hws' Hbind).
  - (* abs *) intros L E R V e1 T1 Hws Hbody IHbody R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_abs L E (R2 ++ R) V e1 T1 Hws').
    intros x Hx.
    apply (IHbody x Hx R2).
    apply (wf_sig_env_weaken_cons E (R2 ++ R) x (bind_typ V) Hws').
    apply (wf_sig_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R).
    apply (typing_wf_sig_mut (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1).
    apply Hbody. exact Hx.
  - (* app *) intros T1 E R e1 e2 T2 Hws Hbody1 IH1 Hbody2 IH2 R2 Hws'.
    apply (typing_app T1 E (R2 ++ R) e1 e2 T2 Hws'
             (IH1 R2 Hws') (IH2 R2 Hws')).

Lemma typing_sig_weaken : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (e : exp) (T : typ),
  typing E R e T ->
  forall (R2 : sig), wf_sig E (R2 ++ R) -> typing E (R2 ++ R) e T.
Proof.
