Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Store lemmas                                                     *)
(* ================================================================ *)

(* A label absent from the store cannot be bound by the signature. *)
Lemma typing_store_notin_dom : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                      (l : label),
  typing_store E R s ->
  (forall v, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
  ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R s l Hts Hnot Hin.
  apply Signatures.binds_In_inv in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [S Hb]. destruct S as [T].
  destruct (typing_store_dom E R s l T Hts Hb) as [v HM].
  exact (Hnot v HM).
Qed.

(* Generic signature extension for store typings.  The signature grows
   from [R1] to [R2 ++ R1]; the store grows from [s] to [s'].  Old entries
   persist ([Hmono]); every binding in [R2] has a typed entry in [s']
   ([Hext]); and every entry of [s'] is either such a new typed entry or
   an old entry.  Old values are retyped under the extended signature via
   [typing_sig_weaken]. *)
Lemma typing_store_mono_sig : forall (E : env) (R1 R2 : sig)
                                     (s s' : store),
  wf_sig E (R2 ++ R1) ->
  typing_store E R1 s ->
  (forall (l : label) (v : exp),
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s') ->
  (forall (l : label) (T : typ),
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R2 ->
      exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s' /\
                typing E (R2 ++ R1) v T /\ value v) ->
  (forall (l : label) (v : exp),
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s' ->
      (exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R2 /\
                 typing E (R2 ++ R1) v T /\ value v) \/
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
  typing_store E (R2 ++ R1) s'.
Proof.
  intros E R1 R2 s s' Hws Hts Hmono Hext Hdec.
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb.
    apply Signatures.binds_app_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Hb2 | Hb1].
    + exact (Hext l0 T0 Hb2).
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v [HM [Hty Hval]]].
      exists v. split.
      * exact (Hmono l0 v HM).
      * split.
        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
        -- exact Hval.
  - intros v HM.
    destruct (Hdec l0 v HM) as [[T0 [Hb2 [Hty Hval]]] | HM0].
    + exists T0. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
      * exact Hty.
      * exact (Signatures.binds_app_2 signature l0 (bind_sig T0) R2 R1 Hb2).
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
      destruct (Hg v HM0) as [T0 [Hval [Hty Hb]]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R1 v T0 Hty R2 Hws).
      * exact (Signatures.binds_app_3 signature l0 (bind_sig T0) R2 R1 Hb).
Qed.

(* Add one fresh label/entry, extending the signature with its type.
   [wf_typ E T] is genuinely needed: [typing] does not imply [wf_typ]
   (e.g. [typing_abs] accepts an arbitrary annotation), while [wf_sig_typ]
   does require it.  The absence of [l] from the store is what lets us
   derive [l] notin dom R, so no separate disjointness hypothesis is
   needed. *)
Lemma typing_store_add : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  wf_typ E T ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  (forall v0, ~ LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v0 s) ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hwt Hts Hfresh Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  assert (Hnot : ~ LabelSetImpl.In l (Signatures.dom R)) by
    (apply (typing_store_notin_dom E R s l Hts); exact Hfresh).
  assert (Hwf : wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R)) by
    (apply wf_sig_typ; [exact Hws | exact Hwt | exact Hnot]).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb.
    apply (proj1 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Hl HT] | Hb1].
    + subst l0. subst T0.
      exists v. split.
      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
      * split.
        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
        -- exact Hval.
    + assert (Hneq : l <> l0).
      { intro Heq. subst l0.
        apply Hnot.
        exact (Signatures.binds_In signature l (bind_sig T0) R Hb1). }
      destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb1) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
      exists v0. split.
      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0
                       Hneq) HM).
      * split.
        -- exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
        -- exact Hval0.
  - intros v0 HM.
    apply (proj1 (LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff (elt := exp)
                    s l l0 v v0)) in HM.
    destruct HM as [[Hl Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
    + subst l0. subst v0.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v T Hty (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
      * apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R l T l T)). left.
        split; reflexivity.
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split.
      * exact (typing_sig_weaken E R v0 T0 Hty0 (l ~ bind_sig T) Hwf).
      * apply (proj2 (binds_sig_cons R l T l0 T0)). right. exact Hb0.
Qed.

(* Replace/insert the store entry at an already-bound label.  The type
   is forced by the signature (using well-formedness/uniqueness of
   bindings), so the new value simply has to inhabit that type. *)
Lemma typing_store_update : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (s : store)
                                   (l : label) (v : exp) (T : typ),
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing E R v T ->
  value v ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hts Hb Hty Hval.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by
    (exact (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T Hty)).
  unfold typing_store in *.
  intro l0. split.
  - intros T0 Hb0.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst l0.
      assert (HT : T0 = T) by
        (exact (wf_sig_binds_uniq E R l T0 T Hws Hb0 Hb)).
      subst T0.
      exists v. split.
      * apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff. left. split; reflexivity.
      * split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [Hf _].
      destruct (Hf T0 Hb0) as [v0 [HM [Hty0 Hval0]]].
      exists v0. split.
      * exact (proj2 (@LabelMapFacts.add_neq_mapsto_iff exp s l l0 v v0
                       Hneq) HM).
      * split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hval0].
  - intros v0 HM.
    apply LabelMapFacts.add_mapsto_iff in HM.
    destruct HM as [[Heq Hveq] | [Hneq HM0]].
    + subst l0. subst v0.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval |]. split; [exact Hty | exact Hb].
    + destruct (Hts l0) as [_ Hg].
      destruct (Hg v0 HM0) as [T0 [Hval0 [Hty0 Hb0]]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hval0 |]. split; [exact Hty0 | exact Hb0].
Qed.

Lemma my_wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> forall l T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R H.
  induction H as [ E0 HE0 | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hpre IHpre HT Hnotin ]; intros l1 T1 Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as Hl HT'. subst. assumption.
    + apply (IHpre l1 T1). assumption.

Lemma typing_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l S,
  typing E R (exp_ref l) S ->
  exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R /\ sub E (typ_box T) S.
Proof.
  intros E R l S H.
  remember (exp_ref l) as e eqn:He.

Lemma sub_all_all : forall (E : env) A B C D,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_all A B) -> wf_typ E (typ_all C D) ->
  sub E (typ_all A B) (typ_all C D) ->
  wf_typ E C /\ sub E C A /\
    exists L, forall X, X `notin` L ->
      sub (X ~ bind_sub C ++ E) (open_tt B X) (open_tt D X).
Proof.
  intros E A B C D HE HA HB Hsub.
  destruct (wf_typ_inv_all E C D HB) as [L0 [HwC HbodyD]].
  destruct (sub_allcomp E (typ_all A B) (typ_all C D) HE HA Hsub C D L0
              HwC HbodyD (all_comp_all C D))
    as [A' [B' [L [HA' [Hac' [HCA HB']]]]]].
  destruct (AllComp_all_inv _ _ _ _ Hac') as [HeqA HeqB].
  subst A'. subst B'.
  split.
  - exact HwC.
  - split.
    + exact HCA.
    + exists L. exact HB'.
Qed.

  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E A ->

    (forall X, X `notin` L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub A ++ E) (open_tt B' X) (open_tt B X)).
Proof.
  intros E S A B L0 HE HS HA Hbody Hsub.
  eapply sub_allcomp; eauto.
  apply all_comp_all.
Qed.

## A. Record field invariance — proved

`RCompP (a : atom) : typ -> typ -> Prop`, the "plain component" relation:
```
rcp_here : forall A, RCompP a (typ_record a A) A
rcp_fvar : forall X A, RCompP a X A
rcp_int_l/r : RCompP a X A -> RCompP a (typ_int X Y) A  (and the right variant)
```
(It is `RComp` without the constructor descending under `typ_mut`; the unrestricted two-way `RComp` invariant is false because of `sub_readonly_record`.)

```
Lemma sub_record_record_both : forall (E : env) (a : atom) A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E (typ_record a A) -> wf_typ E (typ_record a B) ->
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

Lemma sub_to_record_src : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  exists C, wf_typ E C /\ RCompP a S C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C.

Lemma sub_to_record_src_shapes : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> sub E S (typ_record a B) ->
  (exists C, S = typ_record a C /\ sub E C B /\ sub E B C) \/
  (exists X, S = typ_fvar X) \/
  (exists U V, S = typ_int U V).

Lemma sub_record_fvar_false : forall E (a : atom) A X,
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_fvar X) -> False.
```
The requested literal "record or fvar" disjunction is false: `typ_int (typ_record a B) V` subtypes `typ_record a B` via `sub_inter_left`. The `RCompP` refinement is the correct, provable source characterisation and supplies exactly the both-direction field equality needed in the `sub_trans` case. The record-to-`fvar` impossibility is proved via a reachability predicate closed under `sub`.

## B. Dropping readonly — the universal form is FALSE

The exact requested universal statement
`forall E T T', sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'`
is not derivable. Take `T = typ_record a (typ_arrow A B)`, `T' = typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a typ_top)`. The premise holds by `sub_readonly_record` from `typ_arrow A B <: typ_top`. The conclusion would give `typ_record a (typ_arrow A B) <: typ_record a typ_top`, hence by `sub_record_record_both` both `typ_arrow A B <: typ_top` and `typ_top <: typ_arrow A B`; the latter is not derivable. The obstruction is exactly the one-directional `sub_readonly_record`.

Also the proposed readonly/readonly inversion
`sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) (typ_mut mut_readonly U) -> sub E T U`
is false for the same reason (same `T`, `U = typ_record a typ_top`, premise from `sub_readonly_record`; the conclusion would force `typ_top <: typ_arrow A B`).

Strongest true forms proved (all with the requested wf hypotheses):

```
Lemma sub_readonly_drop_top : forall (E : env) T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) typ_top -> sub E T typ_top.

Lemma sub_readonly_drop_fvar : forall (E : env) T X,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) (typ_fvar X) -> sub E T (typ_fvar X).

Lemma sub_readonly_drop_box : forall (E : env) T B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) (typ_box B) -> sub E T (typ_box B).

Lemma sub_readonly_drop_record : forall (E : env) T (a : atom) B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) (typ_record a B) -> sub E T (typ_record a B).

Lemma sub_readonly_drop_nonrecord : forall (E : env) T T',
  (forall (a : atom) C, T <> typ_record a C) ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E T' ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'.
```
The `fvar`, `box`, and plain-`record` target premises are impossible (proved via the `Readonly` `NR` lemmas), so those instances hold vacuously. `sub_readonly_drop_nonrecord` is the genuine universal drop, for non-record `T`: it covers arbitrary targets, including `typ_top`, `typ_int U V`, and `typ_mut mut_readonly U`. The record-source case cannot be recovered without extra structure, as explained above. Auxiliary `sub_to_merge_readonly` is also included.

## C. Target box

```
Lemma sub_to_box : forall (E : env) S B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E S (typ_box B) ->
  exists A, wf_typ E A /\ sub E A B /\ sub E B A /\
    (S = typ_box A \/ BoxComp S A).
```

## D. Target arrow

```
Lemma sub_to_arrow : forall (E : env) S A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) ->
  sub E S (typ_arrow A B) ->
  exists A' B', wf_typ E A' /\ wf_typ E B' /\
    ArrComp S A' B' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E B' B.
```

Lemma typing_unbox_ref_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) l T,
  typing E R (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) T ->
  exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\ sub E T0 T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H.
  remember (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H; intros l0 He; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_sub *) destruct (IHtyping l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    exists T0. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* typing_unbox *) injection He as He1. subst e.
    assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); apply (typing_wf_sig E R _ _ H0)).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv _ _ _ _ H0) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    assert (Hws : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)).
    { apply wf_typ_box. apply (my_wf_sig_binds E R H l0 T0 Hb). }
    assert (Hwt : wf_typ E (typ_box T)).
    { apply (sub_wf_target E (typ_box T0) (typ_box T) HE Hws Hsub). }
    destruct (sub_box_box E T0 T HE Hws Hwt Hsub) as [H01 H10].
    exists T0. split; assumption.
  - (* typing_unbox_readonly *) injection He as He1. subst e.
    assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); apply (typing_wf_sig E R _ _ H)).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv _ _ _ _ H) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    assert (Hws : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)).
    { apply wf_typ_box. apply (my_wf_sig_binds E R (typing_wf_sig E R _ _ H) l0 T0 Hb). }
    assert (Hwt : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T))).
    { apply (sub_wf_target E (typ_box T0) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) HE Hws Hsub). }
    assert (Hwtb : wf_typ E (typ_box T)).
    { apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly (typ_box T) Hwt). }
    destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_box T0) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T))
                HE Hws Hsub T (wf_typ_inv_box _ _ Hwtb)
                (box_comp_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T) T (box_comp_box T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [H1 H2]]]].
    assert (Heq : A' = T0) by (apply (BoxComp_box_inv _ _ Hac')).
    subst A'.
    exists T0. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply (sub_readonly_mutable E T0 T H2).
Qed.

  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E T' ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'.
Proof.
  intros E T T' Hnr HE HT HT' H.
  remember (typ_mut mut_readonly T) as S eqn:HS.
  revert T Hnr HT HT' HS.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U0 E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0

                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];
  intros T Hnr HT HT' HS.
  - (* top *) apply sub_top; assumption.
  - (* refl tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* trans tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* arrow *) discriminate HS.
  - (* all *) discriminate HS.
  - (* box *) discriminate HS.
  - (* readonly *)
    injection HS as Heq. subst T1.
    apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact H1.
  - (* readonly mutable *)
    subst T1.
    assert (HwT2 : wf_typ E0 T2)
      by (apply (wf_typ_inv_readonly E0 mut_readonly T2 HT')).
    apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply (IH1 HE T Hnr HT HwT2 eq_refl).

              (wf_typ_readonly E0 T HT) H1)).
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply (IH1 HE T Hnr HT HwT2 eq_refl).
    + exact H2.
  - (* inter left *) discriminate HS.
  - (* inter right *) discriminate HS.
  - (* inter *)
    subst T1.
    destruct (wf_typ_inv_inter E0 T2 T3 HT') as [HwT2 HwT3].
    apply sub_inter.
    + apply (IH1 HE T Hnr HT HwT2 eq_refl).
    + apply (IH2 HE T Hnr HT HwT3 eq_refl).
  - (* record *) discriminate HS.
  - (* readonly record *)
    injection HS as Heq.
    exfalso. apply (Hnr a T1). symmetry. exact Heq.
  - (* denormalize *)
    subst T1.
    assert (Hnf : wf_typ E0 (normal_form_typing T))

    assert (Hmt : sub E0 (normal_form_typing T)

    rewrite nf_mut in Hsub0.
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply (sub_to_nf E0 T HE HT).
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact Hmt.
      * eapply sub_trans.

        -- apply (sub_of_nf E0 T2 HE HSd2).
Qed.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inclusion/weakening for wf_typ and sub                           *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall (E1 : env) T,
  wf_typ E1 T ->
  forall (E2 : env),
    (forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1 -> binds X (bind_sub U) E2) ->
    wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros E1 T H. induction H; intros E2 Hincl.
  - constructor.
  - apply (wf_typ_var U E2 X). apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L); auto.
    intros X HX. apply (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E2)).
    intros Y U Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HY HU. subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply Hincl. assumption.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl_all : forall (E1 E2 : env) T,
  (forall x b, binds x b E1 -> binds x b E2) ->
  wf_typ E1 T -> wf_typ E2 T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_typ_incl; eauto.
Qed.


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Box-component analysis of subtyping                              *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Inductive BoxComp : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | box_comp_box : forall A, BoxComp (typ_box A) A
  | box_comp_fvar : forall X A, BoxComp (typ_fvar X) A
  | box_comp_rofvar : forall m X A, BoxComp (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X)) A
  | box_comp_int_l : forall X Y A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_int_r : forall X Y A, BoxComp Y A -> BoxComp (typ_int X Y) A
  | box_comp_mut : forall m X A, BoxComp X A -> BoxComp (typ_mut m X) A.

Lemma BoxComp_merge_fwd : forall (T : typ) m A,
  BoxComp T A -> BoxComp (merge_mutability T m) A.

Definition same_kinds (E1 E2 : env) : Prop :=
  forall X, (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E1) <-> (exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E2).

Lemma same_kinds_refl : forall E, same_kinds E E.
Proof. intros. intros X. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + exists V. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_sub_any : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U U',
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_sub U)::E1) ((X, bind_sub U')::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U U' Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U'. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + injection Heq as HXY HV'. subst. exists U. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma same_kinds_cons_typ : forall (E1 E2 : env) X U,
  same_kinds E1 E2 -> same_kinds ((X, bind_typ U)::E1) ((X, bind_typ U)::E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 X U Hsk Y. simpl. split; intros [V HV].
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + destruct (proj1 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].
      exists V'. right. assumption.
  - destruct HV as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq.
    + destruct (proj2 (Hsk Y) (ex_intro _ V Hin)) as [V' HV'].

  typing E R (exp_tapp e Targ) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists A B, typing E R e (typ_all A B) /\
    sub E Targ A /\ sub E (open_tt B Targ) T.
Proof.
  intros E R e Targ T H. remember (exp_tapp e Targ) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targb T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - (* typing_tapp *)
    injection He as Hx Hy. subst e1b Targb.
    exists T1, T2. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (open_tt T2 Targ) HE Ht).
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IH1 He HE (WfTyping.typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e0 S H1))
      as [A [B [HA [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    exists A, B. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion for [exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))]: the only usable
   typing is the readonly-box one, and the store binding type is
   related to the result through a readonly type. *)
Lemma typing_unbox_sealed_ref_inv_local : forall E R l T,
  typing E R (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) T ->
  exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\
    sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T0) T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. remember (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targb T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 lb T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros l0 He; try discriminate.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IH1 l0 He) as [T0 [Hb Hsub]].
    exists T0. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* typing_unbox: impossible *)
    injection He as He1. subst e0.
    assert (Hws0 : wf_sig E0 R0) by (eapply Store.typing_wf_sig_mut; eauto).
    assert (HE : wf_env E0) by (apply (Dev.wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0 Hws0)).
    assert (HWT : wf_typ E0 (typ_box T0))
      by (apply (WfTyping.typing_wf_typ E0 R0 (exp_seal (exp_ref l0)) (typ_box T0) H1)).
    destruct (TypingInv.typing_seal_inv E0 R0 (exp_ref l0) (typ_box T0) H1 HE HWT)
      as [S0 [_ Hss]].
    exact (Readonly.sub_readonly_box_false E0 S0 T0 Hss).
  - (* typing_unbox_readonly *)
    injection He as He1. subst e0.
    assert (Hws0 : wf_sig E0 R0) by (eapply Store.typing_wf_sig_mut; eauto).
    assert (HE : wf_env E0) by (apply (Dev.wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0 Hws0)).
    assert (HWT : wf_typ E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)))
      by (apply (WfTyping.typing_wf_typ E0 R0 (exp_seal (exp_ref l0))
                   (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)) H1)).
    assert (HWTb : wf_typ E0 (typ_box T0))
      by (apply (Dev.wf_typ_inv_readonly E0 mut_readonly (typ_box T0) HWT)).
    assert (HWT0 : wf_typ E0 T0) by (apply (Dev.wf_typ_inv_box E0 T0 HWTb)).
    destruct (TypingInv.typing_seal_inv E0 R0 (exp_ref l0)
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)) H1 HE HWT)
      as [S0 [Htyref Hsubseal]].
    destruct (MyWork.typing_ref_inv E0 R0 l0 S0 Htyref)
      as [Tb [Hb Hsubbox]].
    assert (Hsubr : sub E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box Tb))
                            (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)))
      by (eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_readonly; exact Hsubbox | exact Hsubseal]).
    assert (Hwsrc : wf_typ E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box Tb)))
      by (apply (Dev.sub_wf_source E0 _ _ HE HWT Hsubr)).
    destruct (MyWork.sub_boxcomp E0
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box Tb))
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)) HE Hwsrc Hsubr T0 HWT0
                (MyWork.box_comp_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0) T0
                   (MyWork.box_comp_box T0)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [Hlt Hgt]]]].
    assert (Hac'' : MyWork.BoxComp (typ_box Tb) A')
      by (apply (MyWork.BoxComp_mut_inv with (m := mut_readonly); exact Hac').
    assert (Heq : A' = Tb) by (apply (MyWork.BoxComp_box_inv (A := Tb) (B := A'); exact Hac'').
    subst A'.
    exists Tb. split; [exact Hb |].
    (* goal: sub E0 (readonly Tb) (readonly T0), obtained by sub_readonly
       from Hlt : sub E0 Tb T0 *)
    apply sub_readonly. exact Hlt.
Qed.

(* A stored value can be retyped at its signature binding type. *)
Lemma typing_store_value : forall E R s l v T,
  wf_sig E R ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s ->
  typing E R v T.
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hws Hst Hb HM.
  destruct (Hst l) as [Hf Hg].
  destruct (Hg v HM) as [T0 [Hval [Hty0 Hb0]]].
  assert (Heq : T0 = T)
    by (eapply Store.wf_sig_binds_uniq; eauto).
  subst T0. exact Hty0.
Qed.

(* Inversions of record-component typings. *)
Lemma typing_record_comp_exp_inv : forall E R a e r T,
  typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) T ->
  exists T1 Tr, a `notin` record_dom r /\ typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\
    typing E R e T1 /\ T = typ_int (typ_record a T1) Tr.
Proof.
  intros E R a e r T H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists; repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_inv : forall E R a l r T,
  typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) T ->
  exists T1 Tr, a `notin` record_dom r /\ typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R /\ T = typ_int (typ_record a T1) Tr.
Proof.
  intros E R a l r T H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists; repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

From D Require Import Dev.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* 1. Well-formed signatures: binding inversion and uniqueness      *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma wf_sig_binds : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R -> wf_typ E T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot];
    intro Hb.
  - (* empty signature *)
    simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - (* l0 ~ bind_sig T0 ++ R0 *)
    apply Signatures.binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heql HeqT] | Hin].
    + injection HeqT as HT. subst. exact Hwt.
    + apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig),
  wf_sig E R -> Signatures.uniq R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H as [E0 Hwe | E0 R0 l0 T0 Hws IH Hwt Hnot].
  - constructor.
  - apply Signatures.uniq_push; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_uniq : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T1 T2 : typ),
  wf_sig E R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R l T1 T2 Hws Hb1 Hb2.
  assert (Hu : Signatures.uniq R) by (exact (wf_sig_uniq E R Hws)).
  pose proof (Signatures.binds_unique signature l (bind_sig T1) (bind_sig T2) R
                Hb1 Hb2 Hu) as Heq.
  injection Heq as HT. exact HT.
Qed.

(* Beta for term abstraction: type the opened body at a type below the
   arrow's codomain. *)
Lemma typing_abs_beta : forall E R V e1 T1 T2 v2,
  typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
  typing E R v2 T1 ->
  value v2 ->
  exists Tbody,
    typing E R (open_ee e1 v2) Tbody /\ sub E Tbody T2.
Proof.
  intros E R V e1 T1 T2 v2 Hty Hv2ty Hval2.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by (apply (typing_wf_sig_mut E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow T1 T2)); assumption).
  assert (HE : wf_env E) by (apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R); assumption).
  assert (HWf : wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow T1 T2)); assumption).
  destruct (typing_abs_inv E R V e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) Hty HE HWf)
    as [Tbody [L [Hs Hbody]]].
  assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_arrow V Tbody))
    by (apply (sub_wf_source E (typ_arrow V Tbody) (typ_arrow T1 T2)); assumption).
  destruct (sub_arrow_arrow E V Tbody T1 T2 HE HWS HWf Hs)
    as [Hcontra Hco].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E `union` fv_exp e1)) as [x Hx].
  assert (HxL : x `notin` L).
  { apply notin_union_1 in Hx. assumption. }
  assert (HxE : x `notin` dom E).
  { apply notin_union_2 in Hx. apply notin_union_1 in Hx. assumption. }
  assert (Hxfv : x `notin` fv_exp e1).
  { apply notin_union_2 in Hx. apply notin_union_2 in Hx. assumption. }
  assert (HvV : typing E R v2 V)
    by (apply (typing_sub T1 E R v2 V Hws Hv2ty Hcontra)).
  assert (Hbodyx : typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) Tbody)
    by (apply Hbody; assumption).
  exists Tbody. split.
  - exact (typing_subst_ee0_open E x V R e1 Tbody v2 HxE Hxfv Hval2 HvV Hbodyx).
  - exact Hco.
Qed.

  assert (HXsig : X `notin` fv_sig R)

Lemma typing_seal_inner_result : forall E R e S T,
  typing E R e S ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) T ->
  typing E R e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e S T Hty Hsub.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by (apply (typing_wf_sig_mut E R e S); assumption).
  apply (typing_sub (typ_mut mut_readonly S) E R e T Hws).
  - apply (typing_readonly_wrap E R e S); assumption.
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* If [v : T0] and [T0 <: S], then [v : readonly S]. *)
Lemma typing_value_at_readonly : forall E R v T0 S,
  typing E R v T0 ->
  sub E T0 S ->
  typing E R v (typ_mut mut_readonly S).
Proof.
  intros E R v T0 S Hty Hsub.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by (apply (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T0); assumption).
  apply (typing_sub T0 E R v (typ_mut mut_readonly S) Hws Hty).
  apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* The final result for unboxing a plain reference at a readonly box type. *)
Lemma typing_value_readonly_result : forall E R v T0 S T,
  typing E R v T0 ->
  sub E T0 S ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) T ->
  typing E R v T.
Proof.
  intros E R v T0 S T Hty Hsub0 HsubRO.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by (apply (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T0); assumption).
  apply (typing_sub (typ_mut mut_readonly S) E R v T Hws).
  - apply (typing_value_at_readonly E R v T0 S); assumption.
  - exact HsubRO.
Qed.

(* Sealing a value of type T0, when T0 <: S, produces a value of readonly S. *)
Lemma typing_seal_value_at_readonly : forall E R v T0 S,
  typing E R v T0 ->
  sub E T0 S ->
  typing E R (exp_seal v) (typ_mut mut_readonly S).
Proof.
  intros E R v T0 S Hty Hsub.
  assert (Hws : wf_sig E R) by (apply (typing_wf_sig_mut E R v T0); assumption).
  apply (typing_sub T0 E R (exp_seal v) (typ_mut mut_readonly S) Hws).
  - apply typing_seal. exact Hty.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A value of box type is a reference. *)
Lemma value_box_ref : forall E R e B,
  value e -> typing E R e (typ_box B) -> wf_env E ->
  exists l, e = exp_ref l.
Proof.
  intros E R e B Hv Hty HE.
  assert (HWf : wf_typ E (typ_box B)) by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R e (typ_box B)); assumption).
  assert (HB : wf_typ E B) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_box E B HWf)).
  induction Hv as [ V0 body Hexpr | V0 body Hexpr | l | l | r Hvr | r Hvr ].
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_abs_inv E R V0 body (typ_box B) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_arrow V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_arrow V0 T1) (typ_box B) HE HWS Hs B HB
                (box_comp_box B)) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_tabs_inv E R V0 body (typ_box B) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_all V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_boxcomp E (typ_all V0 T1) (typ_box B) HE HWS Hs B HB
                (box_comp_box B)) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exists l. reflexivity.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box B) Hty HE HWf)
      as [St [Href Hs]].
    eapply sub_readonly_box_false; eauto.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_record_inv E R r (typ_box B) Hty HE HWf) as [Tr [Hr Hs]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E Tr) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_boxcomp E Tr (typ_box B) HE HWS Hs B HB
                (box_comp_box B)) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    eapply BoxComp_record_comp_false; eauto.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_record r) (typ_box B) Hty HE HWf)
      as [St [Hrec Hs]].
    eapply sub_readonly_box_false; eauto.
Qed.

(* A value of non-readonly record type is a record literal. *)
Lemma value_record_lit : forall E R e a T,
  value e -> typing E R e (typ_record a T) -> wf_env E ->
  exists r, e = exp_record r.
Proof.
  intros E R e a T Hv Hty HE.
  assert (HWf : wf_typ E (typ_record a T))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R e (typ_record a T)); assumption).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T HWf)).
  induction Hv as [ V0 body Hexpr | V0 body Hexpr | l | l | r Hvr | r Hvr ].
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_abs_inv E R V0 body (typ_record a T) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_arrow V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_arrow V0 T1) (typ_record a T) HE HWS Hs T HT
                (rc_here a T)) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_tabs_inv E R V0 body (typ_record a T) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_all V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_all V0 T1) (typ_record a T) HE HWS Hs T HT
                (rc_here a T)) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_record a T) Hty) as [T0 [Hb Hs]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_box T0) (typ_record a T) HE HWS Hs T HT
                (rc_here a T)) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_ref l) (typ_record a T) Hty HE HWf)
      as [St [Href Hs]].
    eapply sub_readonly_record_false; eauto.
  - exists r. reflexivity.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_record r) (typ_record a T) Hty HE HWf)
      as [St [Hrec Hs]].
    eapply sub_readonly_record_false; eauto.
Qed.

(* A value of readonly record type is either a record literal or a sealed one. *)
Lemma value_record_readonly_lit : forall E R e a T,
  value e -> typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) -> wf_env E ->
  (exists r, e = exp_record r) \/ (exists r, e = exp_seal (exp_record r)).
Proof.
  intros E R e a T Hv Hty HE.
  assert (HWf : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)))
    by (apply (typing_wf_typ E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))); assumption).
  assert (HT : wf_typ E T) by (apply (wf_typ_inv_record E a T
    (wf_typ_inv_readonly E mut_readonly (typ_record a T) HWf))).
  induction Hv as [ V0 body Hexpr | V0 body Hexpr | l | l | r Hvr | r Hvr ].
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_abs_inv E R V0 body (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_arrow V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_arrow V0 T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                HE HWS Hs T HT (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_tabs_inv E R V0 body (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty HE HWf)
      as [T1 [L [Hs _]]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_all V0 T1)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_all V0 T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                HE HWS Hs T HT (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) Hty)
      as [T0 [Hb Hs]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_box T0) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                HE HWS Hs T HT (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    inversion Hc.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (exp_ref l) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T))
                Hty HE HWf) as [St [Href Hs]].
    assert (HWS : wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly St))
      by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE HWf Hs)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_mut mut_readonly St)
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) HE HWS Hs T HT
                (rc_mut a mut_readonly (typ_record a T) T (rc_here a T))) as [A' [HA' [Hc _]]].
    assert (Hc' : RComp a St A') by (apply (RComp_mut_inv a mut_readonly St A' Hc)).
    destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l St Href) as [T0 [Hb Hs0]].
    assert (HWB : wf_typ E (typ_box T0)) by (apply (sub_wf_source E _ _ HE
      (typing_wf_typ E R (exp_ref l) St Href) Hs0)).
    destruct (sub_rcomp a E (typ_box T0) St HE HWB Hs0 A' HA' Hc')
      as [A'' [HA'' [Hc'' _]]].
    inversion Hc''.
  - left. exists r. reflexivity.
  - right. exists r. reflexivity.
Qed.

[T' = typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a typ_top)], the premise holds via
   [sub_readonly_record] from [typ_arrow A B <: typ_top], but the conclusion
   would force [typ_record a (typ_arrow A B) <: typ_record a typ_top], hence

Lemma sub_to_merge_readonly : forall (E : env) U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E U -> sub E U (merge_mutability U mut_readonly).
Proof.
  intros E U HE H. induction H as [ E0
                 | U0 E0 X Hb
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 H1 IH1 ].
  - rewrite merge_top. apply sub_top; [assumption | constructor].
  - rewrite merge_fvar. apply sub_readonly_mutable.
    apply sub_refl_tvar; [assumption | exact (wf_typ_var U0 E0 X Hb)].
  - rewrite merge_arrow. apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_arrow T1 T2) HE
      (wf_typ_arrow E0 T1 T2 H1 H2)).
  - rewrite merge_all. apply (sub_refl E0 (typ_all T1 T2) HE
      (wf_typ_all L E0 T1 T2 H1 H0)).

  (forall (a : atom) C, T <> typ_record a C) ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E T' ->
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T) T' -> sub E T T'.
Proof.
  intros E T T' Hnr HE HT HT' H.
  remember (typ_mut mut_readonly T) as S eqn:HS.
  revert T Hnr HT HT' HS.
  induction H as [ E0 S0 HE0 HS0
                 | E0 X HE0 HS0
                 | U0 E0 T0 X Hb Hpre IHpre
                 | E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L0 E0 S1 S2 T1 T2 H1 IH1 H0 IH0

                 | E0 T1 T2 HEi2 HSi2b HSi2c
                 | E0 T1 T2 T3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 a T1 T2 H1 IH1
                 | E0 T1 T2 HSd1 HSd2 Hsub0 IHsub0 ];

  - (* top *) apply sub_top; assumption.
  - (* refl tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* trans tvar *) discriminate HS.
  - (* arrow *) discriminate HS.
  - (* all *) discriminate HS.

    apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact H1.

Lemma sub_to_box : forall (E : env) S B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_box B) ->
  sub E S (typ_box B) ->
  exists A, wf_typ E A /\ sub E A B /\ sub E B A /\
    (S = typ_box A \/ BoxComp S A).
Proof.
  intros E S B HE HS HB Hsub.
  destruct (sub_boxcomp E S (typ_box B) HE HS Hsub B
              (wf_typ_inv_box E B HB) (box_comp_box B))
    as [A [HA [Hac [HAB HBA]]]].
  exists A. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================= *)
(* Part D: target arrow characterisation.                             *)
(* ================================================================= *)

Lemma sub_to_arrow : forall (E : env) S A B,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E S -> wf_typ E (typ_arrow A B) ->
  sub E S (typ_arrow A B) ->
  exists A' B', wf_typ E A' /\ wf_typ E B' /\
    ArrComp S A' B' /\ sub E A A' /\ sub E B' B.
Proof.
  intros E S A B HE HS HA Hsub.
  destruct (wf_typ_inv_arrow E A B HA) as [HA1 HB1].
  apply (sub_arrcomp E S (typ_arrow A B) HE HS Hsub A B HA1 HB1
           (arr_comp_arrow A B)).
Qed.

match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfTyping SubInv.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about [record_lookup_ref] and [record_dom]           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma record_lookup_ref_in_dom : forall (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) (l : label),
  record_lookup_ref a r = Some l -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros a r. induction r as [| a' e r IH | a' l' r IH]; intros l H;
    simpl in *.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hneq].
    + apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. symmetry. exact Heq.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH l H).
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a l r) = Some l.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_neq : forall (a a' : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
  a <> a' ->
  record_lookup_ref a (rec_ref a' l r) = record_lookup_ref a r.
Proof.
  intros a a' l r Hneq. simpl.
  destruct (a === a') as [Heq | Hn].
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma RComp_record_inv_label : forall (a a0 : atom) (A B : typ),
  RComp a (typ_record a0 A) B -> B = A /\ a0 = a.
Proof.
  intros a a0 A B H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Stripping [typing_sub] from a typing of a record literal.        *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_exp_record_inv : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (T : typ),
  typing E R (exp_record r) T ->
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R r Tr /\ sub E Tr T.
Proof.
  intros E R r T Hty.
  remember (exp_record r) as e eqn:He.
  revert He.
  revert r.
  induction Hty; intros rr Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHHty rr Heq) as [Tr [Hrc Hsub]].
    exists Tr. split; [exact Hrc | eapply sub_trans; eauto].
  - (* typing_record *)
    injection Heq as Hrr. subst rr.
    exists T. split.
    + exact H.
    + apply sub_refl.
      * apply (wf_sig_wf_env E R).
        apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R r T H).
      * apply (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R r T H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Component analysis: a ref field of a value record component.     *)
(*                                                                  *)
(* If a value record [r] (whose components are all [rec_ref]) has a *)
(* component [A] at label [a], then [a] is a ref field of [r] whose *)
(* label is bound in [R] with some type [Tf], and [Tf] is a         *)
(* subtype of [A].                                                  *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_field :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ) (a : atom) (A : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    RComp a Tr A ->
    exists l Tf,
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R /\
      sub E Tf A.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr a A Hrc.
  revert a A.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hval Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp: impossible for a value *) inversion Hval.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    inversion Hval as [| a1 l1 r1 Hval0]; subst.
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac)
      as [Hac1 | Hac1].
    + (* component is the record field of the head *)
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A Hac1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exists l0, T0. split; [| split].
      * apply record_lookup_ref_here.
      * exact Hb.
      * apply sub_refl.
        -- apply (wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0).
           apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        -- apply (wf_sig_binds E0 R0 l0 T0).
           ++ apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
           ++ exact Hb.
    + (* component comes from the tail *)
      destruct (IH a A Hval0 Hac1)
        as [l [Tf [Hlook [Hbind Hsub]]]].
      exists l, Tf. split; [| split].
      * assert (Hneq : a <> a0).
        { intro Heq. apply Hnotin. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (record_lookup_ref_in_dom a r0 l Hlook). }
        rewrite (record_lookup_ref_neq a a0 l0 r0 Hneq).
        exact Hlook.
      * exact Hbind.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Uniqueness of the component carried by a well-typed record at a  *)
(* given label.  These facts let us identify the component [C]      *)
(* produced by the reverse record-subtyping analysis with the       *)
(* actual field type [Tf] of the record literal.                    *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> a `in` record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A Hac.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion Hac.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A Hac) as [H1 | H1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A H1) as [HA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      apply union_iff. left. apply singleton_iff. reflexivity.
    + apply union_iff. right. apply (IH a A H1).
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_RComp_unique :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (A B : typ),
      RComp a Tr A -> RComp a Tr B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a A B HA HB.
  - (* rec_empty *) inversion HA.
  - (* rec_exp *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
  - (* rec_ref *)
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 A HA) as [HA1 | HA1];
    destruct (RComp_int_inv a (typ_record a0 T0) Tr0 B HB) as [HB1 | HB1].
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA _].
      destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB _].
      subst A. subst B. reflexivity.
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 A HA1) as [HeqA Ha0].
      subst A. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a B HB1).
    + destruct (RComp_record_inv_label a a0 T0 B HB1) as [HeqB Ha0].
      subst B. subst a0.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin.
      exact (typing_record_comp_RComp_in_dom E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0 a A HA1).
    + apply (IH a A B HA1 HB1).
Qed.

(* A successful lookup exposes the corresponding component of the
   record's type.  Only [rec_ref] nodes are visible to
   [record_lookup_ref]; a [rec_exp] node in front makes the lookup
   fail. *)
Lemma typing_record_comp_lookup_RComp :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (Tf : typ),
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig Tf) R ->
      RComp a Tr Tf.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hrc.
  induction Hrc as
    [ E0 R0 Hwe Hws
    | E0 R0 a0 e r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hty
    | E0 R0 a0 l0 r0 T0 Tr0 Hnotin Hrc0 IH Hb ];
    intros a l Tf Hlook Hbind.
  - (* rec_empty *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_exp *) simpl in Hlook. discriminate.
  - (* rec_ref *)
    simpl in Hlook.
    destruct (a === a0) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + injection Hlook as Hl. subst l. subst a0.
      assert (HTf : T0 = Tf).
      { eapply (wf_sig_binds_uniq E0 R0 l0 T0 Tf).
        - apply (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E0 R0 r0 Tr0 Hrc0).
        - exact Hb.
        - exact Hbind. }
      subst Tf. apply rc_int_l. apply rc_here.
    + apply rc_int_r. apply (IH a l Tf Hlook Hbind).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Every [rec_ref] occurring in a well-typed record component is     *)
(* bound in the signature.                                           *)
(* ================================================================ *)

Inductive rec_ref_occ : rec_comp -> atom -> label -> rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | rec_ref_occ_here : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a l r
  | rec_ref_occ_exp : forall (a : atom) (e : exp) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_exp a e r) a0 l r0
  | rec_ref_occ_ref : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r : rec_comp)
                             (a0 : atom) (l0 : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a0 l0 r0 ->
      rec_ref_occ (rec_ref a l r) a0 l0 r0.

Lemma typing_record_comp_ref_binds :
  forall (E : env) (R : sig) (r : rec_comp) (Tr : typ),
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
    forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r0 : rec_comp),
      rec_ref_occ r a l r0 ->
      exists T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R.
Proof.

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
From D Require Import Dev MyWork Store WfTyping TypingExpr SubWeaken Narrow
  SubNarrow Readonly TypingInv Canonical AllCompEx CanonicalAll Helpers
  RecordInv SubInv SubstTT SubstEE AllComp.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary inversion lemmas not provided by the imported modules.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Shape-directed inversion for [exp_tapp], analogous to
   TypingInv.typing_app_inv. *)
Lemma typing_tapp_inv_local : forall E R e Targ T,
  typing E R (exp_tapp e Targ) T ->
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  exists A B, typing E R e (typ_all A B) /\
    sub E Targ A /\ sub E (open_tt B Targ) T.
Proof.
  intros E R e Targ T H. remember (exp_tapp e Targ) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targb T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 l T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros He HE Ht; try discriminate.
  - (* typing_tapp *)
    injection He as Hx Hy. subst e1b Targb.
    exists T1, T2. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    apply (sub_refl E0 (open_tt T2 Targ) HE Ht).
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IH1 He HE (WfTyping.typing_wf_typ E0 R0 e0 S H1))
      as [A [B [HA [Hsub1 Hsub2]]]].
    exists A, B. split; [assumption|split; [assumption|]].
    eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion for [exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))]: the only usable
   typing is the readonly-box one, and the store binding type is
   related to the result through a readonly type. *)
Lemma typing_unbox_sealed_ref_inv_local : forall E R l T,
  typing E R (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) T ->
  exists T0, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T0) R /\
    sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T0) T.
Proof.
  intros E R l T H. remember (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) as e0 eqn:He.
  revert l He.
  induction H as [ E0 R0 x T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b e2b T2 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | L E0 R0 V e1b T1 Hws Hbody IHbody
                 | T1 E0 R0 e1b Targb T2 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | S E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1 Hsub
                 | L T1 T2 e1b e2b E0 R0 Hws H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody2
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 Hws H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b e2b T0 Hws H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                 | E0 R0 lb T0 Hwe Hws Hb
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 r T0 Hr IHr
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e0 a T0 H1 IH1
                 | E0 R0 e1b a e2b T0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 ];
  intros l0 He; try discriminate.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IH1 l0 He) as [Tb [Hb Hsubb]].
    exists Tb. split; [assumption|]. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - (* typing_unbox: impossible *)
    injection He as He1. subst e0.
    assert (Hws0 : wf_sig E0 R0) by (eapply Store.typing_wf_sig_mut; eauto).
    assert (HE : wf_env E0) by (apply (Dev.wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0 Hws0)).
    assert (HWT : wf_typ E0 (typ_box T0))
      by (apply (WfTyping.typing_wf_typ E0 R0 (exp_seal (exp_ref l0)) (typ_box T0) H1)).
    destruct (TypingInv.typing_seal_inv E0 R0 (exp_ref l0) (typ_box T0) H1 HE HWT)
      as [S0 [_ Hss]].
    exfalso. exact (Readonly.sub_readonly_box_false E0 S0 T0 Hss).
  - (* typing_unbox_readonly *)
    injection He as He1. subst e0.
    assert (Hws0 : wf_sig E0 R0) by (eapply Store.typing_wf_sig_mut; eauto).
    assert (HE : wf_env E0) by (apply (Dev.wf_sig_wf_env E0 R0 Hws0)).
    assert (HWT : wf_typ E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)))
      by (apply (WfTyping.typing_wf_typ E0 R0 (exp_seal (exp_ref l0))
                   (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)) H1)).
    assert (HWTb : wf_typ E0 (typ_box T0))
      by (apply (Dev.wf_typ_inv_readonly E0 mut_readonly (typ_box T0) HWT)).
    assert (HWT0 : wf_typ E0 T0) by (apply (Dev.wf_typ_inv_box E0 T0 HWTb)).
    destruct (TypingInv.typing_seal_inv E0 R0 (exp_ref l0)
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)) H1 HE HWT)
      as [S0 [Htyref Hsubseal]].
    destruct (MyWork.typing_ref_inv E0 R0 l0 S0 Htyref)
      as [Tb [Hb Hsubbox]].
    assert (Hsubr : sub E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box Tb))
                            (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)))
      by (eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_readonly; exact Hsubbox | exact Hsubseal]).
    assert (Hwsrc : wf_typ E0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box Tb)))
      by (apply (Dev.sub_wf_source E0 _ _ HE HWT Hsubr)).
    destruct (MyWork.sub_boxcomp E0
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box Tb))
                (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0)) HE Hwsrc Hsubr T0 HWT0
                (MyWork.box_comp_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T0) T0
                   (MyWork.box_comp_box T0)))
      as [A' [HA' [Hac' [Hlt Hgt]]]].
    assert (Hac'' : MyWork.BoxComp (typ_box Tb) A')
      by (exact (MyWork.BoxComp_mut_inv mut_readonly (typ_box Tb) A' Hac')).
    assert (Heq : A' = Tb)
      by (exact (MyWork.BoxComp_box_inv Tb A' Hac'')).
    subst A'.
    exists Tb. split; [exact Hb |].
    (* goal: sub E0 (readonly Tb) (readonly T0), obtained by sub_readonly
       from Hlt : sub E0 Tb T0 *)
    apply sub_readonly. exact Hgt.
Qed.

(* A stored value can be retyped at its signature binding type. *)
Lemma typing_store_value : forall E R s l v T,
  wf_sig E R ->
  typing_store E R s ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s ->
  typing E R v T.
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hws Hst Hb HM.

red_record_comp_ind =
fun (P : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop)
  (f : forall (a : atom) (e1 : exp) (s1 : store) (e1' : exp) 
         (s1' : store) (r1 : rec_comp),
       record_comp r1 ->
       < e1 | s1 > --> < e1' | s1' > ->
       P (rec_exp a e1 r1) s1 (rec_exp a e1' r1) s1')
  (f0 : forall (a : atom) (v : exp) (r1 : rec_comp) (s1 : store) (l : label),
        well_formed_store s1 ->
        record_comp r1 ->
        value v ->
        l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
        P (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1))
  (f1 : forall (a : atom) (l : label) (r1 : rec_comp) 
          (s1 : store) (r1' : rec_comp) (s1' : store),
        < r1 | s1 > -->r < r1' | s1' > ->
        P r1 s1 r1' s1' -> P (rec_ref a l r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1') s1') =>
fix F
  (r : rec_comp) (t : store) (r0 : rec_comp) (t0 : store)
  (r1 : < r | t > -->r < r0 | t0 >) {struct r1} : 
P r t r0 t0 :=
  match r1 in (< r2 | t1 > -->r < r3 | t2 >) return (P r2 t1 r3 t2) with
  | red_record_exp_1 a e1 s1 e1' s1' r2 r3 r4 => f a e1 s1 e1' s1' r2 r3 r4
  | red_record_exp_2 a v r2 s1 l w r3 v0 e => f0 a v r2 s1 l w r3 v0 e
  | red_record_ref a l r2 s1 r1' s1' r3 =>
      f1 a l r2 s1 r1' s1' r3 (F r2 s1 r1' s1' r3)
  end
     : forall P : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop,
       (forall (a : atom) (e1 : exp) (s1 : store) 
          (e1' : exp) (s1' : store) (r1 : rec_comp),
        record_comp r1 ->
